content.cn: 酸辣的口感，散发出高能异香石的独特香味。我第一次吃爆辣腌渍水果时，就是被它的浓郁香气吸引。尝了一口，“酸辣两极”的极致体验实在令人难忘。
content.en: Sour, spicy, and rich with the unique aroma of energized aggagrit. It's the same aroma that enticed me to try Superhot Fruit Preserves for the first time. One bite of the "bipolar sour-n-spicy" gave me the most extreme and unforgettable gastronomic experience.

content.cn: 我把爆辣腌渍水果给了布戈尔一份，之前每次开拓节就属他吃得最多。剩下的我给了另外两个工友，他们都感慨辣后回甘的爽口滋味儿。
content.en: I gave Bugor a serving of the Superhot Fruit Preserves. The dude can really plow through this stuff. The other two crew mates got the rest. They became deeply emotional regarding the initial heat followed by the refreshing and mouth-watering aftertaste.

title.cn: 关于“爆辣腌渍水果”的留言

content.cn: 我到了工友们休息的地方，正好碰上了吃饭的时间。万尼科夫他们看到我把这几份枢纽区应急餐放到了桌上，显然没想到我会带着这个，直接就围了上来。粗粝扎实的灰芦麦，变幻出了温暖而热烈的颜色。有人细品荞花回甘的妙处，有人惊叹这其貌不扬的面包竟然越嚼越有滋味。对他们来说，现在能尝到枢纽区应急餐，或许是一份意外之趣。
content.en: It was mealtime when I arrived at the crew lounge. Vannikov saw me serving the Hub Emergency Rations. He did not see them coming and immediately pounced on them. Coarse yet wholesome grains of reed rye had been transformed into warm and passionate hues. Some commented on the dash of sweetness offered by buckflowers. Others were astonished at how the unassuming loaf kept tasting better and better with every chew. What had been expected as mere rations turned out to be a genuinely pleasant surprise for the entire crew.

title.cn: 关于“枢纽区应急餐”的留言

content.cn: 简单的美食才更考验制作者的功力。我把这道辣炒肉丁送到了正在值班的波利亚和纽曼手里。波利亚尝过后还专门跑来和我说：“罗曼大叔，鲜辣过瘾啊！”
content.en: Simple dishes will put a chef's skills to the test. I got a serving of Meat Stir-Fry for Polya and Neumann as they were on duty. After trying some, Polya came running over and said: "Uncle Roman, the spiciness is simply exciting!"

content.cn: 我总结了下他们两人的评价：肉香四溢，肥瘦相间，煸得焦韧，苦叶椒的辛辣恰到好处，提味而不“抢戏”，咸香与鲜辣，平衡得当。
content.en: I summarized their reviews: Aroma is rich, the meat is perfectly marbled and seared, and the tartpepper gave just enough heat to enrich the dish without dominating everything else. It was a perfect equilibrium of savoriness and garden spice.

content.cn: 灰芦麦面饼脆甜韧香，肉汁沁润交融，一口下去，仿佛胃里有一片丰饶的麦田。管理员，当我把这道菜交给沙尔金和科里后，他们表现得和我一样，完全没想到在现在的情况下，居然还能品尝到裹着爆汁肉馅的酥皮馅饼，一下就猜到我请了重量级外援。
content.en: Crispy-baked reed rye bread with juicy meat fillings. Take a single bite and you'd think there's a rich field of rye growing in your tummy. Endmin, when I served this to Shargin and Corey, they behaved just like me. None of them expected they'd ever get the chance to bite into a crispy, juicy, meat-filled pie that burst with flavor at the first bite. They at once knew that I had secured the assistance of a mighty legend.

content.cn: “雅各布的遗产”可是我的童年回忆。被热腾腾的高能异香石加工过的灰芦麦粉，做成面包后切成条，在煎锅里稍微处理下，嚼起来咔咔作响……据说是那位大军阀雅各布留下的食谱，但食物就是食物，食物是没过错的。
content.en: "Jakub's Legacy" is part of my childhood memories. Reed rye flour seasoned with sizzling hot energized aggagrit, kneaded, baked, then sliced and lightly pan-fried. Every bite was a resounding crunch... They said the Warlord Jakub left this recipe. But food is food, and food is never wrong.

content.cn: 卡莉她们一听到有好吃的，立马就跑了过来。孩子们被逗得咯咯笑，一会儿说像在吃被晒脆的小树枝，一会儿说暖暖的，像是风在释放源石技艺，然后舔着嘴角说道：“这是四号谷地偷偷塞进碗里的游戏。”
content.en: Carly and the kids came running when they heard about chow. All the young ones were giggling when they had this. They described it like eating dried little twigs, then said it felt warm as though the wind itself was casting the Arts. Finally, they licked their lips and said: "Valley IV got sneaky and placed a little game in my foodie bowl."

title.cn: 关于“雅各布的遗产”的留言

content.cn: 软骨饼干，以前我总是会从节日会场揣几块带回家。我把饼干分享给了莎曼她们，大家一边眯着眼仔细品尝，一边回想起了这几年的历程。聊着聊着，我们就想起了被排在开拓节值班的日子，每当遇到了这种情况，我们就会从节日会场上抓一把软骨饼干捂在怀里，想吃了就摸出来啃上几口……美好的日子仿佛都回来了。
content.en: Cartilage Tack. Back in those days, I would walk away from holiday gatherings with a few pieces in my bag. I shared the tack with Salman's crew. Everyone closed their eyes and reminisced about the taste and the work they did along the way. We remembered the days when we were given Exploration Day shift duties. When that happened, we would sneak out of the party with a handful of Cartilage Tack and grab a few bites whenever hunger crept in... It felt as though the good ol' days had returned.

content.cn: 爆辣焗烤源石虫可是我的最爱，虫肉里裹着苦叶椒的辛辣，辛香直冲头顶……佩吉听说我在分发开拓节特色美食后找了过来，我就把这道美食给了她。布戈尔当然也跟在她身边，但看到我拿出这道美食后直接退了一步。哈哈哈，就他这个胆子，唉。
content.en: The Superhot Slug Gratin is my favorite. Juicy slug wrapped around tartpepper heat. This combination of flavors literally explodes in one's head... Peggy heard I was serving specialties and sought me out. I gave her some of this. Of course, Bugor was right beside her but he took a step back when he saw the Gratin. Hahaha. Pffft, what a little coward.

content.cn: 评委和其他品尝过这道美食的人们一致认为：汤色清亮，锦草和琼叶参的香气与汤韵浑然天成。入口甘醇温润，味道层次分明，一口汤入肚，暖意流转全身。
content.en: The judges and other tasters of this dish have arrived at a unanimous conclusion: The aromas of jincao and redjade ginseng created a natural harmony within this clear infusion. Wholesome, soothing, and possessing a distinct, layered taste, this soup imbued warmth throughout the body.

content.cn: 可惜，美中不足的是，这道作品并没有化解琼叶参入口后的回苦，还加入了一些与琼叶参的药理相斥的辅料来改善汤剂的滋味，药食同源的理念没能在这道汤剂中完美体现。但要是光论在本场比赛里的表现，也确是温补气血的匠心之作。
content.en: However, a flaw existed in this otherwise perfect dish — the stubborn, lingering bitterness of redjade ginseng. The condiments used contradict the herb's pharmaceutical properties. We believe food should be therapeutic, but this dish fell short in that respect. Nevertheless, the infusion remained a revitalizing masterwork.

title.cn: 关于“正本补元汤剂”的留言

content.cn: 评委和其他品尝过这道美食的人们一致认为：这道炒饭是该比赛命题里所有作品的典范！金石稻粒饱满分明，外层泛着炒制后的金黄色，芽针粉末恰到好处地增色提香。
content.en: The judges and other tasters of this dish have arrived at a unanimous conclusion: This plate of fried rice proved exemplary among the other dishes submitted in this cook-off! The stir-fried grains of beautiful amber rice glistened with a golden hue, while powdered yazhen enhanced both the color and aroma of this culinary work.

content.cn: 但不得不说，平常的菜品，往往最能考验厨师的本领。优秀的锦素炒饭，应当能感受到金石稻粒在唇齿间起舞——也或许是制作者希望能达到批量生产的效果，这道菜还是少了那么一缕镬气。
content.en: We must admit that everyday dishes truly put a chef's skills to the test. A fine plate of garden fried rice should be a ballroom of amber grains dancing on the tongue — but our contending chef probably went for a mass-production approach, and the result lacked that kiss of true Wok Hey.

content.cn: 评委和其他品尝过这道美食的人们一致认为：一众参赛作品之中，这道清炖兽排参须汤最能体现调和之妙。兽排酥而不烂，肉质在唇间轻轻一抿便化开，肌理间渗着琥珀色的琼叶参汤。一盏暖汤入肚，恰似在寒冬里给自己披上件柔软的棉衣。
content.en: The judges and other tasters of this dish have arrived at a unanimous conclusion: Among the dishes submitted for this cook-off, this ginseng meat stew best exemplified the delicate nature of harmony. The ribs glistened with the dark hues of redjade ginseng. The texture was soft, gently yielding in the mouth without feeling overcooked. Having a bowl of this hearty stew felt like donning a warm coat in winter.

content.cn: 能看出来的是，制作者在处理琼叶参的苦涩上花了大量功夫，完美去除了苦味，但也去除掉了琼叶参原本应有的甘香，未能守住食材的本味。这道作品，还有进一步提升的空间。
content.en: We could obviously tell that the chef has spent a great deal of effort removing the bitterness of the redjade ginseng. Though the astringent taste was gone, the processing also removed the herb's natural and distinctive aromas. Otherwise, the dish would be perfect.

title.cn: 关于“清炖兽排参须汤”的留言

content.cn: 评委和其他品尝过这道美食的人们一致认为：这道武陵炒饭妙啊，镬气十足啊！金黄油亮的金石稻粒颗颗分明，第一口，我们还以为又是一道锦素炒饭，但紧接着，肉粒便在唇齿间炸开。
content.en: The judges and other tasters of this dish have arrived at a unanimous conclusion: A wondrous plate of Wuling fried rice, its perfect amber rice grains shimmered like gold and brimming with Wok Hey! At first bite, we were misled into thinking that it was just another serving of garden fried rice — until the rich flavors of hearty meat suddenly exploded in our mouths.

content.cn: 只是在食材的搭配与处理上，还有待提高。虽然肉粒弹牙多汁，却未能与炒饭完美结合，一勺炒饭下肚，油腻感便从胃里涌上了咽喉。不过，与其他作品相比，也确实算得上是典范之作。
content.en: More work could be put into the ingredients and processing. The meat cubes were juicy indeed, but they failed to perfectly complement the rice. A single helping was enough to ignite greasy heartburn. Nevertheless, we consider this first-rate culinary work when compared to the other submissions.

content.cn: 评委和其他品尝过这道美食的人们一致认为：这道炝炒时蔬炒制得颇具巧思，新笋脆嫩清甜，芽针粉末柔滑爽口，琼叶参薄片在快火中散发出独特甘香。
content.en: The judges and other tasters of this dish have arrived at a unanimous conclusion: This plate of garden stir-fry was truly creative. The young bamboo sprouts were crunchy, refreshing, and sweet; the powdered yazhen was smooth and soothing; and the redjade ginseng slices unleashed their unique aromas after a quick pass through the heated work.

content.cn: 可惜呀，如果命题是一道“时蔬清炒”，这将会是一道完美的作品。三者在炒锅的串联后，仍能保留各自本味，实属不易，但是缺少了“炝炒时蔬”应该有的鲜香与浓郁，没有“炝炒”应有的滋味，可惜呀。
content.en: Unfortunately, this would have been perfect if the dish were titled "Season's Produce, Simply Skilleted". Keeping the three primary ingredients aromatically distinct was no easy feat, but the product lacked the rich yet refreshing aroma required of a proper Garden Stir-Fry. What a pity.

content.cn: 评委和其他品尝过这道美食的人们一致认为：这道竹笋炒肉制作时的火候掌控绝佳！新笋脆爽清甜，兽肉片滑嫩多汁，两者在猛火快炒中达成完美平衡。新笋吸足肉汁的醇厚，兽肉片又沾染竹笋的清香。
content.en: The judges and other tasters of this dish have arrived at a unanimous conclusion: The chef who prepared this plate of bamboo sprouts and meat knew perfect heat control! The young bamboo sprouts were sweet and crunchy, while the fillet slices were juicy and tender. Quick stir-frying over strong fire perfectly combined the two. The sprouts soaked up the rich gravy as the fillet slices absorbed the refreshing aromas of the bamboo grove.

content.cn: 但在后期处理上，制作者在厨艺上的生疏之处便显露无遗。过多的辅料，也包括琼叶参的香气，盖过了作品原本的风味。若非评委们细细品味，从层层佐料之中，找寻到了那缕山野之鲜与家厨之味，这道作品或许会被其他作品淹没。
content.en: But everything after the stir-frying revealed the chef's shortcomings. Too many condiments were used. The aroma of redjade ginseng also overpowered the flavors of the primary ingredients. The judges really had to work their palates to peel away the distractions before finally arriving at the refreshing tastes of nature and cozy family stoves. In conclusion, this dish felt like a dime a dozen.

title.en: Memo: Regarding the "Bamboo Sprouts and Meat"

content.cn: 虽然评委们对这道作品争论了许久，但经过反复商讨，评委们还是达成了共识：这道最能代表管理员过往记忆的菜品，样式颇有特点，虽无繁复调味，但质地致密而均匀，将能量与风味浓缩于方寸之间，还加入了一种神秘的辅料，给我们带来了从未品尝过的美味，若这份辅料能流入坊间，想必能为武陵城增添更多的美味。
content.en: The judges and other tasters of this dish have, after lengthy deliberation and multiple rounds of discussion, arrived at a unanimous conclusion: This dish is the perfect symbol of the Endministrator's past memories. The presentation was unique. Though only mildly seasoned, the texture was compact and uniform, a package of energy and flavors compressed into ready-to-eat portions. A mysterious condiment was used, lending the rations flavors entirely new to us. If this condiment were made available on the market, it would add plenty of delightful culinary possibilities to Wuling.

content.cn: 可惜的是，其他参赛作品中不乏让人瞠目结舌的作品，而除了那份辅料外，这道作品的口感其实与常见的军用口粮差别不大。
content.en: Unfortunately, the works of other contestants were equally astonishing. This entry also tasted similar to standard military provisions, with the condiments being the only highlight.

content.cn: 第5天，过滤装置的设计漏洞比我想象中还要严重……好在只有我接触到了内容物，这才过了多久，我已经感到大脑开始变得迟钝了……我不能让<@nar.mark>罗普</>也接触到它。这里的实验器材还勉强能用。只要我把漏洞修补好……<@nar.mark>罗普</>，等着我……
content.en: Day 5 - The filtration unit's design flaw is worse than I feared... At least I alone was exposed to the contents. Already, my mind slows like rusted clockwork... I must keep <@nar.mark>Ropp</> from touching it. These battered lab tools will suffice. Just need to patch the breach... <@nar.mark>Hold on, Ropp</>...

content.cn: 第19天，我很难掌握自己现在的身体状况……侵蚀偷走了我的时间……我有时能看到一些影子，像是<@nar.mark>罗普</>，也像是我自己，但当我触碰他们时就会消失殆尽。仿佛那些记忆正在逐渐离我远去……我不想忘记这一切，我修改了保险柜的密码，提醒自己不要忘记自己的责任……还有他……
content.en: Day 19 - I can no longer gauge my own deterioration... The Blight steals time itself. Phantoms flicker at the edges of vision: sometimes <@nar.mark>Ropp</>, sometimes a shadow that might've been me. They dissolve at my touch. My memories bleed away like sieve-held water... I rewrote the safe's code. A failsafe against forgetting: Remember the duty. Remember him.

content.cn:
第173天，我……要做什么来着？对了……处理过滤装置的设计漏洞……但是，为什么呢？想不起来了……这本日记上写了很多事情，试验……还有叫<@nar.mark>罗普</>的人……
设计漏洞似乎已经解决了……那我接下来要做什么呢？
content.en:
Day 173 - I... what was I meant to do? Ah yes. The filtration unit's flaw... but why? The reason slips through my fingers. These pages speak of experiments... someone named <@nar.mark>Ropp</>... 
The schematics seem corrected now. Then what... what remains?

content.cn: 发明领域
content.en: CLASSIFICATION

content.cn: 本发明涉及一种净水设备。特别申明，本发明是具有侵蚀相关物质滤膜和上游污水贮水器的过滤装置。
content.en: Disclosed is a device using a water purification method. Specifically, a Blight material filter membrane and an upstream raw water storage container are used by the filtration device.

content.cn: 发明背景
content.en: BACKGROUND

content.cn: 目前市面上已在大规模应用的续流型稳定碳质和密闭滤膜的中小型过滤装置存在以下问题：低浓度侵蚀物质将会留存于稳定碳质和密闭滤膜之间，这样会阻碍水流正常通过该装置。为此，具有小型蚀质分离阀的过滤装置被研制出来。蚀质分离阀提供了从稳定碳质与滤膜之间的空间到装置外的通路。
content.en: Currently available medium to small continuous flow filtration systems of the prior art used in large scale employ a form of stabilized carbon and a hermetic filter membrane. However, the systems of the prior art have the following issue: low concentrations of Blight matter often remain in the space between the stabilized carbon and the hermetic filter membrane, and cause disruptions to water flow through this device. To solve said issue of the prior art, the application provides a filter device using a small Blight matter separator valve. Said small Blight matter separator valve creates a passage for a fluid to flow from the space between the stabilized carbon and the hermetic filter membrane to outside the purification system.

content.en: MEETING AT PARK 2 NEXT MONTH!

content.cn: 又有一段日子见不到她了……
content.en: Guess I won't be seeing her for a while again...

content.cn: 今天跑出来的数据不太对，也许不能按时休假了……还是尽量坚持一下吧！
content.en: The readings today don't look right. There goes my weekend... I'll just put up with this for a while longer!

content.cn: 深夜才出实验室。今天看不到几颗星星。
content.en: I left the lab really late in the night. Hardly saw any stars today.

content.cn: 突然怀疑，那种所谓的“美好生活”，真的会到来吗？
content.en: I suddenly began to doubt if the beautiful life would ever come true for me.

content.cn: 每天在实验室里昏天黑地地拉磨，实在太累了……
content.en: I spent countless days and nights slogging in the lab. I'm working myself to the bone...

content.cn: 好在离见面的里程碑不远了。加油！！
content.en: Thank goodness our milestone meeting is coming up. Keep it up!!

content.cn: 今天去二号园区开会，没有去找她。但当我来到熟悉的地方时，她仍在等着我……
content.en: I had a meeting at Park 2 today and didn't seek her out. But when I passed by that familiar place, she was still there, waiting for me.

content.cn: 人们面对感动的事物时，突然哑口无言的现象，叫什么来着？
content.en: What's that word again for describing that speechless feeling you get when seeing something moving?

content.cn: 她在灯光下远远地望着我……微笑着。
content.en: She just stood in the distance beneath the light ... and smiled as she gazed at me.

content.cn: 项目结束以后，我会把该说的话都告诉她。
content.en: Once the project is over, I'll tell her everything that needs to be said.

content.cn: 她说，她会等我。
content.en: She said she'll wait for me.

content.cn: 我听说……
content.en: I heard...

content.cn: 事情过去这么久了，我还是无法接受。
content.en: It's been a while already, but I still couldn't force myself to accept this.

content.cn: 这个冬天长得要命。
content.en: When will this blighted winter end?

content.cn: 我真的……
content.en: I'm really...

content.cn: 今天四号谷地的调职信来了。这里的一切都让我痛苦得想要尖叫，我要离开这里，我要开始新的生活……
content.en: The Valley IV re-assignment letter arrived. Everything at this blighted place cuts like razor and hurts like hell. I just want to leave this place and start a new life...

content.cn: 讽刺的是，他们选中我的理由，还是因为小美。
content.en: Funny thing is, Masie was the reason why they chose me.

content.cn: 就好像她在送我离开一样。
content.en: It feels as though she's the one who got me sent away.

content.cn: 属于那位信使的空白信纸，带着淡淡的酸橙味。它将会被写上什么样的内容，又会被寄往何方呢？
content.en: A blank letter belonging to that messenger, faintly scented with sour lime. What message will it bear, and where will it go?

title.en: Engravings on the frozen river banks

content.cn: <@nar.center>火中的巨物啊——</>
content.en: <@nar.center>O colossus wreathed in flame —</>

content.cn: <@nar.center>你曾狂奔，烈焰如潮；</>
content.en: <@nar.center>You once raced across the earth, tides of fire in your wake;</>

content.cn: <@nar.center>你曾毁灭，万邦俱寂；</>
content.en: <@nar.center>You once wrought ruin, as kingdoms fell silent;</>

content.cn: <@nar.center>你曾高踞王座之巅，不服者，皆堕为焦炭。</>
content.en: <@nar.center>You once perched atop the throne of embers. All who defied you turned to ash.</>

content.cn: <@nar.center>灰烬散于雪原，昭示熔岩不熄。</>
content.en: <@nar.center>Cinders drift over the snowfields, a testament that the magma never dies.</>

content.cn: <@nar.center>我等虔诚信徒，跪于灰烬之上，于寒夜呼唤：</>
content.en: <@nar.center>We, your devoted, kneel upon these ashes, calling through the frozen night:</>

content.cn: <@nar.center>愿你从沉睡中苏醒，再度以灼世之名，清洗世间；</>
content.en: <@nar.center>Awaken from slumber, and once again scour the world in searing glory;</>

content.cn: <@nar.center>愿上古之炎重燃，让信仰与毁灭并存，永照万世。</>
content.en: <@nar.center>Let the ancient fires reignite. May faith and devastation endure as one, and illuminate the ages.</>

content.cn: <@nar.center>寒风吹灭星火</>
content.en: <@nar.center>Boreal wind snuffs out the last ember</>

content.cn: <@nar.center>战士的生命归于枯萎</>
content.en: <@nar.center>The warrior's life fades into withering silence</>

content.cn: <@nar.center>漆黑的树枝</>
content.en: <@nar.center>Charred branches</>

content.cn: <@nar.center>被积雪一层复一层地埋葬</>
content.en: <@nar.center>Lie buried, layer upon layer, beneath the relentless snow</>

content.cn: <@nar.center>来人步履蹒跚，眼眸闪烁着渴望。</>
content.en: <@nar.center>The figure staggers forward, eyes ablaze with yearning.</>

content.cn: <@nar.center>他伸出手，将剑紧紧握住——</>
content.en: <@nar.center>He reaches out, seizing the blade —</>

content.cn: <@nar.center>火沿着手臂攀爬，灼入皮肉，熔为一体。</>
content.en: <@nar.center>Fire climbs his arm, searing into flesh, merging with his form.</>

content.cn: <@nar.center>焚身之焰燃起，前所未见的力量涌入躯体。</>
content.en: <@nar.center>Flames of sacrifice ignite, unseen power flooding his veins.</>

content.cn: <@nar.center>仇敌在脚下哀嚎，化为匍匐的薪柴。</>
content.en: <@nar.center>Foes wail at his feet, reduced to prostrate kindling.</>

content.cn: <@nar.center>他以为支配了火，可火从不真正属于他。</>
content.en: <@nar.center>He believed he mastered the flame, yet fire has never been truly his to command.</>

content.cn: <@nar.center>沉睡的意志悄然苏醒，浸染躯壳，篡夺心智。</>
content.en: <@nar.center>A slumbering will stirs, seeping into limb and mind, usurping all.</>

content.cn: <@nar.center>当烈焰燃尽，持剑者颓然倒地，仅余劫灰。</>
content.en: <@nar.center>When the inferno fades, the wielder falls, only embers remaining.</>

content.cn: <@nar.center>残火渐熄，利剑蛰伏于冰冷的岩石，无声低鸣。</>
content.en: <@nar.center>Dying cinders cool, the blade lies dormant on cold stone, humming a silent dirge.</>

content.cn: <@nar.center>一切重归沉寂，静候下一个他的到来。</>
content.en: <@nar.center>All returns to silence, awaiting the next arrival.</>

content.cn: ……萨米北部区域报告邪魔活动，异象持续三日后突遭高热焚灭。据目击者称，一名挥舞火焰大剑的少女曾现身林间，所过之处邪魔尽数成灰。目前其身份不明……
content.en: ...Northern Sami reports demon activity. Phenomena lasted three days before sudden high-temperature incineration. Witnesses claim a girl wielding a flaming greatsword appeared in the woods, reducing all demons to ash. Her identity remains unknown...

content.en: ...After thorough investigation, the cause of the recent emergency at Bellony Village's mine has been confirmed. Officials state the incident was triggered by Originium slugs. The affected mine is now fully sealed, and the situation is under control. Specialist teams are addressing residual risks to prevent secondary disasters...

content.cn: 紧张的呼叫者：如果有人能收到这段紧急呼叫，请在这个频道上回应。我们已经失去了和门<@nar.mark>那边</>……和泰拉的所有联系，主通道被外力切断了。
content.en: Panicked Caller: If you receive this emergency call, please respond on this frequency! We can't call <@nar.mark>beyond</> the Gate ... we've lost touch with Terra! The main channel has been severed!

content.cn: 紧张的呼叫者：<@nar.mark>Σ</>区遭到的袭击比我们预想的严重，现在连中心控制室都失去了联络。那里可能已经……全毁了。
content.en: Panicked Caller: The attack on Sector <@nar.mark>Σ</> is far worse than we expected. Central Control has gone dark. The entire place is probably ... destroyed.

content.cn: 紧张的呼叫者：我们试图封锁通道，但是根本不起效果。那些<@nar.mark>东西</>……淹没了整个楼层。我们的人一个接一个地消失……
content.en: Panicked Caller: We tried to seal the passage, but nothing worked. Those <@nar.mark>things</> ... flooded the entire floor. Our people kept disappearing...

content.cn: 紧张的呼叫者：告诉其他人，比起<@nar.mark>我们</>真正的敌人，天使根本不值得恐惧。
content.en: Panicked Caller: Tell the others! Our <@nar.mark>real</> enemies are ... far more terrifying than the Aggeloi.

content.cn: <@nar.center>萨卡兹，无根之人，背负诅咒的族裔。</>
content.en: <@nar.center>Sarkaz. A nation accursed. A people without roots.</>

content.cn: <@nar.center>在这被源石扭曲的世界，我们命中注定一无所有。</>
content.en: <@nar.center>We are fated to have nothing in a world twisted by Originium.</>

content.cn: <@nar.center>鲜血与战火反复浸润的土地，将一次次被毁灭。</>
content.en: <@nar.center>In the Land soaked by blood and war, we have been ordained to face one destruction after another.</>

content.cn: <@nar.center>我们没有故乡，因为它已经重归荒芜。</>
content.en: <@nar.center>We no longer have a home, for home has given way to barren desolation.</>

content.cn: 忧心忡忡的男性：再哭，夜里就会有温迪戈过来把你吃掉。
content.en: Worried Man: Stop crying already. Otherwise a Wendigo will appear in the night and eat you up.

content.cn: 温柔的女性：别吓唬她了。明天是她生日，但她从小到大还没有见过外面的天空呢。
content.en: Gentle Woman: Don't scare her like that. It's her birthday tomorrow. She hasn't seen the outside world before.

content.cn: 忧心忡忡的男性：等她成年，这里或许能重新见到太阳。
content.en: Worried Man: Once she gets older, the sun might shine over this place again.

content.cn: 忧心忡忡的男性：但现在……对不起，我的挚爱。
content.en: Worried Man: But now...? I'm sorry, my love.

content.cn: 焦急的女性：内战爆发了，战火很快就会蔓延到这里。
content.en: Anxious Woman: Civil war has erupted, and the fighting's spreading here.

content.cn: 忧心忡忡的男性：我知道……他们开始清算了……连孩子都难以幸免……
content.en: Worried Man: I know... They're settling the old scores ... and the children might not be spared...

content.cn: 忧心忡忡的男性：这里还需要我来铸造兵器，但我们的孩子……
content.en: Worried Man: They need me to forge their weapons. But our child...

content.cn: 焦急的女性：她还那么小！即便我们无法逃离这场灾难，也要为她……
content.en: Anxious Woman: She's so young! We might not be able to avoid this disaster, but for her sake...

content.en: No fighting with the LBs in the Stockade. Violators will be severely punished.

content.cn: 孩子，与裂地者合作就是和野兽为伍，就算是要向武陵复仇，也是靠咱们自己才算痛快。
content.en: Son, working with the LBs is like frolicking with the beasts. If you want vengeance against Wuling, we should rely on our own strength to make it a fight to remember.

content.cn: 听我一句劝，将他们尽早赶出去吧，咱们还有时间，还能慢慢筹谋。
content.en: Please heed this old man's words. Chase those pipefaces out of our Stockade. Quickly. We still have time to plan and prepare.

title.en: Uncle Shang's Letter to Ruan Yi

content.cn: 孩子……孩子……
content.en: My boy... My poor boy...

content.cn: 你一走，把什么都留给活的人……一寨子的人，满肚子的恨。
content.en: You left. You left us amongst the living ... an entire Stockade filled with nothing but rage and hate.

content.cn: 罢了，罢了……如果这就是你想要的，那我便为你再拼一回老命。
content.en: The blight take me... If this is what you want, then this old man shall fight till his final breath.

content.cn: 没想到汤汤会把那伙人直接带进寨子。
content.en: I never expected Tangtang to bring those people into the Stockade directly.

content.cn: 在景玉谷见第一面我就知道，那伙人是阿达希尔提到过的“终末地”……
content.en: I knew from our first meeting at Jingyu Valley. They're "Endfielders" that Ardashir mentioned...

content.cn: 我很感激那些人帮了寨子，但我们终究不是同路人。
content.en: I'm grateful that they helped the Stockade, but we're not the same.

content.cn: 我很担心，终末地会坏了我的计划。
content.en: I fear that Endfield will get in the way of my plan.

content.cn: 武陵科考站尝试遏制甚大裂隙扩张失败，天师伤亡惨重，周边大面积区域受侵蚀潮影响，也出现临时性物资短缺。
content.en: The personnel of the Wuling Science Station failed in their attempt to contain the expansion of the Very Large Rift. The Tianshi took major casualties. Large areas nearby are now affected by the Blight Tide. A temporary shortage of supplies has been reported.

content.cn: 重建科考站时期，清波寨寨民为求生存，尝试在一个能见度极低的雨夜抢夺重建物资，与我方发生正面冲突。
content.en: While rebuilding the Science Station, residents of Qingbo Stockade who are desperate for survival attempted to raid reconstruction supplies. Our forces were directly attacked during a rainy night of very poor visibility.

content.cn: 天师慌乱中失手使用雷法，造成清波寨人员伤亡。后经确认，牺牲者中包括清波寨重要头目。
content.en: In a state of panic, the Tianshi accidentally unleashed the Thunder Arts and inflicted casualties upon the Stockade residents. Key leaders of the Stockade have been identified among those killed.

content.cn: 后续，我方多次尝试弥合关系无果，只能通过特殊渠道向清波寨提供物资支援。
content.en: After the incident, we made many forays to mend our relationship with the Stockade but achieved little. A special channel is our only way to supply the Stockade with resources.

content.cn: 阮哥，你说得对……
content.en: Big Bro, you're right...

content.cn: 这十年来，寨子里不少人都快忘记，或者说，“选择”忘记当年的仇。
content.en: During the past ten years, many of the Stockade Fam could hardly remember... Maybe I should say they "chose" to forget the debt of blood.

content.cn: 但不该忘，也不能忘！
content.en: We cannot forget! We MUST NOT forget!

content.cn: 放心，有你帮忙瞒着大当家，她根本没发现我们的计划。
content.en: Don't worry. You kept our plan well hidden from the Supreme Chief. She knows nothing about it.

content.cn: 想报仇，就不可能没有伤亡！
content.en: Sacrifice must be made to achieve vengeance!

content.cn: 大伙儿都是下定了决心的人，事到如今，不必再留退路。
content.en: We're determined to see this through! Retreat is no longer necessary.

content.cn: 至于没有这份念头的人，不要为难他们。
content.en: Do not make things difficult for fellow Fam who don't want to be part of this.

content.cn: 先集中关起来，免得他们和裂地者再起冲突，反倒伤了性命。
content.en: Just round them up and throw them in the cages. Don't let them fight the breakers and hurt themselves.

content.cn: 商叔，我清楚阿达希尔目的不单纯，也清楚迎裂地者进寨子会有什么结果。
content.en: Uncle Shang, I know very well that Ardashir has his own plans. I also know what would happen if the breakers are allowed into our Stockade.

content.cn: 但我不后悔，你也不应该后悔。
content.en: But I do not regret my decision, and neither should you.

content.cn: 血债血偿，我们遭受过的，武陵人也会一一受过。
content.en: Blood for blood. The Wulingers shall taste every bit of our immense suffering.

title.en: Ruan Yi's Letter to Uncle Shang

content.cn: 一旦做出决定，我心里清楚，以后的日子就不多了。
content.en: I know very well that once the decision is made, there won't be many days left for me.

content.cn: 可汤汤，她怎么办……寨子一旦分裂，她怎么办？
content.en: But what about Tangtang...? What will happen to her if the Stockade splinters?

content.cn: 留在寨子？这些年一直有人不服她大当家的位置，她能处理好这些吗？
content.en: Will she stay? It's been years but plenty of people secretly refused to accept her as their Chief. Can she handle them?

content.cn: 离开寨子？她一个人能去哪里？会有兄弟姐妹追随她吗？
content.en: Can she leave the Stockade? But where could she go on her own? Will any of the Fam follow her?

content.cn: 我该怎么办……
content.en: What should I do...?

content.cn: （上面的内容已被涂抹，但勉强可以辨认出有一句是“若我离开，寨内大小事务一律交由大当家汤汤”。）
content.en: (Most of the contents had been crossed out, but a few words remain legible. "If I were no longer around, Supreme Chief Tangtang shall have sole discretion regarding all Stockade-related affairs."

content.cn: 伸出手就能碰到星星，闭上眼就能藏身于云层。
content.en: Stretch out your hand and you'll touch the stars. Just close your eyes and you'll snuggle in the clouds.

content.cn: 被云朵或是繁星包裹，任何烦心事都会被抛之脑后吧。
content.en: It doesn't matter if it's a blanket of clouds or stars. It'll dispel your troubles and send them far away.

content.cn: 森林中藏着无尽的秘宝，谁也不知道下一个出现的会是怎样的惊喜。
content.en: Infinite treasure lay within the forest. Nobody knows what the next surprise will be.

content.cn: 凶猛的牙兽？嬉闹的羽兽？抑或是……一条清澈的小溪？
content.en: A ferocious tuskbeast? Or a naughty fowl? Perhaps you'll find ... a clean, bedazzling creek.

content.cn: 你在渴望一场危机四伏的交易？还是一夜暴富的机遇？
content.en: Do you wish for a dangerous deal? Or a chance to become instantly rich?

content.cn: 在这里你可能会得到一切，也可能会失去一切！
content.en: This is where you might seize a fortune, or lose everything you have.

title.en: A Room Resembling an Underground Market

content.cn: 这是留给你们的礼物。
content.en: This is a gift for you.

content.cn: 这是我的矿场……不，这是我们的矿场。
content.en: My ... no. It's our mine.

content.cn: 从我记事起，这片矿场就像我的家一样。父亲母亲，亲切的叔叔阿姨。我的人生绝大多数的时间都在这里度过，我从未想过有一天会离开这里。
content.en: The mine has been my home, ever since my childhood. My parents, uncles, and aunts worked here. I spent nearly every moment of my life here. I never thought I would leave the mine.

content.cn: 但……当“星体”降临，一切都被毁了……
content.en: But ... "Astarron" came ... and destroyed everything.

content.cn: 这里只剩下我一个人……我不想离开这里……工团决定将这里废弃。或许对他们来说，这里只是一个矿场，但……这里是我的家。
content.en: I was the only one left... I didn't want to leave, but ... the UW has decided to abandon the site. Maybe they just treated this as just another mine ... but this is my home.

content.cn: 我在这里生活了很久……我以为这样的日子会持续更久，直到自己和亲人们埋在一起。
content.en: I lived here for years ... and I thought those days would go on till they bury me here with my kin.

content.cn: 但……你们出现了。你们像是一束光一样，照进了这幽邃的地下。带着你们参观矿场的时候，我好像又看到了过去，工人叔叔带着我看过一样的地方……
content.en: Then ... you appeared. Sparkling beams of light that illuminated the dark underworld. When I led you on a tour around the mine, I saw my own childhood when a crew mate showed me the very same places...

content.cn: 对着生锈的起重机，你们称它为“机械城”。看着破碎的矿车，你们称其为“战舰”。
content.en: You called the rusty crane as "Machine Town", and the broken mine carts became your "Battleships".

content.cn: 我已经不知道多久没有和他人一起笑过了，看着你们幻想地面是滚烫的岩浆，给“勇者之路”命名，不知为何，心口那如同被重物压迫着的感觉一扫而空了。
content.en: I don't know when was the last time I smiled. When you fantasized about the floor being super hot lava and named the "Trail of the Brave", that ponderous weight pressed against my chest was lifted. Gone for good.

content.cn: 看着你们，我觉得似乎外面的世界也同样蕴藏着美好……
content.en: The very sight of you made me feel that the outside world is just as beautiful...

content.cn: 我打算走了，我想出去看看。这也是我的父母曾经留下的嘱托。这么多年，我一直没能鼓起勇气。
content.en: Thus I have decided to leave, to see what is going on outside. It was my parents' wish. I just lacked the courage to follow it through all this time.

content.cn: 走之前，我会把这里变成你们想象中的样子。别看我有时候不太靠谱，但我可是个经验丰富的矿井工人。
content.en: However, before I depart, I shall transform the place to your fantasies. I may behave like an unreliable tramp at times, but I remain a highly experienced worker of the mining shafts.

content.cn: 这里是我曾经的家，现在，我想把它作为礼物送给你们。
content.en: This used to be my home. Now I hope I can present it to you as a gift.

content.cn: 谢谢你们把光带给了我。
content.en: Thank you for bringing the light to me.

content.cn: 铁血柔情的守护者——弭弗
content.en: Mi Fu — Stalwart defender with ferrium blood and a gentle soul

content.cn: 提起巡卫队队长弭弗，无人不心生敬意与信赖。
content.en: The name of Watchguard Captain Mi Fu naturally evokes great respect and trust amongst the people.

content.cn: 在武陵城还是一片沼泽与工地时，她便成为了我们的一员，直到如今成长为巡卫队的支柱。她是武陵城最锋利的矛，也是最坚固的盾。无论天师外出勘探，职农春耕秋收，还是商旅往来跋涉，只要有警情，她总是第一时间出现在需要的地方，冷静地发号施令，干净利落地解决威胁。
content.en: She joined us when Wuling was nothing more than a construction site in the middle of the marshes. She has risen to become a pillar of our dependable watchguards. She is the sharpest lance of Wuling, and its most unbreakable shield. Whenever Mi Fu receives an alert raised by Tianshi surveying the lands, by farmers conducting the spring sowing or autumn harvests, or by traveling merchants on the road, she responds at once. She always shows up where she is needed most, issues orders with serene calm, and eliminates every threat with quick efficiency.

content.cn: 弭弗不仅是一位英勇的巡卫，更是一位卓越的队长。训练场上，她教巡卫们出拳如风，擒敌如电。在街坊之间，她又是一位懂人情的调停者，在处理城内日常琐事时兼具耐心和决断。方兴衢商户间的争执，邻里的小摩擦，总能被她巧妙化解，令人心服口服。
content.en: Mi Fu is not just a courageous watchguard. She is also an exemplary captain. The training field is where she instructs the watchguards to strike like lightning and seize the foe like a thunderbolt. The avenues and streets are where she arbitrates with great wisdom. She has shown remarkable patience and decisiveness in handling the daily chores of city management. Whether it is disputes between Fangxing Avenue storekeepers or altercations between neighbors, Mi Fu has always resolved matters in a way that left everyone satisfied.

content.cn: 她的身影，是武陵城安定的象征。孩子们望着她飒爽的英姿，常常眼含憧憬地说：“长大了，我也要成为弭弗姐姐那样威风又厉害的人！”弭弗，以她的忠诚、勇毅与智慧，赢得了全城上下发自内心的爱戴。
content.en: Her presence is the symbol of peace in Wuling. The children look upon her dashing panache with great admiration. "I wanna be strong and powerful like Miss Mi Fu when I grow up!" With her loyalty, courage, and wisdom, Mi Fu has truly won the heartfelt love of the entire city.

content.cn: 弭弗队长在，我们心里就特别踏实，晚上睡觉都安稳。
content.en: We feel safe with Captain Mi Fu around. I can finally sleep at night.

content.en: <@nar.center>Mi Fu: The Indomitable Guardian of the Tianshi Pillar Array</>

content.cn: 当规模前所未见的侵蚀潮涌向武陵城，天使、裂地者……他们在聂菲斯的率领下，冲向天师桩阵列。一时间，阵列危急，如果敌人突破到城内，后果将不堪设想。
content.en: When a Blight Tide of unprecedented scale surged towards Wuling City, an army of Aggeloi and Landbreakers led by Nefarith charged towards the Tianshi Pillar Array. There was a moment when the situation hung by a thread. If the enemy were to breach the defenses and enter the city, the results would be disastrous.

content.cn: 是弭弗带领巡卫们硬生生顶住了敌人一波又一波的疯狂冲击，从来没有离开过战线一步。巡卫们在她的号令下重整阵型，一次次击退敌人。当战友们伤痕累累，是她孤身向前，以血肉之躯挥拳，像一面铁壁，挡在进犯者的面前。
content.en: It was Mi Fu and her watchguards who held back wave after wave of relentless enemy charges. No one abandoned their posts and the line held. Mi Fu's command kept them in formation and defeated every enemy assault. And when all her comrades were wounded and spent, Mi Fu charged into the battle alone and swung her fists. She was the ferrium bulwark that held the attackers at bay.

content.cn: 有她在，阵列就在！
content.en: So long as she stands, so shall the Array!

content.cn: 城外血战，护住的不仅是阵列，更是我们所有人的家园。正因她自始至终的坚守，我们才能合力完成对聂菲斯的致胜一击……
content.en: The hard battle fought outside the city protected more than just the Array. It kept our homes safe. Her undying devotion was the reason we were able to unite as one and unleash the victorious strike upon Nefarith...

content.cn: 受访人：<@qu.key>菲利普</>
content.en: RESPONDENT: <@qu.key>Philip</>

content.cn: 来访事由：工作委托
content.en: PURPOSE OF VISIT: Submission of a job order

content.cn: （记录下方附有字迹潦草的笔记）
content.en: (A few words have been scribbled below this entry)

content.cn: 这个萨卡兹名字有点陌生，应该是外来人员。最近是敏感时期，联络塞什卡的人核对一下。
content.en: The name of this Sarkaz isn't familiar to me. The guy probably came from another region. These are troubled times, so please call Seš'qa and verify his identity.

content.cn: 塞什卡希望能提供此人的相貌特征，问问当天值班的人。
content.en: Seš'qa hopes we can provide descriptions of this individual's physical and facial features. Maybe we should ask the person on the shift.

content.cn: 五个人，居然没一个记得这个查尔的长相？
content.en: We asked five crew mates. None of them remembered the looks of this Char.

content.cn: 见鬼。
content.en: Serious?

content.cn: 别忘记我们的名字，别忘记我们的愿望。我们不该屈从于聂菲斯。
content.en: Do not forget our name. Do not forget our dreams. We kneel to no one, especially not Nefarith.

content.cn: 撕裂大地，撕裂文明环带的谎言，建立我们理想的家园，停止那无止境、无休止的痛苦……
content.en: Break the land apart and tear asunder the falsehood of the Civilization Band. Raise the homeland of our dreams, and finally put to rest the incessant and endless suffering...

title.en: Records: A Page Torn from a Book

content.cn: 羽兽在啄食腐烂的身躯
content.en: Fowls peck at the rotten corpse

content.cn: 利嘴撕开每道扭结的血管
content.en: Knotted veins torn by razor beaks

content.cn: 以此分割你与我的灵魂
content.en: Ripping apart our bonded souls

content.cn: 死者沿着红宝石的桥顺流而下
content.en: The body flowing down ruby bridge

content.cn: 坠入古老的罪愆
content.en: Fallen into an ancient sin

content.cn:
预言，源自古老的萨卡兹巫术，贯穿了这一种族的历史……
回顾过去，那些破碎的图景昭示的似乎总是灾难与厄运。
content.en:
Prophecy, based on ancient Sarkazian witchcraft that permeates the entire history of this race...
In retrospect, these shattered images seem to be portents of disasters and ill fortune.

content.cn: “一对兄弟在注定的分离之后，终将再会。届时，血海会消弭一切……”
content.en: "Brothers destined to separate, but reunion will be their fate. Upon the moment dictated, a blood sea shall wash it all away..."

content.cn: 这个疑似暗示了“同族相弑”的不祥预言，就曾在血魔之间广为流传，甚至被看成是一段必定发生的“命运”。
content.en: A prophecy of ill portent that hints at an "internecine war". There was a time when the Vampires could not stop talking about it. Many even regarded it as an inevitable "fate".

content.cn: 但预言是否就一定会成真呢？而知晓预言者又是否难以违抗所谓的“命运”呢？或许除了当事人无人能知道最终的答案。
content.en: Will this prophecy be fulfilled? Will those who learn of it be able to resist their "fate"? Perhaps only those affected by it will find the final answer.

content.cn: 就如这个血魔的预言，一样还有一段难辨真伪的后续——
content.en: Regarding this prophecy about the Vampires, it is also followed by a stanza that cannot be proven —

content.cn: “而血海之后仍有新的血海，血与火的追逐永无止尽，直至他们再会于下一个光暗交汇的时刻……”
content.en: "A new blood sea will emerge, an endless chase of fire and carnage. Till the hour they meet again, the hour when light and dark mixes..."

content.cn: （文章下方是手写的缭乱字迹）
content.en: (Barely legible scribbles have been written at the bottom of this passage)

content.cn: “预言”说我们两人终将再会，到那时，<@qu.key>血海会消弭一切……</>
content.en: The "prophecy" says the two of us will meet again, and when that happens, <@qu.key>a blood sea shall wash it all away...</>

content.cn: 血海。消弭。
content.en: Sea of blood. One that washes away.

content.cn: <@qu.key>同族相弑，一人独活。</>
content.en: <@qu.key>The kin shall slaughter each other, and only one shall remain standing.</>

content.cn: 多么符合塞什卡传统的解释，不是吗？
content.en: A perfect explanation that is in line with the traditions of Seš'qa, isn't it?

content.cn: 若这是既定的命运，那就让我诅咒这一切。
content.en: If fate has been ordained, then let me bring a curse upon everything.

content.cn: 诅咒这预言，诅咒这块容许它成真的歇脚地，诅咒……所有视它为“未来”的人。
content.en: Curse this prophecy. Curse the Stop that allows it to take root and grow. And curse ... everyone who treats it as our "future".

content.cn: 直到血海蔓延到整个塔卫二为止，我将一直诅咒下去。
content.en: I shall curse everything till the sea of blood seeps and floods every inch of Talosian soil.

content.cn: （一份关于泰拉历史人物的读物，这一页被折了角）
content.en: (A reading material about notable individuals from the history of Terra; the corner of a particular page has been folded to mark it.)

content.cn: 杜卡雷，“君主之红”
content.en: Duq'arael, "Regent's Crimson"

content.cn: 在遥远的泰拉，他曾是萨卡兹血魔王庭之主。根据记载，他因不满兄长丹索的决策，选择亲手杀死丹索，侵吞“提卡兹之血”。
content.en: In distant Terra, Duq'arael was once the Sanguinarch of the Crimson Court. According to records, he was displeased with his older brother Danso's decisions and chose to murder the latter and usurp the "Blood of Teekaz".

content.cn: 然而他未能如愿成为魔王。这位王庭之主的结局是……
content.en: However, he failed to become the King of Sarkaz. The Sanguinarch's end...

content.cn: （潦草的手写体）提神醒脑！
content.en: (Messy handwriting) Very invigorating!

content.cn: 炎国民间，有种诞生自“杂念”的秽物，非妖非鬼，其形无定。
content.en: There is a Yanese tale of unclean beings created by "distractions". Such beings are neither demon nor phantoms, and lack a permanent form.

content.cn: 入夜后，秽物入梦，悄然蚕食宿主的灵识记忆，导致宿主非毒非疾，神殒而亡。
content.en: When night falls, these unclean beings would secretly feed on the sentient subconsciousness and memories of their hosts. And thus, without any signs of poisoning or ailment, the hosts would die as their minds fade away.

content.cn: （潦草又慌乱的手写体）吓死了，下次提神还是喝咖啡吧。
content.en: (Messy scribbles that convey fear) WHAT THE HELL! I should stick to coffee to stay awake next time.

title.en: Strange Yanese Tales of the Supernatural

content.cn: 《秘仪·引魂卷》
content.en: Ritual: Scroll of Spirit Calling

content.cn: 若灵魂困于梦境深渊，寻一处古木环绕的空地依序搭设祭坛。
content.en: If the spirit is trapped in the depths of the dream, find an open place surrounded by ancient trees and raise shrines accordingly.

content.cn: 三处祭坛相互连接，形成通道，破开虚实之间的障壁，使寻觅者窥见梦境，使迷失者得见出口。
content.en: The three shrines are connected to one another, thereby creating a channel that breaches the barrier between dreamscape and reality. The opening lets the seeker peer into dreams, and lets the lost see a way out.

content.cn: 仪式期间，严禁任何生灵跨越此环……
content.en: During the ritual, no living being is allowed to cross the ring...

title.cn: 经过提弗洛斯翻译的手稿

content.cn: ……安装此升级套件后，能大幅提升协议核心对其所辖区域内设备的整合与控制效率。
content.en: ...Installing this upgrade kit greatly improves the integration and efficiency of the PAC and all facilities under its control.

content.cn: 同时，支持配置更多、更复杂的生产与物流供应链，减少运转时的调配冲突与资源浪费……
content.en: This allows the deployment of additional production lines and the capacity for supporting higher tier manufacturing and supply logistics. Conflicts during operational allocations and resource wastage will also be reduced...

content.cn: ……希望与宏山科学院共同建立并维护一条专用于运输息壤及其相关设备的路线。
content.en: ...the aim is to work with HAS to deploy and maintain an exclusive route for transporting Xiranite and its associated infrastructure.

content.cn: 通过这条“生命线”，缓解联盟工团面临的裂隙危机……
content.en: This lifeline will alleviate the problems of dangerous rifts that the UWST is currently facing...

content.en: <image>Reading/reading_c34m_forestmap</image>

content.cn: 粗糙的笔触绘出了林地的大致形貌，林中有三处符号标记，不知何意。
content.en: A crudely illustrated map of the forest. Three locations have been marked on this map. The meaning of the markings are unknown.

title.cn: 绘在墙壁上的林地地图
title.en: Wall Drawing: Map of the Forest

content.cn: <image>Reading/reading_c34m_forestmap</image>
content.en: <image>Reading/reading_c34m_forestmap</image>

content.cn: 粗糙的笔触绘出了林地的大致形貌，地图上三个符号标记，代表了林中分设的三处祭坛。
content.en: A crudely illustrated map of the forest. Three locations have been marked on the map to identify the three shrines in the forest.

title.cn: 绘在墙壁上的林地地图
title.en: Wall Drawing: Map of the Forest

content.cn: 这是第十七次，也是最后一次。
content.en: This is the seventeenth attempt. And the last one.

content.cn: 我按照记载，在林中布下祭坛，无数次割破手指，用鲜血浸润雪地，只求能听到祂的呼吸。
content.en: I followed the records and created the shrines in the forest. Countless times I've cut my fingers and moistened the snow with my blood just to hear Him breathe.

content.cn: 我以为在那层薄薄的屏障后，祂的眼睛正寻找回家的路。
content.en: I thought His eyes are still searching for a way home behind the gossamer veil.

content.cn: 但什么也没有，我什么也感知不到……
content.en: But there is nothing. I can't sense anything...

content.cn: 我已经老得快看不见了……我想走了。祭坛，符文，仪式……我已经没有心力了。
content.en: I am so old that my sight is failing ... I want to leave. The shrines, the runes, and the rituals... I no longer have the strength to sustain them.

content.cn: 如果有人在多年后发现这本笔记，请不要嘲笑我的懦弱。至少这样我还能在彻底看不见前……再看一眼黑森林与冬牙群山。
content.en: If anyone were to discover my notes, please do not scoff at my weakness. At least I could steal a last glance of Myrkwood and Wintertooth Mountains ... before I went completely blind.

content.cn: 又失败了……
content.en: It failed again...

content.cn: 通道再次打开，无数巫术造物进入其中，但仍然一无所获。
content.en: The channel was reopened. Numerous witchcraft spawns entered but nothing was found.

content.cn: 我知道这具身体已撑不过这个冬夜，咳出的血浸润了脚下的土地。
content.en: I knew my body wouldn't survive this winter. Blood came up when I coughed and it soaked the earth beneath my feet.

content.cn: 但我不会走。
content.en: But I will not leave.

content.cn: 我死也要死在这里，用我的骨头做箭支，用我的残魂做灯火……扫清障碍，点亮路途……
content.en: I shall die here. If you find me, turn my bones into arrows and my spirit into lamp fire... Purge the obstacles ... and light the way...

content.cn: 后来的人……若你捡到这本笔记，求求你，接替我。
content.en: If anyone were to ... pick up this diary, I beg you to complete what I've started.

content.cn: 为祂寻找一条回家的路。
content.en: Help Him find a way home.

content.cn: 《秘仪·入魂卷》
content.en: Ritual: Scroll of Spirit Diving

content.cn: 三座祭坛彼此分立，不过窥见梦境中的倒影。
content.en: The three shrines have been established, but only offer a glimpse of the dreamscape's reflection.

content.cn: 另设三座祭坛，以入梦者额前发丝或眉毛为引，可将三坛力量合而为一，寻觅者方能真正坠入梦境深渊。
content.en: Another three shrines must be set up. The dream diver's brows can be used as the inducing agent to unite the powers of all three shrines. This will allow the seeker to dive straight to the depths of dreamscape.

content.cn: 只是，通道可开，归途难寻……
content.en: Opening the channel is one thing, but the path of return will be hard to seek...

content.cn: 洁尔佩塔发来的一张照片，定格了她与管理员在这片澄澈的天空中共同留下的回忆，犹如告别时拂过两人脸颊的晚风般，如此温柔而轻盈。
content.en: A photo you received from Gilberta. It captured the moment she shared with you under the clear skies. Memories of it felt like the gentle evening breeze that brushed against your cheeks.

content.cn: “今天没有悲伤的事。”
content.en: "No Sad Stuff Today."

content.cn: <image>Reading/collection_e1m7_1</image>
content.en: <image>Reading/collection_e1m7_1</image>

content.cn: 阿吉送给佩丽卡的画作。这是她为了感激众人送上的心意。
content.en: Ginny drew this and gave it to Perlica. The little girl was very grateful to the Endfielders.

content.cn: 女孩将她认为世界上最酷的几样东西都画在了纸上。
content.en: A young girl drew the coolest things she could think of on this piece of paper.

content.cn: 一张艾维文娜只给过少数人的私人名片，除了常规的联系方式外，还留着“如有特殊情况”可使用的紧急联系途径。
content.en: Avywenna only gives this personal contact card to the select few. The card features standard contact numbers as well as an emergency number for "special situations".

content.cn: 名片背面的一角有一个不怎么明显的凹印记号，像是一个小小的指向箭头——似乎是艾维文娜独有的个人标识。
content.en: The back side of the card features an embossed logo that resembles a small arrow. This seems to be Avywenna's personal mark.

content.cn: <@nar.center>……时间融化不了她唇齿间的宇宙……</>
content.en: <@nar.center>...The cosmos held by her lips is untouched by time...</>

content.cn: <@nar.center>……死亡的子嗣把守的门窗外，她仍在等待……</>
content.en: <@nar.center>...Beyond portals guarded by the deathly kind, she continues to wait and bide...</>

content.cn: <image>Reading/collection_read_letter</image>
content.en: <image>Reading/collection_read_letter</image>

content.cn: 管理员：
content.en: Endministrator:

content.cn: 当你看到这封信，我应该已经离开。
content.en: By the time you read this letter, I will have already left.

content.cn: 有你帮忙，枢壤仪确有改进，不再对武陵造成威胁，但强行关闭裂隙，总会有代价。
content.en: Your assistance has improved the Xiranite Nexus, and it no longer poses a threat to Wuling. But an attempt to forcibly seal the rift would not be without consequences.

content.cn: 不论如何，我确信自己一人能够关闭裂隙。至于代价……也只我一人。
content.en: However, I do know, with certainty, that I can seal the rift on my own. As for the price ... I alone should suffice.

content.cn: 我已留书，将武陵各项事务暂交由葛一朴与弭弗……最终，武陵会继续往前。
content.en: I have penned a letter to grant Ge Yipu and Mi Fu temporary authority over matters of the city... In the end, Wuling will endure and move on, as it has always done.

content.cn: 曾几何时，我以为离去的人今生也无缘再见，回忆，也只是回忆。
content.en: There was a time when I thought I would never see the departed, that memories would remain as they are — things that linger in our minds.

content.cn: 可当你出现，那些离去的面容与眼前的相叠，回忆被再次点亮，一一重现。
content.en: But you appeared, and the faces of the departed overlapped with the sights. Memories were reignited, one after another, they replayed themselves.

content.cn: 记得你刚来到科考站，我站在人群中望着你，期待终有一天也能与你谈论自己的观点与想法。
content.en: I remember when you first visited the Science Station. I stood in the crowd and gazed at you from afar. I hoped there would be a day when I could share my perspective and ideas with you.

content.cn: 可真有机会与你说话时，我却磕磕巴巴，一句话也讲不清……所以我想，若你还记得我，恐怕只会想起一个总莫名其妙躲着你的后辈。
content.en: When I finally got my chance, I found myself stuttering and unable to form a coherent sentence... I thought you would probably remember me as a young girl who just kept avoiding you for reasons unknown.

content.cn: 十年晃眼过，当日的喧闹人群，也只剩下你我。
content.en: A decade has gone by. You and I are the only ones left from the crowd of yesteryear.

content.cn: 但至少你还在，还能让我觉得，那段美好的时光仍尚存一息，并未彻底离我远去。
content.en: But you still walk amongst us, and you have made me feel that a figment of the beautiful times has remained instead of leaving me completely.

content.cn: 这就够了……
content.en: And that is enough...

content.cn: 你是终末地的管理员，我是武陵的管代。
content.en: You are the Endministrator of Endfield Industries, while I am the Viceroy of Wuling.

content.cn: 武陵是我的责任，而你，却注定要前往更远的前方，承担更重要的责任。
content.en: Wuling is my responsibility, while you are destined to push further into the frontiers and to shoulder burdens of far greater import.

content.cn: 恳求你与我同去，是将我的责任强加在你身上，更何况，你已为武陵做了许多。
content.en: Asking you to join me on this mission is akin to me forcing you to take on my duties, and you have already done so much for Wuling.

content.cn: 所以……
content.en: So...

content.cn: 管理员，很抱歉没能遵守约定。
content.en: Endmin, apologies for reneging on my promise.

content.cn: 同为领导者，我希望你能理解我做出的选择。
content.en: As a leader yourself, I hope you can understand the choice I made.

content.cn: 你帮我完善枢壤仪已经足够，不应再和我一同承担。
content.en: You've helped me repair the Xiranite Nexus. That is already more than enough. I shouldn't ask for anything beyond that.

content.cn: 毕竟，是我的失察，才让武陵陷入危险，让人们承受损失……
content.en: After all, it was my negligence that placed Wuling in danger. The suffering of the people and the city is my responsibility...

content.cn: 更何况，能亲眼见证一项跨越十几年的项目收获成果，是一位天师的毕生所求。
content.en: Furthermore, witnessing a project spanning more than a decade fulfilling its purpose... That is the lifetime wish of any Tianshi.

content.cn: 在求索的道路上，一个人的终点，往往是另一人的起点。
content.en: On this quest for discovery, one's final stop is often the starting point of another.

content.cn: 如果这是我的终点，我希望它会成为你们再次向北部禁区进发的起点。
content.en: If this becomes my final stop, then use it as your starting point ... for our push towards the North Wuling Exclusion Zone.

content.cn: 若有意外，武陵城中行政事务暂交予巡卫队队长弭弗处理，学院事务则交由天师葛一朴负责。
content.en: If an accident were to occur, the handling of all administrative affairs of Wuling City shall be handled by Watchguard Captain Mi Fu, while Academy and campus matters shall be handed over to Tianshi Ge Yipu.

content.cn: 实验名称：使用枢壤仪实地进行裂隙闭合测试
content.en: TITLE OF TEST: Field Trial for Rift Sealing with the Xiranite Nexus

content.cn: 研究机构名称：武陵材料研究所
content.en: Research Center Title: Wuling Institute of Materials Science

content.cn: 主要研究者：庄方宜
content.en: PRIMARY INVESTIGATOR: Zhuang Fangyi

content.cn: 随行实验人员：无
content.en: ADDITIONAL INVESTIGATOR(S): None

content.cn: 实验目标：测试升级后的枢壤仪应对裂隙的具体表现，以及评估闭合裂隙过程中，枢壤仪所造成的能量碰撞与冲击的危险程度。
content.en: GOALS OF TEST: Performance assessment of the upgraded Xiranite Nexus against an actual rift; and evaluate the levels of potential hazards resulting from energy collisions and shockwaves generated by the Xiranite Nexus during the rift sealing process.

content.cn: 风险须知：本次实验需要参与人员尽可能靠近裂隙进行操作，承受高强度超域能量冲击。
content.en: RISK REMINDERS: Participants must be as close as possible to the rift to conduct this test, and will therefore be exposed to powerful pulses of Æther energy.

title.en: Informed Consent Form for Test Safety

content.cn: 厚厚的论文册，曾被频繁翻阅，每一页都留有详细的笔记，看得出阅览者十分用心。
content.en: A thick compilation of scientific theses. Someone has flipped through it religiously. Detailed notes have been left at every page. The reader really got into the details.

content.cn: 书页中还夹着一枚书签，上面绘了只胖乎乎的羽兽。

content.cn:
尊敬的管理员：
今日向您报喜。团队历经数年，终于成功合成新材料“息壤”。其性能数据远超预期，印证了您当年提出的理论构想。
在此，谨向您汇报这一喜讯，也衷心祝愿您正在进行的远征一切顺利！
content.en:
Dear Endministrator: 
We got some terrific news today. After years of work, we finally synthesized the novel material "Xiranite" successfully. Its performance metrics are well-above our expectations. Xiranite is proof of the theoretical framework you proposed all those years ago.
Just sharing this piece of joy with you. I'm also praying that your ongoing expedition is going smoothly as well!

content.cn: 甚大裂隙爆发后，瘴气不断弥散，所到之处城镇倾圮，哀鸿遍野，北部家园已化作焦土，只能舍弃土地，退守后方。
content.en: When the Very Large Rift burst forth, the Miasma spread without cease. Wherever it reached, towns fell to ruin and cries of anguish filled the land. The northern homelands have been reduced to ash. Nothing remains but to forsake that soil and retreat to the rear.

content.cn: 直至腹心要害，不可再退。遂请隐士助力，效法大炎玉门城制，疏地下暗流，筑烽燧桩，布散巨兽权能。再将关隘交予应龙特勤队镇守，遏制瘴气，抗击蚀影。
content.en: Till it pierced the heartland, where no retreat remained. Then were the master hermits called forth. After the fashion of the Yumen Garrison of Yan, they dredged the underground streams, raised the Balepyre Towers, and scattered the Feranmut's power. The pass was given over unto the Yinglung Special Task Force — to quell the Miasma and resist the Blightshades.

content.cn: 尚后人知：全众者，守也；全守者，生也。但退守只是权宜之策，应龙众人于此立誓，绝不言弃，日复一日，勘查禁区，开辟前路。
content.en: Therefore let it be made known: to preserve the people is to stand firm; to stand firm is to survive. Retreat is but a transient measure. The Yinglungs swear herein that they shall forsake not their charge, but shall day by day survey the exclusion zone, and carve forth a path unto the future.

content.cn: 盼终有一日，自此出师，收复失土。
content.en: May there come a day when we march forth hence, and reclaim all that was lost.

content.en: With the support of Endfield Industries, Project Xiranite has achieved a significant milestone. We sincerely invite you to attend this celebration banquet held in honor of this achievement.

content.cn: “那些肯定都会有的。愿望嘛，想大胆点！”
content.en: "Those are definitely coming. If you're gonna wish for something, might as well dream big!"

title.en: Appointment Letter for Tianshi Li Xiting

content.cn: 甚大裂隙那边出了点问题，我们去看看。锅里有饭，等我们回家。
content.en: Something's wrong at the Very Large Rift. We're going to check it. Food's in the kitchen. Wait for us to come home.

content.cn: ……今时不同往日，由于文明环带近十年来在材料研究和抗侵蚀干扰技术领域的一系列突破，对侵蚀采取扫描、封锁、清除措施已不再是过于超前的幻想。
content.en: ...Times are now different. Breakthroughs in material science and anti-Blight interference technology achieved by Civilization Band scientists during the last decade mean that scanning, containing, and eliminating Blight masses in the field is no longer science fiction.

content.cn: 我们可以找到侵蚀区域的“最初接触点”，像解开线团那样解除它的威胁。当然，侵蚀扫描平台应当以何种形态被投放至怎样的应用场景，现在仍未有定论。但无论如何，假如某种技术能够允许我们在第一线、第一时间遏制侵蚀的危害，它就有被实现的价值。
content.en: We are now capable of locating a Blight patch's "origin of contact" and neutralizing it like untangling a ball of yarn. Although the exact form of the Blight scanner platform as well as the deployment and applicable scenarios thereof have yet to be determined, any technology that enables immediate, on-site control of the Blight is highly promising. It is a goal worth realizing.

title.cn: 工团大会预算申报宣讲草稿（第八版）
title.en: UWST Assembly Budget Proposal Briefing Draft (Version 8)

content.cn: 关于侵蚀扫描平台的具体设计，现在有两套原型方案。
content.en: We now have 2 design proposals for the Blight scanning platform prototype:

content.cn: 方案一：使用移动地块级别的重型平台搭载扫描设备，以地区为单位展开作业，扫描并清理侵蚀区域。
content.en: PROPOSAL 1: Load the scanner on a heavy platform on par with a nomadic city plate, and start scanning and clearing out Blight zones one region at a time.

content.cn: 方案二：反其道而行之，将扫描设备小型化，安装到轮式作业平台上去。
content.en: PROPOSAL 2: Miniaturize the scanner and mount it on a wheeled mobility chassis.

content.cn: 如果是后者，只需要一支行动小组，就可以深入侵蚀区域执行任务。伊冯这个想法很好，不过我有几个地方不放心：小型化会废弃许多功能，必须靠人力完成剩余操作；而且，把那台原型机缩小到轮式平台的尺寸可不容易，我担心目标设得太高，最后无法实现。
content.en: If it's the latter, a single field team would be enough to carry out missions deep inside the Blight zone. Yvonne's idea is solid, but I have a few concerns: miniaturization would mean sacrificing a number of functions, leaving the rest to be handled manually. Also, shrinking the prototype down to fit a wheeled platform won't be easy. I'm worried the objective might be overly ambitious and hard to pull off.

content.cn: P.S. 但伊冯还是把蓝图画好了。文件详见附件——千万别弄丢！
content.en: PS: But Yvonne drew up the blueprints anyway. See the attached files. PLEASE DON'T LOSE THEM!

content.cn: 原型机的完成度已经相当高了，不过伊冯坚持要给原型机定制一套辅助智能和表情交互界面。
content.en: The prototype is nearly complete, but Yvonne insists on adding a custom support AI and a facial expression interface to it.

content.cn: 这家伙显然有点太上心了。我问伊冯是不是还打算给原型机起个名字，结果真有一个！TA-TA，这到底是什么意思……
content.en: She's clearly getting way too invested. I asked Yvonne if she planned to name the prototype — turns out she already did! TA-TA. What is that even supposed to mean...?

content.cn: 希望那名字不是随手在键盘上敲出来的。总之，你要的零件也到货了，记得来拿。
content.en: Let's hope she didn't just smash the keyboard to get that name. Anyway, the parts you requested are here. Don't forget to pick them up.

content.cn: P.S. 接口参数详见附件——千万别弄丢！
content.en: PS: The port parameters are in the attachment. PLEASE DON'T LOSE THEM!

content.cn: （飞舞的手写体）你们记好了，TA-TA的全称是，全、频、超、域、抑、稳、自、动、机！
content.en: (Flamboyant handwriting) The full name of TA-TA is Trans-Æther Tranquilizer-Automata. MEMORIZE IT!

content.cn: ……纵使历经数次迭代，枢壤仪的性能仍远未达到预期。
content.en: ...Even after several iterations, the performance of the Xiranite Nexus still falls far short of expectations.

content.cn: 在武陵城长期面临息壤储备短缺的严峻现实下，庄方宜天师做出了艰难抉择：暂缓枢壤仪的开发，将其改造后，置于息壤炉中，作为稳定炉心、维系息壤生产的核心部件……
content.en: Faced with the harsh reality of long-term Xiranite shortages in Wuling City, Tianshi Zhuang made a difficult decision: pause development of the Xiranite Nexus and repurpose it as a stabilized core component within the Xiranite forge to maintain Xiranite production.

content.cn: 当被问及这一计划的停滞是否意味着某种遗憾时，庄方宜天师的回答异常简洁：
content.en: When asked if the stagnation of this plan implied any regret, Tianshi Zhuang's reply was remarkably brief:

content.cn: “是一人使得还是千万人使得，没什么好犹豫的。”
content.en: "Whether it serves one person or millions, the choice is clear."

content.cn: 被遗忘在泉水旁的“汤汤券”，上面原本有汤汤歪七扭八的字迹，现在已经模糊不清。
content.en: A "Tangtang Cert" left beside the ancestral spring. Her barely legible handwriting has been smudged beyond comprehension.

content.cn: 打湿它的是祖泉的流水，还是汤汤的泪水，已经无从辨认。
content.en: There is no way of telling if it has been made wet by the flowing waters of the Ancestral Spring, or Tangtang's tears.

content.en: <image>Reading/reading_e8m1_suishou</image>

content.cn: 老师，我们那位代理人到底什么来头？
content.en: Mentor, do you know anything about the Proxy?

content.cn: 我纵览司岁台的卷宗，也没发现任何一位岁兽代理人符合她的情况。
content.en: I read through the records at the Sui Regulator. She matches none of the Feranmut Sui's proxies.

content.cn: 甚至当初建造巨兽心脏时她展露出的权能，都着实令人眼花缭乱……
content.en: The power she revealed when building the Feranmut Heart was ... really bewildering.

content.cn: 难道她不是当初的十二位代理人之一？
content.en: Maybe she isn't one of the original twelve proxies.

content.cn: 很多疑问，也许只有继续深入研究她留下的痕迹才能有答案。
content.en: There are so many questions. Perhaps we will only find the answers by studying the traces she left behind.

content.cn: 我会在武陵再多待些时日。
content.en: I shall remain in Wuling for a few more days.

content.cn: 计算参考值：息壤投入量、息壤损耗效率、雨水生成系数、区域面积、超域破溃周期、区域深度读数、空气损耗……
content.en: ALGORITHMIC BASELINE REFERENCE: Total Xiranite input; Xiranite conversion loss; Runoff coefficient; Target area; Æther rupture cycle time; Area Depth readings; Mid-air loss...

content.cn: 计算结果分析：如采取全域平均造雨的方案，则应龙关每日消耗46727.22单位息壤，资源利用效率极低。
content.en: SIMULATION RESULTS & ANALYSIS: Adopting the plan of homogeneous area-wide rain seeding will consume 46727.22 unit(s)/day of Xiranite for Yinglung Pass. Resource utilization efficiency will be extremely low.

content.cn: 阿吉画下了帮助难民暂居处的人们。笔触依旧很稚嫩，画中的笑脸越来越多了。
content.en: Ginny made a drawing of people who helped out the refugee camp. A typical drawing made by a child with many smiling faces.

content.cn: <image>Reading/collection_listen_record</image>
content.en: <image>Reading/collection_listen_record</image>

content.cn: 阿杜用斯托布传授的技术，编排运输机器人们跳了一支舞。这也许是他独创的道谢方式。
content.en: Dewey learned some techniques from Staub and got the logistics robots to perform a dance routine. Perhaps it's his special way to convey his gratitude.

content.cn: <image>Reading/reading_f1m4_can</image>
content.en: <image>Reading/reading_f1m4_can</image>

content.cn: 来自难民暂居处自行生产的第一批柑实罐头。对暂居处的人来说，它们有着特别的纪念意义。
content.en: From the very first batch of canned citromes produced by the refugee camp. This tin carries special meaning to the camp residents.

content.cn: 一切来得太突然了。侵蚀摧毁了营地，撤离途中，裂地者又突然出现了。
content.en: Catastrophe struck without warning. The Blight ravaged the camp. Landbreakers emerged from the wastes like blades through smoke.

content.cn: 他们什么时候胆子大到敢直接进攻工团的营地了？
content.en: Since when did they grow bold enough to strike directly at UWST?

content.cn: 奥莉加的伤势在加重，我必须省下能源，让她的辅助行动装置坚持到避难点。
content.en: Olga isn't getting any better. I must save energy to keep her Supporter device going till we reach the shelter.

content.cn: 帕维尔主动提出要帮我照看她，但我看得出来，他也快撑不住了。他年纪太大，经不起这种折腾。
content.en: Pavel offered to help look after her, but I can tell he's barely holding on. He's too old to withstand this kind of torture.

content.cn: 我们遇到救援队了！带队的是个年轻人，看得出经验不多，但人挺不错。
content.en: We've met the rescue team! The one leading the team is a young man. You can tell he doesn't have much experience, but he's nice.

content.cn: 奥莉加的情况终于稳定了，我们还拿到了一批补给。事情似乎开始往好的方向发展了。
content.en: Olga's condition has finally stabilized, and we've also received a batch of supplies. Things seem to be starting to take a turn for the better.

content.cn: 早上诺夫曼问我要不要放慢速度，我拒绝了。侵蚀还在持续扩散，撤离行动一刻都拖不得。
content.en: In the morning, Noffman asked me if we should slow down, but I refused. The Blight is still spreading continuously, we can't rest now.

content.cn: 奥莉加和帕维尔支持我的决定。我们仨走在队尾，互相照应——只要不掉队，就没问题。
content.en: Olga and Pavel support my decision. The three of us are walking at the end of the team, looking out for each other. As long as we don't fall behind, everything will be fine.

content.cn: 一批工团配发的常规设备，包括便携终端、防身用快捷施术单元、通用型号的源石电池组等。其中，三个通信设备遭到人为破坏，损坏痕迹清晰可辨。
content.en: A batch of standard-issue UWST gear, including handyterms, quick-cast Arts Units for self-defense, and universal Originium battery packs. Three comm devices show clear signs of deliberate sabotage.

content.cn: 应急委员会的各位同志：
content.en: Comrades of the Emergency Committee,

content.cn: 你们好。
content.en: Hope you are all well.

content.cn: 我郑重提出申请，请解除我“基建前站负责人”的相关职责，重新安排其他合适人选。
content.en: I write to formally request the removal of my duties as Infra-Station Chief, and that a more suitable replacement be appointed in my stead.

content.cn: 这段时间以来，我始终尽力履行岗位使命，带领同伴完成救援与建设任务。然而，个人经验的不足与判断的失误，已对集体造成不可逆的损失。我深知，无论出于何种理由，责任终究无法推卸。
content.en: These past weeks, I have striven to uphold my post - leading rescues, pushing for construction, doing all within my power. Yet my inexperience, my flawed judgments… they have cost us irreparably. No excuses can absolve such failure.

content.cn: 过去几日，我反复回想那次救援行动的每一个节点。我曾试图为失误找出合理解释，但最终我必须承认：我还不具备承担这份责任的能力。在关键时刻，我没能带回所有人，也没能为避难点的稳定提供最优解……
content.en: These last nights, I've replayed that fateful rescue in my mind, over and over. I searched for justifications, for some sliver of reason to soften the truth. But I cannot lie: I am unworthy of this responsibility. When it mattered most, I failed to bring everyone back. Failed to secure the shelter, to chart the best path…

content.cn: 根据管理员提供的新线索，失踪的三人仍存在一定的生还可能。目前尚未发现三人的遗体，无法确认他们已死亡。而那些获得他们设备的裂地者，似乎未曾与三人遭遇。
content.en: From the new leads provided by the Endministrator, there remains a chance the three missing souls yet live. No trace of their remains has been found to confirm their end. What's more, the Landbreakers that seized their equipment show no signs of having crossed blades with them.

content.cn: 我一直反复叮嘱巡逻队，务必留意关于三人的一切线索。事态稍有稳定后，我也曾亲自前往他们失踪的区域进行过数次勘察。然而，始终一无所获。唯一尚未彻底探察的地方是裂地者频繁出没的活跃区。但那里……他们不可能藏身在那种地方，而我也不能让巡逻队的队员去赌命。
content.en: I've drilled it into the patrols, scour every corner for even a scrap of clue about the three. Once things settled a little, I trekked back to where they vanished, combing the area again and again. Nothing. Not a single trace. The only spot left unplumbed is the Landbreaker hive, where those things swarm thickest. But… they couldn't possibly be hiding there. And I certainly can't risk the lives of the patrol teams.

content.cn: 随着时间推移，我想他们生存的概率已经微乎其微。
content.en: As time creeps on, their chances of survival grow slimmer than a thread.

content.cn: 或许唯一的希望就是瞭望塔了。
content.en: Perhaps the only hope lies with the watchtower.

content.cn: 在维护旧设备的过程中，注意到有一台退役状态的老式信号基站，其核心模块依旧保存完整。其中包含三个辅助施术单元与一个主施术单元，完整性尚可，没有明显的被侵蚀破坏的痕迹。
content.en: While maintaining the old device, a decommissioned vintage signal base station was noticed. Its core module remains fully intact. It houses three Support units and one main Arts Unit, all in decent condition with no visible signs of Blight damage.

content.cn: 设备编号为“M-026G”，出厂序列匹配工团第二代野外作业支援设备，原本用于野外作业中的通信联络。
content.en: The device, numbered "M-026G," matches the factory sequence of the UWST's second-generation field operation support equipment, originally designed for communication and liaison during field operations.

content.cn: 主施术单元理论输出功率正常，可以正常使用。
content.en: The main Arts Unit's theoretical output power checks out.

content.cn: 辅助施术单元结构稳固，若进行模块隔离处理，理论上可单独驱动一道固定术式通道（如定点灼烧或屏障冲击）。
content.en: The supporting Arts Units boast stable structures. With module isolation, they could theoretically drive a fixed artifice channel independently - such as pinpoint incineration or barrier impact.

content.cn: 回路接口为早期的工团标准格式，可通过中继线与现有瞭望塔系统实现联动（需增加稳定器）。
content.en: The circuit interface follows the early UWST standard format, enabling linkage with the existing watchtower system via a relay line. Though a stabilizer must be added.

content.cn: 适配源石电池组扩展方案，有一定操作空间。
content.en: It accommodates an Originium battery pack expansion scheme, leaving room for maneuver.
Written by: ■■■■■■

content.cn: 协作单位：四号谷地应急委员会
content.en: Collaborator: Valley IV Emergency Committee

content.cn: 概述
content.en: Overview

content.cn: 在部署信号接收器进行全域扫描期间，系统于裂地者控制区域边缘捕捉到短暂异常信号，频率特征与失联工团成员奥莉加携带的辅助行动装置一致。因该信号极其微弱，信号特征仅维持0.7秒后即消失。
content.en: During the deployment of the signal receiver for a full-area scan, the system picked up a fleeting anomalous signal at the edge of the Landbreaker's controlled zone, its frequency signature matching the auxiliary operation device carried by Olga, the missing UWST member. The signal, however, was extraordinarily faint, its characteristics persisting for a mere 0.7 seconds before vanishing entirely.

content.cn: 详细分析
content.en: Detailed Analysis

content.cn: 信号特征编码：与工团第二代辅助行动系统编码结构高度匹配，编码匹配度达93.7%。
content.en: Signal signature encoding: Highly consistent with the coding structure of the UWST's second-generation Support operation system, with a matching rate of 93.7%.

content.cn: 来源位置：疑似信号位于四号谷地东北矿脉源区山道交汇点附近。该地为裂地者高频出没区域，地图标记为“不可通行”，但存在未被正式记录的小型裂谷与天然通道，具备短期藏匿的条件。
content.en: Source location: The suspected signal emanates near the mountain path junction of the northeastern Origin Lodespring in Valley IV. A hotbed for Landbreaker activity, the area is marked "impassable" on official maps - yet unrecorded minor rifts and natural passages weave through it, offering fleeting shelter for those in hiding.

content.cn: 信号状态：可初步判断为设备异常或自动回传机制，并非人工主动触发，应为持续性释放的设备信号。由于信号极其微弱，故未能捕捉到持续性的信号特征。
content.en: Signal status: Initial analysis suggests this is either an equipment anomaly or an automatic transmission mechanism, not manually triggered. It appears to be a continuously emitted device signal, though its extreme faintness prevented the capture of sustained signature patterns.

content.cn: 初步结论
content.en: Preliminary Conclusion

content.cn: 发出该信号的设备需要长期维护，虽然缺乏连续信号佐证，但本次侦测结果强烈表明失联工人中至少奥莉加仍存活。建议加装增幅器，继续捕捉该信号。
content.en: The device emitting this signal requires long-term maintenance. While there's no corroborating continuous signal, this detection result strongly suggests that at least Olga, among the missing workers, is still alive. It is recommended that an amplifier be installed to continue capturing the signal.

content.cn: 尸体发现于四号谷地枢纽区的002号临时仓库，呈半卧位，尸体的大腿、手腕能看到明显的割伤，腰部能看到较深刺伤，其致命伤位于脖颈，初步判断，死因为颈动脉遭利器切断后导致的大出血。死者护具几乎完好无损，四处伤口都在护甲缝隙。
content.en: Body discovered in temporary depot unit 002, Hub area of Valley IV. Positioned in a semi-seated posture. Clear slash wounds visible on thighs and wrists, with deeper stab wounds at the waist. The fatal injury is located at the neck. Preliminary assessment indicates death resulted from severe hemorrhage due to a severed carotid artery caused by a sharp weapon. The victim's protective gear remains largely intact, with all four wounds precisely targeting gaps in the armor.

content.cn: 我们过去掌握了一些碾骨氏族危险目标的情报，死者很可能是“断头台”盖比。他之所以被称作“断头台”，是因为他手中的大斧威力惊人，其威力或许足以劈开装甲车……这样的话，杀死他的人作战经验或许很丰富？一个手持利器、行动敏捷的高手，首先在盖比的腰部造成了重伤，让他几乎没有办法发力劈下大斧，然后攻击手腕，进一步止住他的攻击……最后是腿部，彻底断绝盖比的逃跑可能……
content.en: Based on previously gathered intelligence regarding high-risk targets within the Bonekrusher Clan, the deceased is likely "Guillotine" Gabbi. His moniker stems from the terrifying power of his great axe, said to be capable of cleaving even armored vehicles... Which suggests his killer must possess considerable combat experience? The attacker, armed with a sharp weapon and remarkable agility, first inflicted a severe waist injury, crippling Gabbi's ability to wield his axe, then targeted the wrists to further neutralize his offensive capacity... Then finally striking the legs to eliminate any chance of escape.

content.cn: 嗯……但这好像也有点说不通？
content.en: But ... something doesn't quite add up.

content.cn: 袭击者可以精准地刺入护甲缝隙，那么他一定能直接一刀封喉吧？一个在高速运动作战中的高手，为什么要额外刺出三刀？
content.en: If the attacker could precisely strike armor gaps, why not deliver a single, immediate killing blow to the throat? Why expend three additional strikes during high-speed combat?

content.cn: 我有一个猜测，袭击者或许是一位复仇者，所以他很熟悉盖比，熟悉他的防具和攻击手段，而并非自身战斗技巧高超。
content.en: One theory: the attacker may be a revenge-seeker. Someone intimately familiar with Gabbi's gear and fighting style, rather than a naturally superior combatant.

content.cn: 盖比替许多人做过事，杀人、绑架、抢劫……在聂菲斯还寂寂无闻时，盖比就应该已经受雇于聂菲斯了，他的仇人一定不少。
content.en: Gabbi served numerous leaders: assassination, kidnapping, robbery... He was likely employed by Nefarith long before she rose to prominence. The list of those holding grudges against him must be extensive.

content.cn: 这个裂地者只在后颈有一条清晰的伤口，除了尘土几乎没有沾染其他污渍。
content.en: This Landbreaker only has one clean wound on the back of the neck. Aside from dust, there's almost no other staining on the body.

content.cn: 他甚至没能来得及握紧武器，也许是第一个被伏击干掉的倒霉鬼。
content.en: He didn't even have time to grip his weapon properly. Probably the first unlucky soul ambushed.

content.cn: 箱子被巨大的力量摧毁，栏杆上有着细小的切痕。
content.en: Containers were smashed with tremendous force, tiny cut marks are found on the railings.

content.cn: 两处破坏应该不是来自同一种武器，持斧的裂地者在这里发生过激烈战斗。
content.en: The two types of damage likely came from different weapons. The axe-wielding Landbreaker clearly fought fiercely here.

content.cn: 尸体发现于四号谷地阿伯莉采石场的杂物存放区，呈半卧位，尸体的背部有大片电击伤，喉部有大片瘀伤，似乎有内出血，死因初步判断为触电导致的心脏骤停。
content.en: Body discovered in the depot area of Aburrey Quarry, Valley IV. Positioned semi-upright. Large electrical burn on the back, extensive bruising and apparent internal bleeding in the throat. Preliminary cause of death: cardiac arrest from electrocution.

content.cn: 对比内部资料，我可以确信，遇袭者是“鬼火”维奇尔，一名焰术师。碾骨氏族的焰术师应该算是一种历史悠久的“符号”。这些人只要全神贯注地举一会儿手，就能在火光里转移到另一处地点，十分灵活。
content.en: Cross-referencing internal files confirms the victim is "Will-o-Wisp" Vichir, a pyromancer. Bonekrusher pyromancers are practically historic symbols. These guys can focus, raise a hand, and teleport through flames with ridiculous flexibility.

content.cn: 这样看下来，维奇尔死在了对他最不利的位置，一处被高压阻拦网合围的区域……我几乎可以想象到灵活的维奇尔在围困中四处转移，但总是能被人追上的样子……
content.en: But here's the thing: Vichir died in the worst possible position ... trapped within a high voltage fence. I can almost picture agile Vichir blinking around while being systematically cornered...

content.cn: 等等……这反而有些不对劲……
content.en: Wait ... that's what doesn't add up.

content.cn: 维奇尔的尸体上只有喉部的瘀伤和背部的电击伤，他的身体上甚至没有任何钝器或利器伤害，这是为什么？
content.en: Vichir only has throat bruising and back burns, no blunt or sharp weapon injuries. Why?

content.cn: 难道袭击者没带武器？
content.en: Did the attacker come unarmed?

content.cn: 维奇尔和袭击者一同被围困在高压阻拦网之间，局势对两人一样不利……倒不如说对袭击者更不利一些，维奇尔毕竟拥有人数优势……
content.en: Vichir and the attacker were both trapped by the high voltage fence. A situation equally bad for both, or worse for the attacker since Vichir had numbers on his side...

content.cn: 维奇尔之死似乎只有一种可能，一位焰术师和敌人一起被围困在狭窄地形内，他的第一反应一定是立刻转移……这绝对在袭击者的计算之中，他凶猛且快速地击中了维奇尔的咽喉，打断了转移……能量被扼在体内，这也正是维奇尔内出血的原因……
content.en: There's only one plausible scenario. A pyromancer trapped in close quarters would instinctively teleport immediately. The attacker anticipated this: striking Vichir's throat violently and fast, interrupting the transfer... Energy trapped inside his body explains the internal bleeding...

content.cn: 这些裂地者集体倒在地面上，以一个奇怪的姿势对着房间。看起来像是在求着什么……而且他们似乎是被同时击杀的。
content.en: These Landbreakers have collapsed collectively on the ground, arranged in a strange posture facing the room. They appear to be pleading for something ... and seem to have been killed simultaneously.

content.cn: 尸体发现于四号谷地矿脉源区的蚀崖观测站，呈卧位。除喉部一处深度切割之外，未见新鲜显著伤口，推测死因为过度失血和窒息导致的心肺功能停止。
content.en: Body discovered at the Blightcliff Observation Post in Valley IV, positioned lying down. Aside from a deep laceration at the throat, no other fresh significant wounds were found. Presumed cause of death: cardiopulmonary failure due to excessive blood loss and suffocation.

content.cn: 因为伤口出现在常见致命位置，我最初怀疑死者遭到了来自前方的弩箭狙击。但伤口的深度和宽度并不支持这个假设——从宽度看，那应当是一支巨大的弩箭，但即便事后被拔出，它也应该刺得更深，而非仅仅划破动脉。
content.en: Given the wound's location in a commonly fatal area, I initially suspected the victim was sniped by a crossbow from the front. However, the depth and width of the injury don't support this theory. Based on the width, it would have required a massive bolt, but even if removed afterward, it should have penetrated deeper rather than merely slicing the artery.

content.cn: 如果箭矢是从极限射程发射，已经耗尽了动能，几乎不可能在那种距离命中咽喉。目前来看，现场能发射如此箭矢的武器似乎只有死者手边的劲弩。
content.en: If the bolt had been fired from extreme range with depleted kinetic energy, hitting the throat accurately at that distance would be nearly impossible. Currently, the only weapon on-site capable of firing such a bolt appears to be the powerful crossbow beside the deceased.

content.cn: 我认为事实更可能是另一种：死者手持箭头完成了自害，随后将其丢弃。
content.en: I believe the more likely scenario is another: the victim used the arrowhead to inflict self-harm, then discarded it.

content.cn: 通过比对图片资料，结合现场态势，推测他很可能正是“血眼”撒萨罗，一位拥有许多忠诚追随者的重要氏族干部。他的拥趸均会携带黑色羽兽挂饰作为象征。
content.en: Cross-referencing image data and assessing the scene, it's speculated he may be "Bloodeye" Sazaro, an important clan cadre with many loyal followers. His adherents all carry black fowlbeast pendants as symbols.

content.cn: 但这就意味着，一位善战的领导者，因为不明原因选择了自尽，这一切甚至发生在碾骨氏族入侵四号谷地期间。
content.en: But this means a combat-capable leader, for unknown reasons, chose suicide... All occurring during the Bonekrushers' invasion of Valley IV.

content.cn: 虽然不打算同情他，但一位加害者这样死于加害途中，显然并不是常见的情况……
content.en: While I don't intend to sympathize with him, a perpetrator dying this way mid-harm is clearly not a common situation...

title.cn: 瑟斯顿的现场记录·矿脉源区

content.cn: 尸体被发现于四号谷地供能高地的变电室，呈仰卧位，尸体的腕部、背部、左胸、颈部、面部有多道伤口，致命伤位于心脏位置，死因可推断为心脏遭刺穿导致的大出血。另外，从血液颜色判断，割伤死者的兵器似乎淬了毒。
content.en: Body discovered in the substation of Power Plateau, Valley IV. Positioned supine. Multiple wounds on wrists, back, left chest, neck, and face. Fatal injury located at the heart. Cause of death determined to be massive hemorrhage from cardiac puncture. Additionally, based on blood discoloration, the blade used appears to have been poisoned.

content.cn: 他一定是“火山”查查！这可是个足够有名气的裂地者，或许连文明环带内部，不怎么了解裂地者氏族划分的人都听过他的名字，甚至在聂菲斯统合碾骨氏族前，他的名字才是碾骨氏族的代表。更重要的是，他其实很年轻。有传言说他甚至还不到三十岁，如果没有聂菲斯横空出世，他一定才是能统一碾骨氏族的人。
content.en: This has to be "Volcano" Chacha! A Landbreaker notorious enough that even people within the Civilization Band with little knowledge of clan divisions might have heard his name. Before Nefarith unified the Bonekrushers, his name was the face of the clan. More importantly, he was remarkably young. Rumors claimed he wasn't even thirty. Had Nefarith not emerged unexpectedly, he would likely have been the one to unite the Bonekrushers.

content.cn: 那么是谁杀了他，聂菲斯？但聂菲斯没必要用毒药……
content.en: So who killed him? Nefarith? But she wouldn't need poison...

content.cn: 更重要的是，尸体背部、左胸、颈部的伤口似乎都在尚未愈合的状态下，再次遭到了反复攻击。要知道这些伤口大部分被遮掩在了护甲下，单靠战斗中的敏锐观察是绝对没办法发现它们的。
content.en: Crucially, the wounds on his back, left chest, and neck appear to have been repeatedly attacked before they could heal. Most of these injuries were concealed beneath armor, which are impossible to detect through combat observation alone.

content.cn: 除非，袭击者本来就对“火山”查查足够熟悉。
content.en: Unless the assailant was already intimately familiar with "Volcano" Chacha.

content.en: He wants weapons, shelter, and more access rights. Clearly, others will join his plan.

content.cn: “火山”不符合我们的标准。企业的合作对象必须理解规矩什么时候应该存在，什么时候不应该，而不是把所谓“原则”和“传统”看得如此重要。
content.en: "Volcano" doesn't meet our standards. Corporate partners must understand when rules should exist and when they shouldn't, not cling to so-called "principles" and "tradition" so tightly.

content.cn: 更多人在观望，筹码暂时还在你这边。我们会假意配合“火山”，但拖延不了太久，你需要行动。
content.en: More people are watching. The chips are still on your side for now. We'll pretend to cooperate with "Volcano," but we can't delay for long. You need to act.

title.cn: 笔迹潦草的裂地者笔记

content.cn: 这批差点逃跑的长耳兽，最新的实验反馈结果出奇地好。抓回来后，它们的测试表现与之前的相比有天壤之别。
content.en: The clutch of long-ears that nearly escaped confinement actually displayed remarkable test results. Post-recapture performance literally went through the roof.

content.cn: 一个合理的推测是，这与它们在外期间吃的东西有关。
content.en: A good explanation would be related to the things they ate during their brief escape.

content.cn: 当时是林奈帮我抓回了长耳兽。他说长耳兽误食了一些被废弃药剂污染的草，这是个重要线索。
content.en: Linnaeus was the one who helped me bring the long-ears back to their pens. He told me that the herby-little-furballs ate grass contaminated by pharmaceutical waste. It sounds like a good lead to me.

content.cn: 我从他的实验室拿了些药剂制备的中间产物，给部分长耳兽试了一下，出乎意料，效果很好。这批长耳兽表现出的环境敏感性更为明显。
content.en: I took some pharmaceutical intermediates from his lab and administered them to a number of long-ears. Results went unexpectedly well. The treated long-ears exhibited significantly improved environmental awareness.

content.cn: 研究第一阶段的汇报已经顺利结束。
content.en: The first phase of the research project has been successfully reported.

content.cn: 接下来还有许多难点，如真菌的培育和更广泛的生物测试等。不过，这些暂且可以放一放。我确实需要给自己放个假了。
content.en: We'll be facing more challenges like culturing the fungus and expanding the scope of bio-testing. I'll set those aside for now because I really need a break.

content.cn: 今天琼来祝贺我，还带了点心。时光飞逝，想起当年我们一起加入工团的情景。她真是个不错的姑娘，温柔又热心。
content.en: Joan came to congratulate me and even brought some snacks. Time really flies in this place. Can't help but think about the time when we joined the UWST together. She's so nice, gentle, and friendly.

content.cn: 对参数进行调整后，本次模拟通过虚拟运算成功复现了泰拉的天灾。这说明以塔卫二目前的环境条件，在局部区域内将活性源石微粒浓度精确控制在某一范围内时，重现天灾是完全可能的。
content.en: After adjusting the parameters, this simulation used a virtual algorithm to successfully recreate the catastrophes of Terra. This result shows that triggering a Catastrophe at the current environmental conditions of Talos-II is theoretically possible, if the local density of active Originium particles can be precisely maintained within a certain range.

content.cn: 为了确保将来实地测试时的稳定性和准确性，建议继续增加浓度，再进行一个轮次的模拟。
content.en: To ensure the stability and accuracy of subsequent field trials, we recommend an additional round of simulation with increased density.

content.cn: 废弃原因：核心难点未突破，原型机无法量产，该研究具有较高危险性
content.en: REASON(S) FOR SUSPENDING PROJECT: Key bottleneck remains unsolved. Prototype cannot be mass produced. Research poses certain levels of risk.
