content.en: Take out some of the trails to trap those cowards! But keep in mind that this is still our Stockade! DO NOT destroy everything!

content.cn: 等到咱们跟着阮哥平了武陵回来，咱们还要把寨子盖得更大，盖得更好呢！
content.en: Once we conquer Wuling with Big Bro, we'll return and build an even bigger and better and prettier Stockade!

content.cn: 你们的弩，你们的源石技艺，不算强。
content.en: Your crossbows and your Arts. None of them are strong enough.

content.cn: 接受雾火。
content.en: Accept the hazefyre.

content.cn: 接受缠裹雾火的武器。
content.en: Accept the weapons wreathed in hazefyre.

content.cn: 武陵只是一个开始……
content.en: Wuling is just the beginning...

content.cn: 头领会让你们看到未来。
content.en: The Baws ... shall let you witness the future.

content.cn: 你们，炸掉商业街，拖住巡卫。
content.en: You! Blow up the avenue and keep the watchguards occupied.

content.cn: 我们，斩首姓庄的。
content.en: We shall go forth, and murk Zhuang herself.

content.cn: 应龙不用你们操心。
content.en: And quit worrying about Yinglung.

content.cn: 她可以是汤汤，她可以是二姑娘，她可以是大当家，她甚至可以像弭弗一样，离开寨子去当巡卫。
content.en: That girl can be Tangtang, the Younger Dame, the Supreme Chief ... hell, she can just follow Mi Fu's lead, quit the Stockade, and be a watchguard.

content.cn: 所有这些身份，我都认。
content.en: She can have all that. I'm totally fine with it.

content.cn: 但我绝不认一个害死了阮哥的凶手。
content.en: But I'll never forgive someone who murked Big Bro.

content.cn: 既然不认可，我就要有所作为。
content.en: And since I do not forgive, I must do something.

content.cn: 我不逃不避，咱们江湖事江湖了。
content.en: No more escaping. We're settling this the Jianghu way.

content.cn: 我就站在这里，你们这些人——支持汤汤的，任何人都可以来……
content.en: I'll be standing right here. You blight-hearted Tangtang supporters can come at me all you want...

content.cn: 咱们一决生死。
content.en: We'll settle this. One on one. To the friggin' death.

content.cn: 唉，那只彪兽死了。
content.en: Ugh. The poor raker died.

content.cn: 可惜，它运气真的不好。
content.en: The beast was just too unlucky.

content.cn: 这边几个空笼子倒是给我提了个醒，我要去看看有没有小彪兽，能不能抓几只回来。
content.en: The empty cages did remind me of something else. I gotta look for raker cubs and see if I can catch a few.

content.cn: 自从我在家里角落翻到古书，知道了清波寨里也曾有高明的驯兽技术后，我就知道自己这辈子应该干什么了。
content.en: I went through a few old books at home and learned that Qingbo Stockade once had pretty advanced beast domestication techniques. I finally learned what I was supposed to do.

content.cn: 种地那都是没意义的事情，驯养野兽才是我的天职。
content.en: Farming is meaningless. My duty is to tame the wild and ferocious elements of nature.

content.cn: 唉，听说百多年前，老祖宗们一个眼神就能让野兽赴汤蹈火，这甚至不是源石技艺……
content.en: Over a century ago, our ancestors could make beasts fight and do all sorts of dangerous stuff with a single gaze. They didn't even need Originium Arts to pull it off...

content.cn: 他们到底是怎么做到的呢，总不会是天赋异禀吧？
content.en: How did they do it? Is this a gift? A rare innate talent?

content.cn: 还是需要和野兽同吃同住？
content.en: Did they live together with the beasts? Did they share their homes and meals?

content.cn: 二姑娘不能活着。
content.en: Younger Dame doesn't deserve to live.

content.cn: 除非商叔点头放过她，我听商叔的。
content.en: Unless Uncle Shang says so. Uncle's words are my command.

content.cn: 我在这水边下了快十年的棋，终于算是想清楚了一件事。
content.en: After nearly ten years of playing the game near the water, I finally figured it out.

content.cn: 首墩是一步死棋。
content.en: The Marker Stone is a dead piece.

content.cn: 它注定是没办法推广到全塔卫二的。
content.en: It could not be replicated or placed throughout Talos-II.

content.cn: 且不说息壤产量的问题难以解决，单单是压制裂隙的配套设施都极难复制。
content.en: Xiranite mass production is a near-impossible hurdle on its own. Rift suppression machinery and facilities are also extremely difficult to make.

content.cn: 首墩是武陵乃至宏山各项技术的结晶，想要批量生产，太难。
content.en: The Marker Stone is the grand technological achievement for Wuling, or the entirety of Hongshan, even. But producing more of it is beyond our reach.

content.cn: 考察者们带来的资料，游商们带来的信息……每年，每一份文件我都看了不下二十遍，放眼塔卫二，离了武陵，几乎没有第二个地方适合建设这样全套的息壤配套设施……
content.en: Surveyors and traveling vendors would give us data and intel... And every year, I would read every file at least twenty times. Wuling is the only place in Talos-II where a comprehensive Xiranite infrastructure is possible...

content.cn: 但死棋亦可盘活，绝境亦有生机。
content.en: But a dead piece can be revived again. Hope can be found amidst doom.

content.cn: 只要有能适应各种环境条件的建设系统。
content.en: We just need a construction system capable of working in wildly different environments.

content.cn: 劳逸结合嘛，不过我倒是想起来一些有趣的事，我怀疑排水口附近有潜地虬兽。
content.en: Work-life balance, people. But I just remembered something interesting. I believe there's a Tunneling Nidwyrm near the discharge outlet.

content.cn: 可不是我乱猜的，那天过去我明显能感受到脚底下有轻微的震动感。
content.en: It's not a wild guess. I was close to that place and felt weak tremors beneath my feet.

content.cn: 要真是就好了，哎呀，我和你们讲，这一只虬兽抓来，扒皮拆骨，放砂锅里炖半天，香！
content.en: I wish that were true. Nidwyrms are delish. Scale it, debone it, and stew it in a claypot. Just the thought of it! Absolutely divine.

content.cn: 水从天上来？
content.en: Water cascades from the heavens above?

content.cn: 水从心中来，是以抽刀断水而水不绝。
content.en: It pours from the heart, a stream that cannot be severed by a blade.

content.cn: 我心已定，故可一念而悬素倒流。
content.en: So composed I am, I can reverse an entire waterfall if I so wish.

title.en: Random Writings of a Mountain Hermit (1)

content.cn: 我钓了它三天三夜。
content.en: I tried to catch this fin for three days and nights.

content.cn: 我追了它两天两夜。
content.en: I chased after it for two days and nights.

content.cn: 从淬剑荡再到这栖云林地，武陵的水脉真是杂乱。
content.en: I started at the Sword Quenching Marsh and ended up at the Cloudrest Woods. The rivers and streams of Wuling are an interwoven mess.

content.cn: 但我心中有一个猜测……
content.en: I can't help but suspect...

content.cn: 莫非这水中的巨物并非大鳞，而是天使？
content.en: ...this is no mega-fin, but an Aggelos!

content.cn: 竺先生，我写下这些字，是想和您说一个好消息。
content.en: Instructor Zhu, these writings of mine are intended to inform you of good news.

content.cn: 武陵解决了息壤产量的问题，我们不会再有息壤紧缺的隐患了。我想禁区带来的威胁很快也会被遏制住。过去，是您与其他应龙队员用命控制住了禁区的侵蚀，如今，我们终于有机会根绝这种无奈的牺牲。
content.en: Wuling can finally mass produce Xiranite. We won't need to worry about it ever running out. I believe the threat posed by the Exclusion Zone will be lifted soon. Back in those days, you and the Yinglungs gave your lives to hold back the Blight of the EZ. We now have a working solution to end this for good.

content.cn: 我很开心，先生，想来您也会开心。
content.en: I'm very happy, Instructor. I believe you are happy too.

content.cn: 您的剑法，我传给了更多人，并不只在武陵，我也去了塔卫二上的许多地方。每当有人问起我这剑法的来头，我就会说，这是那位老英雄——竺所创造的剑法，接着便能和他们聊起武陵，从科考站落成聊起，聊到您在科考站旁边一手创立谈剑堂，再聊到息壤，聊到您的牺牲……
content.en: I've taught your swordmancy to many others, even those outside Wuling. After all, I visited plenty of locations on Talos-II. Whenever people ask me about its origins, I would say an old hero named Zhu came up with it. Then I'd talk about Wuling, the original Science Station, how you worked there and founded Tanjian Hall at the same time, then I'd go on about Xiranite and your sacrifice...

content.cn: 于是学了剑法的人就能知道“传承”的意义。
content.en: Those who practice your swordmancy would thus learn of the "legacy" it carries.

content.cn: “传承”这两个字很重，老师，但我担住了。
content.en: "Legacy" is a heavy word, Instructor, but I carried it on.

content.cn: 我遇到了一位钓鳞高手。
content.en: I met a master angler.

content.cn: 他提到了武陵的水脉，尤其是地下水，错综复杂。
content.en: He told me that the waterways of Wuling, especially the underground rivers, are interwoven and complex.

content.cn: 这引起了我的思考，水脉无疑会增加首墩的修建难度。
content.en: I started thinking about that. The waterways posed a significant challenge for the Marker Stone's construction.

content.cn: 这确实也值得调查了解。
content.en: I guess this warrants some serious investigation.

content.cn: 万物在生不在杀。
content.en: All beings focus on life, not battles to the death.

content.cn: 敛天地之势，发于方寸之间，剑出则涓流成江海者，为大宗师。
content.en: A true grandmaster is one who unleashes the force of nature within an inch, whose blades start as a stream that fills an ocean.

title.en: Random Writings of a Mountain Hermit (2)

content.cn: 亲爱的念念：
content.en: Dear Babbles:

content.cn: 最近好吗，有没有好好吃饭，又长高了没有？
content.en: How are you doing? Clearing up your dinner plate? Did you grow taller?

content.cn: 姑姑最近搬到了玛尔斯波利斯，这里很热闹。
content.en: Your Aunt just moved to Morospolis. It is a busy and very crowded city.

content.cn: 好了，接下来姑姑又要说那些说过很多次的话了。
content.en: Alright, your Aunt will once again repeat that special line.

content.cn: 要不要搬来和姑姑一起住？
content.en: Interested in coming to Morospolis and living with your Aunt?

content.cn: 你一个人在武陵，姑姑真的不放心。
content.en: I just don't feel safe leaving you alone in Wuling.

content.cn: 虽然你身边好心的叔叔阿姨能照顾你，武陵也能支持你的学业，但姑姑还是想亲自照顾你。
content.en: I know there are a lot of nice people over there and Wuling pays for your schooling, but I do prefer taking care of my sweet Babbles myself.

content.cn: 等姑姑忙完这阵子，就想想办法搬到武陵。
content.en: Once I'm done with my work here, maybe I'll just move to Wuling.

content.cn: 姑姑想让念念有一个家。
content.en: I really want to give Babbles a proper home.

content.cn: 姑姑您辛苦啦。
content.en: You're working really hard, my dear Aunt.

content.cn: 念念一切都好，有在很认真地吃很多饭。
content.en: Your sweet Babbles is doing well and I am clearing my plate.

content.cn: 您不用担心，林地里的房子就是念念的家呀。
content.en: Don't worry about me. My home is in the Woods.

content.cn: 念念是大孩子了，所以能够照顾自己。
content.en: I'm a big kid, too. I know how to take care of myself.

content.cn: 念念也很清楚爸爸妈妈已经走了，他们不会回来了。
content.en: I know very well that Pa and Ma had already left and won't be coming back.

content.cn: 所以念念才不能走。
content.en: That's why I got to stay.

content.cn: 念念走了的话，念念的家就会变成空房子，念念的家就不见了。
content.en: If I left the place, Babbles' Home Sweet Home will be empty, and then it will be gone.

title.en: Letter: From Babbles but Never Sent

content.cn: 各位游客你们好，欢迎来到城建馆……
content.en: Welcome to the Urban Development Hall, dear visitors...

content.cn: 是的，您眼前的是科考站建立初期的规划文件。您可以看到，科考站建立之初，规模极为有限，然后请您看这里，这是十年前的事故中，保留下来的为数不多的“遗物”——一箱文献资料。
content.en: Indeed. This is the very design plans of the Science Station during its early years. As you can see, the Science Station started off as a rather small facility. Now take a look at this crate of documents and files. It is one of the very few items we managed to salvage from the accident ten years ago.

content.cn: 没错，这是天师们用生命从禁区中传递出来的……
content.en: That's right. The courageous Tianshi managed to recover this from the Exclusion Zone, but paid a dear price for it...

content.cn: 您可以看到，在您眼前有四份息壤，他们分别取自第一批实验型息壤、在武陵批量生产的第一批息壤、十年前的事故后恢复生产的第一批息壤，以及集成工业系统所生产的第一批息壤。
content.en: We can see four Xiranite samples here, respectively taken from these production lots: Experimental Batch 1, Wuling Mass Production Batch 1, Post-Incident Recovery Batch 1, and AIC Factory Batch 1.

content.cn: 这四份息壤，代表着武陵发展的四个阶段。
content.en: These four Xiranite samples represent Wuling's four phases of development.

content.cn: 上班好累啊……
content.en: Work is so exhausting...

content.cn: 爸，我回来了。
content.en: I'm back, Father.

content.cn: 我离开武陵，游历许久，去了很多地方，看了很多人。
content.en: I left Wuling. I traveled far and long. I visited many places and met many people.

content.cn: 裂隙、侵蚀……对抗这些东西，很多人有很多办法。
content.en: There are other Rifts and Blight... But everyone came up with their own ways to fight back.

content.cn: 他们启发了我，也让我重新燃起了对息壤、对武陵的希望。
content.en: They inspired me and re-ignited my hopes for Xiranite and Wuling.

content.cn: 您因修建首墩而牺牲，这么多年过去，我从不敢抬眼看它。
content.en: You fell during the construction of the Marker Stone. For many years, I could not bring myself to even look at it.

content.cn: 如今我的心结已然放下。
content.en: But I have finally found peace within me.

content.cn: 水质正常，这些藻类生长的状态很好，每次来到这里，我都会为自己的天才设计骄傲两分钟左右。
content.en: Water quality nominal. The algae are growing well. During every visit, I can't help but spend around two minutes feeling proud of my own genius design.

content.cn: 一旦水中出现侵蚀，这些藻类就会第一时间死亡。
content.en: If the Blight manages to infiltrate the water, the algae would be the first to die.

content.cn: 感谢我那些爱种南瓜的好朋友们复原的种植技术。
content.en: A big thank you to my pumpkin-growing friends who managed to revive the horticultural technique.

content.cn: 今日首墩无恙，很好很好。
content.en: Peace reigns in the Marker Stone today. All is well.

content.cn: 每次眺望首墩，我都会感到不可思议。
content.en: Every time I look at the Marker Stone, I feel nothing but amazement.

content.cn: 它是最初那根钉住甚大裂隙的长钉。
content.en: It is the very first nail hammered into the Very Large Rift (VLR).

content.cn: 但那可是甚大裂隙……仅仅是分支裂隙带就有数十公里……
content.en: But we're talking about the VLR ... a massive phenomenon with a fissure band measuring dozens of klicks wide...

content.cn: 武陵付出了多大牺牲？
content.en: What price did Wuling pay to achieve this?

content.cn: 我想我需要多了解一下，这值得调查和记录。
content.en: I felt compelled to learn more. This is something I should investigate and write about.

content.cn: 你们下一次填维修申请时能不能认真点？
content.en: People, can you be more serious when filling out a repair request form?

content.cn: 这故障等级填得也太高了吧，我还以为是蓄水站要爆了……
content.en: This repair urgency level is way over the top. I thought the Reservoir Station was moments away from complete obliteration.

content.cn: 结果只是通风管里有滴水声。
content.en: Guess what I found. Dripping noises in the vent shafts.

content.cn: 帮你们修好了，是过滤网太长时间不清理导致的。
content.en: I got it fixed. This happens when the filter meshes are not cleaned for too long.

content.cn: 不过你们这架子，这么摆不合规吧？真到了紧急排水的时候，整个蓄水站内部都会泡进水里，物资不都浪费了？
content.en: Gotta say this, though. Your shelves are non-compliant. If we need to run an emergency discharge, the entirety of the Reservoir Station will be soaked in water. Including all the supplies stacked on your shelves.

content.cn: 五年前那场大雨，水不是差点就淹上来了吗？你们心真大啊。
content.en: Remember that downpour five years ago? The one where the flood almost came up? Seriously, why are you so careless?

content.cn: 水温没问题，浑浊度也没问题。
content.en: Water temperature is okay. Turbidity is okay.

content.cn: 微生物的数据好像不太正常，我要排查一下。
content.en: Microbial data doesn't look okay. I have to check it again.

content.cn: 万幸，是我自己设备的问题。
content.en: Lucky me. The problem is caused by my device.

content.cn: 我就说嘛，怎么可能出事。
content.en: I knew the place is super safe. Nothing will happen here.

content.cn: 我们都知道，蓄水站围出的这个大池子，起到的是缓冲作用。
content.en: Everyone knows that the huge basin at the Reservoir Station is meant to buffer against actual floods.

content.cn: 一旦首墩出了什么问题，或者是甚大裂隙有异变，导致水体中出现侵蚀，蓄水站就要第一时间阻止受侵蚀影响的污水流向武陵城……
content.en: If Blight starts showing up in the water due to a problem at the Reservoir Station or Very Large Rift (VLR), the Reservoir Station must immediately contain the Blight-polluted water, and keep it from flowing towards Wuling City.

content.cn: 但近十年，甚大裂隙还没出过什么事。
content.en: However, nothing has happened at the VLR for ten years straight.

content.cn: 想来以后也不会出事。
content.en: I don't think anything is going to happen.

content.cn: 十年前我没把妻子、女儿从北部禁区带出来，也没把同门师兄弟带出来。
content.en: I failed to bring my wife and daughter from the North Wuling Exclusion Zone ten years ago. None of my fellow peers made it out either.

content.cn: 断壁残垣里没剩什么，只剩一株树苗。
content.en: There was nothing left in the ruins except for a sapling.

content.cn: 一转眼，它都这么大了。
content.en: But that tiny thing grew and became massive over the years.

content.cn: 小黄塔长势喜人。
content.en: Yellow Pagoda achieved excellent growth.

content.cn: 红扇较之上月没什么变化。
content.en: Red Fan barely changed compared the data last month.

content.cn: 一帘青稍稍蔫了一点……
content.en: Green Curtain looks a little sick...

content.cn: 都说我悲观，但我坚信生命的真理一定在植物之中。
content.en: Everyone calls me pessimistic, but I believe the truth of life lies within the plants.

content.cn: 看看吧，即便是在这仅有微弱光芒的角落，它们依旧能生长。
content.en: Look at them. They continue to grow, even in dimly lit corners like this.

content.cn: 或许有一天植物连超域都能战胜。
content.en: A day might come when the plants defeat the Æther itself.

content.cn: 之前收到巡卫们同步的信息，不知各位有没有注意到其中有关“特殊烟雾”“天师桩异常”的记录。
content.en: The Watchguards just gave us an update. I don't know if anyone noticed the "special haze" or "malfunctions in the Tianshi Pillars".

content.cn: 无论是城中医生还是巡林员，我想他们接触到的事物一定和侵蚀存在关联。
content.en: City physicians and grove rangers would know. They often deal with things associated with the Blight.

content.cn: 那么我们是否可以合理推断，有某种与超域有关的威胁正在悄悄接近武陵？
content.en: Is it not reasonable, then, to deduce that some Æther-related threat is slowly making its way towards Wuling?

content.cn: 近些日子还请各位多加留心。
content.en: We need to be more vigilant, especially in the coming days.

content.cn: <s>这是我的学生，态度认真，学习能力尚可。</s>
content.en: <s>My disciple is very committed and an eager learner.</s>

content.cn: <s>这是我的学生，可以酌情考虑录取。</s>
content.en: <s>This is my disciple. Admission should be considered.</s>

content.cn: <s>有天赋，肯下苦功夫。</s>
content.en: <s>Talented and willing to invest hard work.</s>

content.cn: 是个好孩子。
content.en: A good kid.

title.en: Incomplete Letter of Recommendation by Tianshi Xi Mo

content.cn: 我劝过他们很多次，没必要把机芯模块设计得如此不严肃。
content.en: I tried to persuade them. There's no pressing need to adopt such lighthearted designs for the core module.

content.cn: 好吧，年轻人喜欢可爱的东西，这我可以理解。
content.en: Sure. Young people like cute things. It's something I can respect.

content.cn: 但想象一下，如果我们真的将这套设备小型化了，用在前线或者什么其他地方，用来消除侵蚀，是什么景象？
content.en: But picture this. If we were to miniaturize this set of equipment and use it for Blight elimination at the frontlines or some other places, do you know how it would look like?

content.cn: 想想全副武装的应龙战士，这种绿油油的小东西跟着他们蹦来蹦去……
content.en: Imagine. Fully armed and outfitted Yinglung soldiers with these green, beany things hopping and prancing around...

content.cn: 别叫我老顽固！咱们的年龄差甚至不到五岁！
content.en: Don't call me an old dolt! We're less than five years apart!

content.cn: 我认真分析了近期的源石虫粪便，确实在其中检测到了息壤成分。
content.en: I ran an in-depth analysis of recent Originium Slug fecal samples, and actually found some Xiranite within them.

content.cn: 这代表着我们已经十分接近成功。
content.en: This means we are very close to success.

content.cn: 以生物作为中转，进行息壤扩散，从而进一步形成无侵蚀区域的计划，是有一定几率成功的。
content.en: Living organisms can serve as intermediate carriers to help with Xiranite dispersion. Our plan of creating a Blight-Free Zone actually has a chance to succeed.

content.cn: 当然，问题的关键在于用什么动物。
content.en: Now, the question is, what type of creatures should we use for dispersal?

content.cn: 我想我们需要早点承认，只有源石虫这种生命力顽强的，才有实现计划的可能。
content.en: I believe we should admit quickly that only Originium Slugs, with their extreme resilience, has a chance to achieve success for our project.

content.cn: 园区里的驮兽、咆兽、彪兽之类的，我建议尽早放归野外。
content.en: As for the burdenbeasts, howlerbeasts, and rakerbeasts we have in the park, I recommend releasing them back to the wilderness.

content.cn: 研究姑且算是成功了，但让息壤以植物的生长为模型，进一步向土壤，向周边环境扩散，这可能有点难度。
content.en: Research seems successful for now. However, giving Xiranite plant growth models and environmental dispersal mechanisms may be quite a challenge.

content.cn: 算法还存在一定缺陷，植物拥有向光性，息壤可没有。再简化一点，也要考虑到源石技艺和植物生长模型的结合。
content.en: We still have issues in the algorithmic scripts. After all, plants tend to be phototropic but not Xiranite. If we were to simplify this, we should consider how plant growth models could be integrated with the Originium Arts.

content.cn: 我们还需要更稳定，更便捷的“领航员”。
content.en: We need a "Navigator" with better stability and agility.

content.cn: 接下来，重点就不在试验园区了，我们的第一阶段已经获得了令人满意的成果，新款的天师桩已经成功落成于野外，我们进一步降低了侵蚀摧毁武陵的可能，这值得庆祝。
content.en: The Test Area will no longer be the focus for our next step. We achieved satisfactory results from phase one. The new Tianshi Pillar has been deployed in the wilderness and further reduced the likelihood of the Blight destroying Wuling. This success should be celebrated.

content.cn: 试验园区的人员可能有所缩减，我预估，下一阶段的研究重点应该在息壤生产这方面，该搬家去材料研究所了。
content.en: They might be moving people out of the Test Area. I have a feeling that the next phase of the research will be focusing on Xiranite production. Well, time to move house to the Institute of Materials Science.

content.cn: 息壤的应用……动物、植物、水环境三个方面的应用，可以作为园区的新研究方向。当然，有关天师桩进一步迭代优化的研究也不能落下。
content.en: Zoological, botanical, and hydrological applications of Xiranite ... these three fields may be the new focus for the Test Area to work on. Of course, the project on Tianshi Pillar upgrades and optimizations must be kept going as well.

content.cn: 息壤汇聚形成的，近似花苞的物体。看似枯朽的息壤结构，却仍拥有一缕春光。它于武陵的万千灯火中盛放，轻轻地吹去了甚大裂隙的恐怖阴霾。
content.en: A bud-shaped congregation of Xiranite material. Though the structure looks wilted, it carries a hint of spring. Let it bloom amidst the lights of Wuling, and dispel the fearful gloom cast by the Very Large Rift.

content.cn: 管道还没修好！！！我很快就会回来继续修！！！不要在上面踩来踩去！！！很危险的！！！
content.en: The pipelines are NOT fixed yet!!! We'll be back to get it done! DO NOT STEP ON IT!!! IT'S DANGEROUS!!!

content.cn: <image>Reading/reading_sm2l6m1_yujian</image>
content.en: <image>Reading/reading_sm2l6m1_yujian</image>

content.cn: 半掩埋在泥土中的古旧玉简，看起来已有百多年的历史。玉简上的刻字绝大部分已模糊不清，但尚有一行字可以辨认——
content.en: Ancient jade slips half-buried in the mud. They look over a century old. Most of the inscriptions are no longer legible, but one particular line bears recognizable words —

content.cn: “需看后来人”，刻痕犹在。
content.en: The writings that stood the test of time read: "Our hope is for posterity."

content.cn: 我已潜入应龙关。
content.en: I've infiltrated Yinglung Pass.

content.cn: 神秘未知的应龙关，危机四伏的应龙关……
content.en: Yinglung Pass, a place of mystery, filled with the unknown, where danger lurks around every corner...

content.cn: 从菈梵朵玛跑来武陵这么久，终于让我溜进来了。
content.en: I've spent ages snooping around Wuling since I left La Fantoma, and I finally found my chance to slip in.

content.cn: 不愧是应龙特勤队，防守得够严密的，可惜还是让我靠潜水溜进来了。
content.en: Gotta hand it to the Yinglungs. They got every place covered. But they did not expect a pro with diving gear.

content.cn: 那个画画的还说什么潜水也没戏，绝对进不来……
content.en: That painter told me that diving wouldn't work and it was impossible to get in...

content.cn: 风险越大，收益越大。要是拍到什么不得了的照片，我看杂志社的那些人还敢开除我吗？
content.en: High risk, high returns. No one at the magazine office would dare fire me once I get a few amazing photos!

content.cn: 但这地方也确实够怪的，从我进来开始，就好像有人盯着我一样。
content.en: But the vibe's a little off for this place. I can't help but feel that someone's constantly looking at me.

content.cn: 刚才还在那里的应龙是不
content.en: Wait. There was an Yinglung here, did

content.cn: 警告——你已进入应龙关区域。
content.en: WARNING — YOU ARE NOW IN YINGLUNG PASS

content.cn: 宏山科学院武陵科学发展区已将此区域设立为封闭管制区。
content.en: The Wuling Scientific Developmental District of Hongshan Academy of Sciences (HAS) has marked this area as a closed EXCLUSION ZONE.

content.cn: 严禁任何未经宏山科学院武陵区管代允许的人员进入。
content.en: ACCESS IS STRICTLY PROHIBITED for any personnel not authorized by the HAS Viceroy of Wuling.

content.cn: 所有无关人员请立即退出至边界标识外。
content.en: All unauthorized personnel must leave this area at once and remain outside the demarcated boundary.

content.cn: 擅自闯入者将视为违反《环带公约》规定，应龙特勤队有权对其进行武力驱逐。
content.en: Trespassing is a violation of the Band Accord. TRESPASSERS WILL BE FORCIBLY REMOVED by the Yinglung Special Task Force.

content.cn: 经过实地调研，对目前应龙关的环境进行评估。
content.en: The field survey has been completed. The following is an environmental assessment of the Yinglung Pass (YLP) area.

content.cn: 应龙关区域的超域污染物水平对比142年已显著下降，但仍存在长期生态风险。
content.en: Levels of ambient Æther pollutants in YLP have significantly dropped compared to the data collected in Year 142. However, long-term ecological risks persist.

content.cn: 发现几株对应龙关区域污染表现出良好耐受性的耐污染物植物，水体暂未发现明显的污染物。
content.en: Several plants with strong pollution resistance have been identified in YLP. No significant contaminants have yet to be found in various water bodies.

content.cn: 总体而言，该区域正呈现“自然复苏”与“持续污染”并存的复杂状态，建议严格限制人类在此区域的活动。
content.en: Overall, YLP is currently undergoing a complicated state where natural remediation and persistent pollution occur simultaneously. We recommend applying strict restrictions for access and limiting various activities in the area.
