content.en: <@nar.enter></>

content.cn: 批注：了不起，真是了不起，看到这里我已经发现了十个新词，我给院里发的文章都没写过这么多。
content.en: REVIEW COMMENTS: Incredible. Truly. By this point of reading, I've counted ten flashy new terms. A full length paper of mine for HQ barely invents half as much.

content.cn: 回复：好的老师，我改改。
content.en: RESPONSE: Of course, my mentor. I'll work on a revision.

content.cn: 批注：这段是整篇写的最好的一段。只是，记得删掉，偏题了。
content.en: REVIEW COMMENTS: This is the best written part of the paper. But it is also way off topic. DELETE IT.

content.cn: 数据录入完成，交给老师和学长学姐他们分析就好。
content.en: Data writing complete. I'll just submit them so my mentor and seniors can run the analysis.

content.cn: 时间差不多了，我得赶紧回营地帮老师拿测量设备。
content.en: Time is almost up. I gotta head back to camp and help my mentor bring up the measuring instruments.

content.cn: 等等，桥对面是什么东西滚过去了？
content.en: Wait. What's on the other side of the bridge? Did something just roll across?

content.cn: 天使吗？不对，哪儿有这样的天使。
content.en: Is it an Aggelos? No way. This place shouldn't have an Aggeloid problem.

content.cn: 有点像源石虫，但这里会有源石虫吗？我记得在来应龙关的路上老师有和我们讲过……
content.en: Looks like an Originium Slug. But are there slugs here? I think I heard my mentor talk about them on our way to Yinglung Pass...

content.cn: 想不起来了，早知道不在路上改论文了。
content.en: I can barely remember the details. I shouldn't be revising my report during the ride.

content.cn: 对面的学长好像还没发现，我要不要提醒他……
content.en: I don't think my senior noticed the thing. Maybe I should remind him...

content.cn: <@nar.enter></>
content.en: <@nar.enter></>

content.cn: 学长踢了那个东西一脚，可能是实验的一部分。
content.en: My senior gave it a kick. Maybe it's part of the experiment.

content.cn: 时间过得好快，上一次和老师来应龙关都是三年前了。
content.en: Time really flies. Three years have passed since my mentor and I last visited Yinglung Pass.

content.cn: 想起上一次，我作为新人被安排帮老师拿测量设备。
content.en: During the last visit, I was just a freshman tasked with carrying the measuring instruments for my mentor.

content.cn: 每次都是，把手向我一伸，哈哈，我和老师就面对面地呆站在那儿。
content.en: Mister mentor would just reach for something. And I ... heheh ... just stood there. Awkward...

content.cn: 我哪知道他要什么，连续拿了好几个设备都不对，他才唉声叹气地自己动手拿……
content.en: How was I supposed to know which instrument he wants. I did try a few times and got every one of them wrong. He sighed with frustration and helped himself instead.

content.cn: 唉，课题完全没有头绪，只能待三天，我真能做出来吗？
content.en: Ugh. I don't know what I should focus on. I only got three days at this place. Will I get to find my research topic?

content.cn: 对面那位是新来的同学吧，望着我干嘛，现在就愁眉苦脸的，等会儿不知道要愁成什么样。
content.en: Why can't that freshman disciple stop staring at me? Yeah, well. Have fun looking troubled and confused. You don't know what's coming.

content.cn: <@nar.enter></>
content.en: <@nar.enter></>

content.cn: 连源石虫都来笑话我，气死我了！
content.en: Blight my life! Even the Originium Slugs are making fun of me.

content.cn: 这么光滑的切面……想必是前辈们在这里和蚀影打斗时造成的吧。
content.en: Such smooth cutting plane... Must have been made by senior Yinglungs who fought the Blightshades.

content.cn: 我已经能想象出来当时的场景了，那蚀影从侵蚀瘴中走出来，一位前辈拔刀上前，刀光剑影之后，将蚀影连同它身后的装置一起斩断……
content.en: I can almost imagine how the battle went. The Blightshade emerged from the Miasma and one of us went to meet it. A single cut sliced right through the Blightshade and the machinery behind it...

content.cn: 好一场酣畅淋漓的战斗！
content.en: What a battle it must be!

content.cn: <@nar.mark>xx</>月<@nar.mark>xx</>日 一切正常。
content.en: <@nar.mark>XX</>/<@nar.mark>XX</>. All is well.

content.cn: <@nar.mark>xx</>月<@nar.mark>xx</>日 发现侵蚀瘴，未发现蚀影。已控制侵蚀瘴。
content.en: <@nar.mark>XX</>/<@nar.mark>XX</>. Blight Miasma found. No Blightshades. Blight Miasma is then contained.

content.cn: <@nar.mark>xx</>月<@nar.mark>xx</>日 遭遇三只天使，已消灭。未发现侵蚀瘴。
content.en: <@nar.mark>XX</>/<@nar.mark>XX</>. 3 Aggeloi encountered and then neutralized. No Blight Miasma found.

content.cn: <@nar.mark>xx</>月<@nar.mark>xx</>日 一切正常。
content.en: <@nar.mark>XX</>/<@nar.mark>XX</>. All is well.

content.cn: <@nar.mark>xx</>月<@nar.mark>xx</>日 发现几只小蟠兽，看起来是在躲避天使时跑进来的。为防止天使进入应龙关，已将关外的天使消灭。小蟠兽暂时收容进铁笼中，以便观察。
content.en: <@nar.mark>XX</>/<@nar.mark>XX</>. Several pantailbeasts found. The critters probably entered this place to escape the Aggeloi. To establish an Aggelos-free area, clusters outside the Pass have been eliminated. The pantails will be temporarily kept in shelter cages for observation.

content.cn: <@nar.mark>xx</>月<@nar.mark>xx</>日 <s>一切正常，</s>确认小蟠兽身上没有携带任何危险物质<s>，随时可以放生</s>。突发暴雨，北部禁区的危险物质可能会泄漏。小蟠兽暂时不能放生。
content.en: <@nar.mark>XX</>/<@nar.mark>XX</>. <s>All is well.</s> We have confirmed that the pantailbeasts are not carriers for dangerous materials<s> and can be released any time</s>. Sudden downpour. There may be leakages of dangerous materials in North Wuling EZ. The pantails must not be released for now.

content.cn: <@nar.mark>xx</>月<@nar.mark>xx</>日 一切正常，昨天的暴雨没有造成任何影响。再次确认小蟠兽没有携带北部禁区的危险物质，已完成放生。
content.en: <@nar.mark>XX</>/<@nar.mark>XX</>. All is well. The sudden downpour yesterday has no negative influences. The pantails have been verified again and are not carriers for dangerous materials of the North Wuling EZ. The creatures have been released back into the wild.

title.cn: 应龙特勤队的行动记录

content.cn: 区域：应龙关。
content.en: AREA: Yinglung Pass

content.cn: 线材接口松动，重新接上就行。
content.en: Cable connection is loose. Just reconnect.

content.cn: 这么简单的问题，难道应龙特勤队就不能自己解决吗？让我跑这么远……
content.en: Can't the YSTF manage this simple fix on their own? To think I came all this way just to plug something back in...

content.cn: 唉，本来今天可以睡个懒觉的，只能回去睡回笼觉咯。
content.en: Ugh. I thought I could steal a nap today. Welp, I guess I'll only get to sleep at home tonight.

content.cn: 算了，来都来了，顺便看看还能不能帮他们修修别的东西吧。
content.en: Whatever. Since I'm here already, I might as well look around see if they got other things that need fixing.

content.cn: 这些人怎么回事，怎么弄坏的东西这么多，顺便修修也不是这么个顺便法啊！
content.en: What is wrong with these people? They're literally doing everything they can to wreck everything they have! THEIR FIXES ARE ALL WRONG!

content.cn: 还算他们讲道理，请我吃了饭。
content.en: Welp, at least they're generous. I got some free food.

content.cn: 不过他们吃的口味也太重了，油也不少，难怪之前不管我怎么喂我闺女都吃不胖，也难怪她以前总嫌我炒的菜没味儿，我家的饭菜和这里比起来那可清淡多了。
content.en: But their food is a little too strong and oily for my taste. Maybe this is why my baby girl can't gain any weight. She kept complaining how my dishes are tasteless. Indeed. My cooking is really mild compared to the Yinglung fare.

content.cn: 找机会问他们要个减肥秘籍。
content.en: Maybe I should ask them for their secret slimming formula.

content.cn: 应龙关已经能够应对北部禁区的侵蚀影响，但还有很多改善的空间。
content.en: Yinglung Pass is now capable of handling the Blight of the North Wuling Exclusion Zone, but there's plenty of room for improvement.

content.cn: 再扩建下去……风险不是现在的我们所能承担得起的。
content.en: If they keep expanding the place ... the risks would go far beyond what we could bear.

content.cn: 也没有那么多的物资和人力同时进行应龙关的扩建和武陵城的建设了……
content.en: We don't have enough resources and people to expand Yinglung Pass and build Wuling City at the same time...

content.cn: 我们已经做了所有能做的事……扩建也好，改造也罢，交给后来人吧。
content.en: We've done all that we could... I say we leave the expansions and rebuilding to posterity.

content.cn: 好水，真是好水。
content.en: The water is good. Very good indeed.

content.cn: 自山巅落下，洗净应龙关的污秽，带着泥沙冲入深渊……
content.en: It cascades from the mountaintop, purges the taint from Yinglung Pass, and carries the sediments into the deep gorges...

content.cn: 深渊……
content.en: The deep gorges...

content.cn: 我被调来应龙关少说也有个七八年，这水究竟流去了哪儿？
content.en: I've been garrisoned at Yinglung Pass for seven years? Or maybe eight. Where did all that water go?

content.cn: 应龙关下面，究竟还有些什么？
content.en: Is there something beneath Yinglung Pass?

content.cn: （一段被转为文字的录音）
content.en: (Text transcriptions of an audio recording)

content.cn: 这天桩是不是坏了？怎么到处乱飞？
content.en: Is this sky pole damaged? It's just darting about at random.

content.cn: 不应该吧，这个和支援铁誓军的是同一型号的设备，没那么容易坏啊。
content.en: I don't think so. We actually supply the Oathkeepers with the same model. They're designed to be tough.

content.cn: 你会修？那你试试吧。
content.en: You know how to fix it? Alright. Give it a shot.

content.cn: 等会儿，你真会修吗，天桩上的灯都灭了，要不……正常现象吗？行……吧，那你继续。
content.en: Wait. Do you really know how to fix this? Its lights just went out. Maybe we should... Oh. It's supposed to happen? Fine... Just carry on.

content.cn: 我说什么来着，这下好了，彻底趴窝儿不动了。还……还在可控范围内吗？
content.en: Oh yeah, great work, genius. It's not moving anymore. Can ... can we still save it?

content.cn: 呦，真让你小子修好了，不赖啊，加入应龙特勤队之前你是干嘛的？
content.en: WOW. You actually pulled it off, kid. Not bad. What did you do before joining the Yinglungs?

content.cn: 等等，你有没有闻到一股烧焦味？不对，天桩冒烟了！
content.en: Wait. Do you smell something burning. Sheesh. There's smoke coming out of the sky pole.

content.cn: 算了算了你别弄了，回去填修理单等武陵城里的职工来修吧。
content.en: Just stop trying already, kid. Fill out a repair application form. Get Wuling to send a proper technician here.

content.cn: 区域：应龙关。
content.en: AREA: Yinglung Pass

content.cn: 这次终于来了个有挑战的活儿，源石电路板损坏，这种精细活儿才该叫我嘛。
content.en: Finally. An actual challenge. Damaged Originium circuitry. They should have given me precision repair work right from the get-go.

content.cn: 现在的设备真是不顶用，我记得天师府学院里也有好多类似的设备，经常喊我去修理。
content.en: Modern equipment hardly lasts. They got plenty of stuff like this in the Tianshi Bureau Academy. And they have an endless string of jobs for me.

content.cn: 想当初建应龙关的时候，我闺女用的东西虽然没有现在这些设备精细，但耐用多了。
content.en: Back when they first built Yinglung Pass, my girl was issued less refined equipment. But those could at least take a beating.

content.cn: 就算经常跑去什么高深度区域都不会坏。
content.en: Her equipment hardly broke down. Even after multiple missions in high Depth areas.

content.cn: 看见了一台天桩，多好啊，总是往危险的地方冲，一刻不停，多么勤奋的小家伙，跟我闺女一样。
content.en: I saw a sky pole. Beautiful gadget. It's always rushing to the most dangerous places without break or rest. Hardworking little thing. Just like my darling baby girl.

content.cn: 飘在空中收集环境数据，不知道的怕是会以为连天桩都会找地方“摸鳞”了。
content.en: They hover around endlessly to collect ambient data. People who don't know better might think the sky poles are "slacking off".

content.cn: 真是和我闺女一样。在她加入应龙特勤队后，就总是很忙，到处在跑，也不知道休息。
content.en: They're just like my darling girl. She's always busy and running around after joining YSTF. Never knew a moment of rest.

content.cn: （一段被转为文字的音频文件）
content.en: (Text transcriptions of an audio recording)

content.cn: 来应龙关的第二天就一个人跑那么远，休息时间也不好好休息。
content.en: Day two at Yinglung Pass and you already found the audacity to come all the way here. Why don't you take a proper break?

content.cn: 哟，画啥呢？这画笔看起来不错啊。
content.en: Oho. What are you painting? Say, this brush looks pretty nice.

content.cn: 从一位画家那买的？之前我发现一个画家在外面溜达，不知道是不是同一个……
content.en: Did you buy this from some famous painter? I actually saw one wandering outside this place. Maybe it's that one...

content.cn: 这是你画的？你认识他？可他不是已经……
content.en: You painted this? Do you know him? But isn't he...

content.cn: ……原来你是他弟弟，所以你才大老远从本部跑来这儿。
content.en: Oh, okay. It's your younger brother. No wonder you came here all the way from HQ.

content.cn: 哦，我来找你是因为我们看了你的档案，今天是你生日……
content.en: Yeah, I came looking for you because we read your file. It's your birthday today...

content.cn: 我回去让他们撤了。
content.en: I'll tell them to cancel it.

content.cn: 不用吗？好吧，那我们等你回来。
content.en: No? Really? Okay, we'll wait. The party won't start without you.

content.cn: 谁能想到应龙关十年前居然是一片荒芜。
content.en: Nobody could tell that Yinglung Pass was just a piece of desolation ten years ago.

content.cn: 在本部读书时，我看那些老照片，里面哪有这么多的草啊树的，都是枯死的植物。
content.en: I remember those old photos I saw when I studied back at HQ. The place didn't even have living vegetation. Just dead, withered stuff.

content.cn: 现在的应龙关到处绿油油的，多好。要我说，这应龙关的景色，完全不输武陵城。
content.en: Yinglung Pass is now a lush and verdant place. It's wonderful. In fact, I think the local scenery is on par with that of Wuling City.

content.cn: 唯一不好的地方就是这路纵横交错……和老师走散后我就迷路了。
content.en: But there's a tiny problem. The criss-crossing roads... I'm lost. It happened soon after I got separated from my mentor.

content.cn: 早知道不边走边改论文了，完全没注意到老师和那几个应龙队员已经离开了。
content.en: I should've left paper revisions for later instead of working on them along the way. I totally didn't notice my mentor leaving with the Yinglungs.

content.cn: 事已至此，先改论文吧。
content.en: Well, since I'm here anyways, might as well focus on revising my paper.

content.cn: 刻在墙上的名字，便是应龙关的意义。
content.en: The names carved onto the walls ... represent the meaning behind Yinglung Pass.

content.cn: …………死了也得有遗体吧，什么东西都没留下，到底是死了还是跑了？
content.en: Dead people tend to leave bodies. If we find nothing, we can't be sure if the dude croaked or just slipped away.

content.cn: 没有破坏束缚用的装置，也没有任何在挣脱过程中留下的痕迹，就算是逃了……又是如何办到的？
content.en: I found nothing that could be used to cut the bindings, no signs of struggle or escape. If he did escape ... how did he do it?

content.cn: 空气中还有一股像是什么东西被烧焦了的味道，这儿也没有可燃物吧，总不能是……
content.en: I caught this burning smell in the air. But there are no flammable materials nearby. Can it be...?

content.cn: 不行，这里的情况很不对劲，得赶紧向上面汇报，太诡异了。
content.en: None of this makes sense. I must escalate this. This is too unnatural.

content.cn: 我才注意到，这居然是用水墨画的吗……
content.en: I just noticed. Is this an ink painting...?

content.cn: 不是我不走了，就是……你看这桥，像不像流动的水墨。
content.en: Well, I can keep going, but ... it's the bridge ... it looks like it's made out of flowing ink.

content.cn: 这么高，要是掉下去了，岂不是……
content.en: And it's a long way down. Falling off is gonna...

content.cn: 是，我们已经走过很多座这种桥了，但万……万一呢，我才刚毕业，我还不想……
content.en: Yeah. We did cross many bridges like this. But what if ... you know, there's a slim chance that... Look, I just graduated and I don't wanna...

content.cn: 我当然知道应龙特勤队走了十年了。
content.en: Of course I know the Yinglungs have been using the bridge for ten years.

content.cn: 不去想还好，但我现在知道了这是水墨……
content.en: I just wish that I never knew that the bridges were just ink paintings. Now I can't stop thinking about that...

content.cn: 代理人是允许我们走这座桥，但我还是怕啊……
content.en: Sure, I know the proxy has given us permission to cross the bridge but... Look, I'm just friggin' scared...

content.cn: 云雾既开，我应该找个时间再去看看。
content.en: The cloud has cleared. I should check out the place again once I have the time.

content.cn: 不知深山雪林之中那位老雪祀现状如何。
content.en: I wonder if the old Snowpriestess in the deep snowy forest is doing okay.

content.cn: （一段被转为文字的录音）
content.en: (Text transcriptions of an audio recording)

content.cn: 大娘，感谢您的好意，但我们真不能收，请您赶快随运输队一起离开，这儿很危险。
content.en: Thank you, lady, but we cannot accept this. Also, this is a dangerous place. Please leave with the transport team.

content.cn: 这算什么话，你们还是孩子呢。大娘没什么好东西，就只有这些肉啊菜的，看你们瘦的哟……
content.en: Come now, kid. It's just a few packs of fillet cuts and vegetables. Look at you. All skin and bones. Take these and put on some weight already...

content.cn: 唉您找队长也没用……大娘您别……您别……
content.en: Lady, please. The Captain won't accept it either... Let's just ... ugh...

content.cn: 骑士竞技？还是负重越野？当然，如果大家不介意，也可以在不考虑赛制赛程的情况下和我们的库兰塔朋友进行长跑竞技。
content.en: Knights Major? Or fully encumbered steeplechase? And if everyone is okay with this, we can consider a long-distance event with our Kuranta friends. We'll also relax the rules and rankings.

content.cn: 重点不在于项目，我亲爱的朋友们，重点在于，假如三大阵营认可并有意推进，我们说不定能在三五年内真正拥有一项全文明环带范围的综合体育赛事。这代表着我们的政治、经济、文化基础已经足以承托这样一项伟业。
content.en: It's not about the competition, my dear friends. The focus is on getting a nod or even support from the Big Three. We might be able to organize a Band-wide integrated sports event within three to five years. This would prove that our political, economic, and cultural foundations have become strong enough to support such a great endeavor.

content.cn: 我们的前路充满希望。
content.en: Our way to the future is fully paved with hope.

content.cn: 当然，我们都知道，最近人们的目光主要集中在北极，恐怕有关体育赛事的议题将要延后了。
content.en: Of course we do know that people are focused on the recent turn of events in the Polar North. Discussions on sports events and competitions have been postponed.

content.cn: 不能再退了，指挥、监测工作可以在这里进行。这道防线必须要立起来。
content.en: No more retreats. This is where we command our forces and surveillance work. A defensive line must be built.

content.cn: 我知道这个距离依旧有危险，但不顶住这里，侵蚀出了山口就会散开。
content.en: I know we're still too close, but if we fail to hold this position, the Blight would pour out of the mountain pass and spread.

content.cn: 咱们的命换更多人的命，还算值得。
content.en: Our lives for the lives of many more. It's a great deal.

content.cn: 我已被侵蚀四面围困，就要死了。
content.en: The Blight got me surrounded. I'm gonna die soon.

content.cn: 我亲眼看着厨子向前多走了一步，只是一步，他就这么“融化”在“烟气”里。
content.en: The chef just took one extra step. Just one! And he just ... melted into the miasma.

content.cn: 倒还不错，好一道“疠瘴横流”的恶景。临死前能见识到肉眼都难观测、边界亦不明显的侵蚀，也算是挺值。
content.en: But there's something good coming out of this. I witnessed a hellish vision: A giant mass of rolling miasma that consumes all in its path. A form of Blight whose boundaries are ill-defined, one that could hardly be seen by the unaided eye. This was all worth it.

content.cn: 研究了这么多年侵蚀，总想着能不能进一步利用它，最后也因它而死，死得其所吧。
content.en: I've studied the Blight for so many years. I was obsessed with harnessing it for better use. And now this thing is going to kill me. A death I deserve.

content.cn: 逃到这里时没看到老竺，我这老兄弟本领高超，应该能活下来。
content.en: I managed to reach this place but I don't see Zhu anywhere. That old buddy of mine has some pretty awesome skills. I bet he got out of here safely.

content.cn: 有几把木剑。孩子们长不大了。
content.en: I see a few wooden swords... These children would never see adulthood.

content.cn: 我们不可能永远输给你，去你妈的。
content.en: *Yanese expletive*. You can't beat us forever.

content.cn: 虽然你我多年未见，但寒暄的话我还是少说些为好，你不爱读，我不爱写。
content.en: We haven't met for a while, but I'll keep the pleasantries short. You hate reading them, and I hate writing them.

content.cn: 上次来信，你说谈剑堂就像个幼儿园，说我放着大好的风光不看，放着大好的前程不去，非要一辈子困死在武陵，当幼儿园园长。我懒得驳你。
content.en: From your last letter, you described Tanjian Hall like it's a kindergarten. You chastised me for ignoring the bigger picture, abandoning a better future, getting myself stuck in Wuling, and accepting my role as a kindergarten principal. I won't even bother shredding your misconceptions.

content.cn: 你也和我学过几手剑术，应该知道，教授孩子们文武技艺可不会让剑长出锈花。
content.en: You learned a few stances of swordmancy from me. You should know better than to assume that teaching children their letters and fighting arts would blunt my edge.

content.cn: 你看着他们一招一式软绵绵的不成样子，看着他们把“削剑式”写成“消剑式”，倒确实会气得人笑出声来。但日子一天天过着，孩子们的木剑变成铁剑时，你就能知道“传承”二字的重量了。
content.en: Some of them could barely complete a move at first. Any instructor would be frustrated to see their slices wobble and shake. But as the days went by and wooden swords were replaced by ferrium ones, you'd know the true weight and meaning of "legacy" and "heritage".

content.cn: 若是不信，你就来武陵看看。
content.en: If you do not believe me, then come to Wuling.

content.cn: <@nar.enter></>
content.en: <@nar.enter></>

content.cn: <@nar.right>竺</>
content.en: <@nar.right>Zhu</>

content.cn: 横六竖三，十八格金匣，如今满了三分之一。
content.en: A six-by-three golden war case of eighteen grids, six of which have been filled.

content.cn: 我的学长学姐，学弟学妹，大多尸骨无存，但他们曾和我说过，如果他们死了，就把能找回来的武器放在“能看到希望”的地方。
content.en: Most of my seniors and juniors have perished, and most of them even failed to leave a body behind. However, they told me that I could try to salvage the weapons of the fallen and keep them at a place where they could "witness the light of hope".

content.cn: 我思来想去，又与竺先生商议，最合适的地方就是这处谈剑堂。就让他们看着孩子们学艺、成长吧。
content.en: I pondered for a while and discussed this matter with Instructor Zhu. Tanjian Hall seems to be the most fitting place. They should see the children practice, train, and grow.

content.cn: 总录兵器如下：
content.en: The following lists their weapons:

content.cn: 观火。长剑。长二尺七寸，刃赤，穗白，折于淬剑荡，有剑格收回。
content.en: Fire Watcher. Longsword, 2 feet and 7 inches long with a crimson edge and furnished with a white tassel. Fallen at Sword Quenching Marsh. Fully recovered and kept in a grid.

content.cn: 彪尾。长枪。长一丈，尖分四棱，缨为彪绒，折于北地，仅缨穗得归。
content.en: Raker Tail. Spear, 10 feet long with a pyramidal tip, decorated with a plume of raker fur. Fallen at the North. Only the spear plume has been recovered.

content.cn: 至此，总录残兵六柄。
content.en: As of now, a total of six weapons of the fallen have been categorized.

content.cn: 《<@nar.mark>……</>息壤<@nar.mark>……</>实验的<@nar.mark>……</>通知》
content.en: Notification Regarding <@nar.mark>...</> Xiranite <@nar.mark>...</> Testing <@nar.mark>...</>

content.cn: <@nar.mark>………………</>请各位天师在<@nar.mark>……</>月<@nar.mark>……</>日前将息壤环境数据<@nar.mark>……………………</>至<@nar.mark>……</>处。
content.en: <@nar.mark>............</> We request all Tianshi <@nar.mark>......</> Ambient Xiranite data <@nar.mark>......</> to <@nar.mark>............</> before the date of <@nar.mark>......</>.

content.cn: 即日起，研究所将<@nar.mark>……</>请各位<@nar.mark>……</>以免<@nar.mark>……</>。
content.en: From this day forth, the Research Labs <@nar.mark>......</>. We kindly request everyone to <@nar.mark>......</> to avoid <@nar.mark>......</>.

content.cn: 架上书籍，有价值者皆已回收，不必再费时。
content.en: All valuable books and publications once offered on this shelf have been safely stashed away. There is no need to search through the rest.

content.cn: 纸张易腐，见此留言者，烦请再留字，以告后来人。
content.en: Paper is not a medium made to last. If you read this memo, please make a new copy and replace the old one. For our posterity.

content.cn: 甲二十一：十年了。我真的快忘了十年前这里长什么样子，我只记得当时，这边靠着墙的地方，有一排告示栏。
content.en: A21: Ten years. I'd almost forgotten what this place looks like. I could only remember that there used to be a bulletin board right against this wall.

content.cn: 甲二十一：那天组里说实验完了会有合影，我在群里说，大家记得穿正式点。大家都说没什么正式衣服可穿，我说那好歹挑个好背景，他们都让我挑。
content.en: A21: The team said we're taking a group photo after the testing. I even told my labmates to wear something nice. They replied by saying nobody has formal attire. So I suggested taking a photo at a nice place, then they made me choose.

content.cn: 甲二十一：我一眼就挑中告示牌这里，我当时想着，这里光线好，宽敞，调调角度，组里人多，一个也别落下了……
content.en: A21: The bulletin board was the first thing that came to mind. It had good lighting and open spaces. A photographer would only need to work on the angles. And we could fit everybody in our huge team.

content.cn: 灶师：行了老刘，换个话题吧。
content.en: Stovemaster: Come on, Old Liu. Talk about sth else.

content.cn: 甲二十一：我得说呀。
content.en: A21: But I gotta get it off my chest.

content.cn: 甲二十一：“砰”的一声，就活下来我一个。先是天崩地裂，我源石技艺还算不错，裹着石头撞出研究所，从坡上滚下来，然后我回头，就看见组里一半人融在侵蚀里。那几个告示牌飞得到处都是，有一个掉在我脚边，我记着上面的字，是停电通知……
content.en: A21: There was this KABAM and I was the only one left alive. It ripped apart the entire place like paper. I'm decent with the Arts, so I quickly encrusted myself in stone, rammed my way out of the Labs, and rolled down the slope. I turned around and saw half of the team melting into the Blight. The notices posted on the board flew all over the place. One of them rested near my feet. I remember it being a power outage notification...

content.cn: 甲二十一：后来就算我不敢再吃冰淇淋，不敢看冰融化，那些死了的人，他们的脸我都忘了，但通知上的字我一个也没忘。我不知道为什么，但我每天晚上都能梦见它，就掉在我脚边上。每一个字清清楚楚。
content.en: A21: That sight is terrible. I can hardly bring myself to eat ice cream ... or even see ice melting. So many died, and I can hardly recall their faces. But that notice ... I don't know why but I still remember it... It keeps showing up in my dreams, resting near my feet every time. And I still see every single word.

content.cn: 甲二十一：“因维修电路，研究所存放间停电两小时”。我真不知道为什么，但这几个字追着我跑追了十年，我真忘不了。
content.en: A21: "A 2-HOUR power outage has been scheduled for the Research Labs storage room for circuitry repairs." I don't know why, but these words haunted me for ten whole years. They've been burned into my memories.

content.cn: 甲二十一：我没想过我能回来。
content.en: A21: I never knew I could make it out.

content.cn: 灶师：我也没想过。当年我从这里带走的只有一株树苗，我把它种在了蓄水站，还以为这辈子只能对着它追忆家人。
content.en: Stovemaster: Me too. I only managed to bring a sapling with me back then. I planted it at the Reservoir Station. I thought it was my only way to remember my family for the rest of my life.

content.cn: 灶师：现在我们真的回来了，所以老刘，往前看，别回头。
content.en: Stovemaster: We've returned. This time for real. You gotta look forward, Old Liu. Don't dwell in the past.

content.cn: 在这些箱子里发现了一些工业零件。
content.en: The crates contain several industrial machine parts.

content.cn: 最开始还以为是事故前打算用在科考站扩建的，但仔细一看，好像是用在息壤发散装置上的零件，那应该是息壤散布项目的相关物品。
content.en: On first glance, the parts were mistakenly treated as tools for the pre-disaster Science Station expansion project. Closer inspection revealed that they might be parts of a Xiranite-dispersing machine, making them items related to the Xiranite dispersal project.

content.cn: 记得送到园区那边，看看是不是哪位研究丙型天师桩和相关项目的老师留下的旧物件。
content.en: Remember to take them to the Test Area. See if they belong to any of the Tianshi working on projects related to the Type-C Tianshi Pillars.

content.cn: 记得说话委婉点，人家大概率睹物思人，你们别说出什么“哎呀，给您把遗物送回来了”之类的“吉祥话”。
content.en: And PLEASE use some tact. The sight of the salvage might trigger memories. The last thing I want is one of you spouting blightery like: "Check this out! We found your stuff!"

content.cn: 可惜，这些设备损坏得很彻底。
content.en: Unfortunately, these machines have been utterly wrecked.

content.cn: 检查列表上对“抵抗侵蚀潮的研究资料”的回收怕是没戏唱了。
content.en: I don't think we'll ever complete this salvage checklist item: "Blight Tide containment research data".

content.cn: 部分余料已回收。
content.en: We did salvage the rest of the items, though.

content.cn: 勉强算是<@nar.mark>…………</>物资<@nar.mark>………………</>囤积<@nar.mark>…………</>
content.en: I guess I can treat this as <@nar.mark>...……...</> supplies <@nar.mark>..................</> should gather and store some <@nar.mark>............</>

content.cn: 活下来已经很<@nar.mark>…………</>
content.en: It's already a <@nar.mark>............</> that I survived.

content.cn: 不远处<@nar.mark>应该也</>有<@nar.mark>像我这样的</>幸存者，我得<@nar.mark>想想办法与他</>会合。
content.en: I think there <@nar.mark>might be</> other survivors <@nar.mark>like me</> nearby. I gotta find out how to <@nar.mark>meet up with him</>.

content.cn: 但有一点很奇怪，我好像看<@nar.mark>……</>视线。
content.en: There's some weird thing, though. I think I saw <@nar.mark>......</> of my vision.

content.cn: 视线是<@nar.mark>…………</>
content.en: My vision is <@nar.mark>............</>

content.cn: 这不可能，他们<@nar.mark>这是什</>么状态？
content.en: Impossible. What on Talos <@nar.mark>is wrong with</> these people?

content.cn: 活着？还是死了……但我感觉<@nar.mark>他们就</>只像是一道影子。
content.en: Are they living or dead...? I got this feeling that <@nar.mark>they're</> just shadows.

content.cn: 但或许……<@nar.mark>这是</>脱困的办法。
content.en: But <@nar.mark>this</> might be ... a way out of here.

content.cn: 如果我也能变成他们这样的状态，是不是<@nar.mark>就能</>越过那<@nar.mark>些该死</>的侵蚀……
content.en: If I can turn myself into a shadow, maybe I <@nar.mark>can</> get through that <@nar.mark>friggin'</> Blight...

content.cn: 是否可以通过源石技艺，实现这一点。
content.en: Maybe I can use the Originium Arts to transform myself.

content.cn: 是否可以通过源石，进行模拟？
content.en: Can I create a personal simulacrum with Originium?

content.cn: 有广播声。
content.en: I hear the broadcast.

content.cn: 应该是搜救行动<@nar.mark>开始</>了。
content.en: I think they're <@nar.mark>starting</> a search and rescue operation.

content.cn: 但我没办法<@nar.mark>通知</>到外界，侵蚀<@nar.mark>在进一步</>合围，<@nar.mark>或许我</>很快就会被完全<@nar.mark>包裹起</>来。
content.en: But I can't <@nar.mark>get in touch</> with anyone out there. The Blight is <@nar.mark>encroaching</> on all sides. <@nar.mark>I might</> be completely <@nar.mark>swallowed</> up soon.

content.cn: 我必须想想办法，因为抗侵蚀潮研究项目，这里的息壤材料还算耐用……
content.en: I gotta think of a way. The Blight Tide research project left some pretty durable Xiranite-based materials here...

content.cn: 但这不是<@nar.mark>长久之计</>，我必须想想办法。
content.en: But this is not a <@nar.mark>permanent solution</>. I must come up with something else.

content.cn: 这附近应该<@nar.mark>有其他被困的</>幸存<@nar.mark>者</>，需要<@nar.mark>和他们</>会合。
content.en: There should be <@nar.mark>other trapped surviv</>ors nearby. I must meet <@nar.mark>up with th</>em.

content.cn: 通信干扰是个麻烦事，但总有办法。
content.en: Comms interference is a bummer, but there is always a way.

content.cn: 息壤余料×68
content.en: Xiranite Materials ×68

content.cn: 电<@nar.mark>路</>板×24
content.en: Cir<@nar.mark>cuit</> Board ×24

content.cn: 压缩<@nar.mark>晶体</>外壳×98
content.en: Compressed <@nar.mark>Origo</>crust ×98

content.cn: 速热<@nar.mark>干</>粮×60
content.en: Self-Hea<@nar.mark>ting</> Ration ×60

content.cn: 饼干、零食等×50
content.en: Biscuits and Snacks ×50

content.cn: 万幸这里还堆了几箱给夜班执勤同事留下的补给，在饿死之前，我得想办法找到出去的路。
content.en: Fortunately, I found several crates of supplies for our night shift colleagues. I still need to find a way out before I starve to death.

content.cn: 箱内遗骨已交由安思园识别记录。
content.en: Remains in the crate have been sent to Serenity Garden for identification and registration.

content.cn: 勿忘先辈牺牲。
content.en: Do not forget the sacrifices of our predecessors.

content.cn: 别被它“看”到，关闭仪器，手语沟通，用潜行队列。
content.en: Don't get "seen" by it. Switch off all devices. Hand signals only. Infiltration formations.

content.cn: 这些不是普通蚀影，资料里没有记录。
content.en: The database has nothing on these Blightshades. They're not normal.

content.cn: 立刻掉头，见此留言视为任务失败。
content.en: Immediate retreat. If you read this memo, regard this mission as failed and aborted.

content.cn: 把情报带出去。
content.en: Leave with the intel.

content.cn: 祂抛弃了这里。
content.en: He abandoned this place.

content.cn: 祂抛弃了我们。
content.en: He abandoned us.

content.cn: 针叶林、雪、山体。
content.en: Pinewoods, snow, and a mountain.

content.cn: 和萨米维格相似。
content.en: Just like Samivegr.

content.cn: 和资料中的萨米相似。
content.en: Just like the Sami as described in the records.

content.cn: 我找对地方了。
content.en: I found the right place.

content.cn: ……我被困了？
content.en: Am I ... trapped?

content.cn: 找不到路。
content.en: Can't find a way out.

content.cn: 睡着了会不会醒不过来？
content.en: If I fall asleep, will I never wake up again?

content.cn: 普契尼你不要在河对岸对我招手啊！
content.en: Puccini, I know you're on the other side of the river. Stop waving to me!

content.cn: 波！波！夫！你！怎！么！也！来！了！
content.en: POPOV! WHY THE HELL ARE YOU HERE AS WELL?

content.cn: 一如在本传中所言，梦是最容易招惹到秽的场景。就如《鉴秽明行笔录》中有关负山之物的记载，依照后续写注之人的猜测，在昏暗的雨夜，人在极疲惫的情况下，梦中所见之光怪陆离，或许就是秽的映照。
content.en: According to the main corpus of this work, dreams are extremely vulnerable to the Unclean. The work titled "Miscellany for Discerning the Unclean" contains a record of an entity called the Mountain Bearer. According to hypothetical guesses made by later commentators, extremely exhausted individuals may dream about strange sights and experiences. Such dreams might be projections of the Unclean.

content.cn: 也如《藕丝堂诸问》中所录，蒙学童子人在街头，见祖父于巷尾扬手相招，却因小兽衔住裤脚而不得前往相会，醒来后发现亦是梦境。
content.en: A story recorded in "Inquiries for the Hall of Lotus Silk" describes a school child who saw his grandfather at the other end of an alley waving at him. However, a small critter held on to the boy's trousers by its mouth and prevented the reunion. The boy then woke up and realized it was just a dream.

content.cn: 秽生于心，秽生于梦，应是如此。
content.en: It should be safe to assume that the Unclean is born of the heart and is nourished by dreams.

title.en: Strange Yanese Tales of the Supernatural - Supplement (1)

content.cn: 走吧，走吧。
content.en: I should go. I must leave.

content.cn: 离开这里，不要卷进我不切实际的妄想中。
content.en: Put this place behind me, and free myself from unrealistic fantasies.

content.cn: 诸梦之源，在于心念；诸念之源，在于天地。
content.en: The fount of dreams lies within the heart and mind; the fount of all thought is watered by the entire world.

content.cn: 梦，信念，天地，人。
content.en: Dreams, beliefs, the world, and people.

content.cn: 一点点微小的愿望，一点点改变世界的动力，一点点期待……
content.en: A tiny wish, a small urge to change the world, a dash of expectation...

content.cn: 这些愿望彼此影响，秽是否存在，妖物与邪祟又是否只是我们这种穷酸书生的妄想。
content.en: These hopes, wishes, and desires influence each other. Are the Unclean, the Geists, and the Apparitions simply derived from the fickle fancies of desperate, penniless scholars like us?

content.cn: 是真是幻，就请各位读者自行探索吧。
content.en: Is it real? Or is it just a figment of the imagination? I'll let you, my reader, discover that for yourself.

title.en: Strange Yanese Tales of the Supernatural - Supplement (2)

content.cn: 雪祀之事，我已向上汇报。
content.en: I have submitted a report regarding the Snowpriestess to my superiors.

content.cn: 往后迷失于此者，勿惊勿疑，可自行至木屋求救。
content.en: As for those who found themselves lost in this area, there is no need to panic or worry. Find your way to the cabin. Help and shelter can be found there.

content.cn: <@nar.right>应龙</>
content.en: <@nar.right>Yinglung</>

content.cn: 对祂来说，陨落只是一种临时的状态。
content.en: To Him, the fall is only temporary.

content.cn: 我会继续沿着祂的目光前进。
content.en: I shall continue to press forward under His gaze.

content.cn: 武陵旁边竟然还有这种地方！
content.en: I didn't expect Wuling to have a place like this!

content.cn: 从环境来看，这应该是受到了源石技艺的影响吧……
content.en: From what I'm seeing here, the local environment must have been affected by some Originium Arts...

content.cn: 其他地方也出现过这样的现象，比如温带地区却存在一小块冰原之类的，其成因到现在也没人能完全讲明白。
content.en: Similar phenomena have appeared in other places. Even to this day, nobody could explain how small icefield pockets showed up in temperate regions.

content.cn: 也好也好，省得去北边，就有雪景可画。
content.en: A blessing in disguise, I say. I don't have to go all the way north to create paintings of snowy places.

content.cn: 这里离应龙关还挺近的，上次没敢下水，想溜到禁区，结果失败了。
content.en: This is actually pretty close to Yinglung Pass. I completely fumbled my attempt to sneak into the Exclusion Zone because I couldn't bring myself to swim.

content.cn: 早知道从这里走好了。
content.en: If I only knew about this place. I could've taken this route.

content.cn: 奇妙的造物……有没有可能运回去种地……
content.en: A rather miraculous creation... I wonder if I could carry it back and grow it...

content.cn: 跟终末地的集成工业系统能不能结合一下……
content.en: It might work with Endfield's Automated Industry Complex...

content.cn: 这温度，这雪是认真的？
content.en: This temperature and the snow feel unreal.

content.cn: 应该是源石技艺……
content.en: This must be some form of Originium Arts...

content.cn: ……自然因素被人巧妙地影响过，各种细节环环相扣。
content.en: Someone has altered the natural elements in a very clever fashion. One effect is linked to another.

content.cn: 好高明的手段。
content.en: A true display of Arts mastery.

content.cn: ……食物在逐渐失去味道。
content.en: The food is gradually losing its taste.

content.cn: 或者是我在失去胃口，还是在失去想法，又或欲望？
content.en: I might be losing my appetite. Maybe it's my ideas. Perhaps it's my desire?

content.cn: 没有声音，没有回应……
content.en: There is no sound, no response...

content.cn: 一切意义都在失去。
content.en: Everything is losing its meaning.

content.cn: 站到最高处，能看出祭坛设置的巧妙之处。
content.en: A higher vantage point does reveal the clever designs and positioning of the shrines.

content.cn: 以“善意”为起点，能量与声音流向“枝桠”，顺着诸多脉络延伸出去，但最终却又都收回到“雪祀”之处。
content.en: Streams of energy and voices starting from the "Good Will" would course towards the "Branches" before literally branching out various veins before finally converging at the "Snowpriestess".

content.cn: 而“雪祀”再度指向“善意”。
content.en: And after reaching "Snowpriestess" the flows would return to "Good Will" once more.

content.cn: 这是一个巧妙、极巧妙的循环。
content.en: This cycle is most intricate and clever in design.

content.cn: 万法相通，这或许也能借鉴到天师桩的相关布置上。
content.en: A most universal approach, I'd say. Perhaps I could adopt something similar in Tianshi Pillar deployment.

content.cn: 许久没来，这里变化不小。
content.en: I haven't been here for a while. The place has changed a lot.

content.cn: 这座桥并非是因为袭击断裂，可以排除本区域有其他威胁的可能。
content.en: The bridge did not collapse from an attack. The presence of other hazards or threats in this area can be ruled out.

content.cn: 大概率是雪祀离开，造物们“野化”后，不再维护造成的。
content.en: The Snowpriestess's creations are likely to have gone "feral" after her departure. They could no longer perform their reparation duties.

content.cn: 已整理并向上汇报，不必忧虑。
content.en: The findings have been compiled and reported to my superiors. There is no need for concerns.

content.cn: 但造物仍有威胁，谨慎靠近。
content.en: The creations will continue to pose a threat. Approach with caution.

content.cn: 管理员，有关北部禁区旧日幸存者的各项现场资料，我们已收到，现为您同步分析。
content.en: Endministrator, we have received the field information you have gathered regarding the survivors of the North Wuling Exclusion Zone (NWEZ) disaster. We shall sync our analysis with you.

content.cn: 首先，我们需要向您致歉，这份调查报告延迟了一段时间才发送给您，请您见谅。为您撰写调查报告的干员在梳理各种资料后，踌躇许久不知如何下笔。由于这份报告涉及众多牺牲者及武陵旧日事故的惨烈状况，因此我们采用了更复杂的分析及评估方式。同时，出于严谨性考虑，这份报告也仅针对您在现场所发现的、未被或暂未被收录至武陵官方资料中的内容进行分析。
content.en: Firstly, we must apologize for the delay in sending this investigation report (IR). The operator who reviewed the uploaded information could hardly start drafting the IR, as it involved a great number of casualties from the terrible incident that befell Wuling. Hence, we adopted a more complicated approach to data analysis and evaluation. Given our considerations regarding the scientific rigor of the said approach, the analytical scope of this IR shall be limited to field information that you have secured and has not yet (or has yet to be) archived by the official Wuling database.

content.cn: 您在城建区、天柱等位置搜索发现的这些内容，绝大部分是十年前事故亲历者留下的痕迹，这些内容指向了灾难爆发初期，救援尚未完全展开时，这些被困者是如何在销骨毁形的侵蚀瘴中艰难求生的。侵蚀瘴吞没禁区是一个“缓慢”的过程，但在爆发之初，它首先“切割”了整片科考站旧址。无数侵蚀瘴将各个区域隔开，防备不及的人们被它吞没，幸存者们在通信断绝的情况下，显然没有放弃求生。您所发现的资料应该来自旧日侵蚀潮对抗项目的相关实验室，那里曾经进行过大量的息壤材料生产试验，如无意外，您应该能看到许多至今仍有“活力”的息壤设备。息壤试验早期，有些研究是通过“堆量”的方式推进的，侵蚀潮对抗项目中，设计用于平波堤建设的息壤建筑材料就是其中之一，其相关实验室中息壤储存量较高，也正因如此，幸存者们才能依托这一类的设施在灾难爆发初期保住性命。在保住性命后，他们也展现出了科考站工作者们应有的素质。无论是试图恢复通信，还是整理手边物资，在您收集到的资料中，我们都能看到这些人的果断与坚持。
content.en: Almost all of the information that you have uncovered at the Designated Urban Area and Celestial Column was left behind by first-hand witnesses and victims of the disaster from ten years ago. The contents therein describe how the trapped victims attempted to survive and escape the disintegrating Blight Miasma at the early stages of the disaster before full-scale initiation of SAR attempts. Although the Blight Miasma "gradually" washed over the NWEZ, the early onset of the disaster "bisected" the old Science Station. Numerous masses of Miasma then emerged, swallowing up those who could not escape while leaving some trapped in isolated pockets of relative safety. Despite the lack of communications, these survivors did not give up their attempts to escape to safety. The information you found is probably from an old research lab working on solutions for combating the Blight Tide. The lab was once furnished with multiple Xiranite test production facilities, a number of which should still be "active" assuming the absence of other intervening factors. Several early Xiranite experiments focused on the "brute force and quantity" approach. One of the projects for combating the Blight Tide designed Xiranite construction materials used in the Quelltide Levee. The project lab was furnished with substantial Xiranite reserves and various test facilities that people used to help them survive the early stages of the disaster. The information you found also highlighted the decisiveness, perseverance, and professionalism of the Science Station personnel who managed to survive the initial onslaught. They attempted to re-establish communications and organize intellectual assets they could still access.

content.cn: 武陵事故是一场意外，它所留下的伤痕至今仍在人们心中，但可以确定的是，在您前往北部禁区，带领众人将足迹再一次留在这片禁绝生命的土地上后，那份永不停歇的痛苦必然会减缓许多。
content.en: The Wuling incident is an accident that left people mentally scarred, even to this day. But we are certain that your NWEZ operation will lead people back to a land that was once hostile to all life. Making the place hospitable again will greatly alleviate their weeping wounds.

content.cn: 面对苦难，人类永不退缩，我们拥有着如此的自信。
content.en: Humanity never shies from suffering. Such is our confidence.

title.cn: 关于旧日幸存者的调查报告

content.cn: 管理员，我们已收到您在雪松林中上传的资料，接下来就为您展开分析。
content.en: Endministrator, we received your data uploads while you were in the Snowy Forest. The following is our analysis.

content.cn: 首先能够肯定的是，雪松林的“运作模式”的确是一项值得分析和研究的内容。当然，比起将之称为“运作模式”，我们或许更应该称其为“维持模式”，又或者“设计模式”。
content.en: First, we are certain that the "Operational Model" of the Snowy Forest is a topic worthy of in-depth analyses and investigations. That being said, instead of calling it "Operational Model", "Maintenance Model" or "Design Model" might be more appropriate.

content.cn: 如您所见，雪松林的气候明显异常，这种奇妙的环境偶尔会在塔卫二各处被发现，就像是大沙漠中偶尔会出现的雪原，又或者森林中突然会出现的某一小块沙漠，其成因各异……这处雪松林的成因我们还在调取综合数据进行分析（几乎可以被判断为是源石技艺造成的，但是还需更多数据证明）。当然，它并不会影响到此次我们针对其内部设计模式的分析。
content.en: As you can see, the Snowy Forest evidently has an abnormal climate. Similar anomalous environmental pockets have been found across Talos-II. Examples include icefields in the desert or even a small patch of desert in a forest. Such phenomena have various causes. We are still acquiring, integrating, and analyzing various data for the Snowy Forest's formation (we can, with near certainty, cite Originium Arts as the cause, though further data evidence is required). Of course, this deficiency will not affect our analysis of its internal designs and modeling.

content.cn: 您所上传的文件中提及的老雪祀，她一定是一位天才。从现有的数据来看，雪松林本来应该处于某种较为开放的状态，温度也应该更高一些。但这位老雪祀，她巧妙地用自己的源石技艺影响了这片区域，或者说，维持住了这片雪松林的状态。利用迷雾也好，加种几棵松树也罢，她保证了这片林地不易被外人发现，让这里能够处于一种“封闭且稳定”的状态。与此同时，她所设置的维护者们（也就是那些法术造物），其设计也很巧妙，这些造物具备结构简单、易于生产、便于维护等优点，这些取材于树木、岩石、泥土的造物本身也成为了这种“封闭稳定”状态的重要组成部分。您可以这样想象，某个损坏到无法维护的法术造物，它只需要安静地沉眠于某一处道路旁、某一团积雪下，就能遮挡住外来者的视线，成为雪松林道路的一部分……如果不是因为这位雪祀离开了松林，疏于管理的造物们出现了“野化”现象，展现出了过于极端的攻击欲望，在最理想的状态下，或许外来者们都不会感受到这些守卫的存在。
content.en: The Old Snowpriestess mentioned in the data you uploaded is definitely a genius. From our existing data, the Snowy Forest is located in a rather open area of warmer latitudes. However, the Snowpriestess made clever use of her Originium Arts to influence, or should we say, maintain the current (and anomalous) state of the Snowy Forest. With masses of obfuscating fog and pine trees, she has kept the Forest hidden from outsiders to keep it within a "closed and stable" state. Meanwhile, the maintainers of this system (which is to say, the witchcraft creations) she deployed are intricately designed. Said creations have the advantages of being structurally simple, easy to create, and cheap to maintain, as they are made out of wood, rocks, and mud. The creations themselves have also become an important component of this "closed and stable" state. Think of it this way. A witchcraft creation damaged beyond repair need only rest quietly by a trail, or beneath some snow. It would simply serve as an obstacle obscuring an outsider's field of view and become part of the Snowy Forest's many trails. Visiting outsiders might not even notice the presence of these guardians if they remained in their ideal state. Unfortunately, the absence of management due to the Snowpriestess's departure from the Forest made them increasingly "feral", resulting in their extreme levels of aggression.

content.cn: 这种具备循环感、自然感的设计，只有真正在荒野上行走过、亲近万物的人才能设计出来。想必那位老雪祀一定有一颗善良且敏感的心。如果有朝一日您能与她见面，请替我们向她传达问候与敬意。
content.en: A design that incorporates such life-like and natural cycles can only be achieved by one who has truly roamed the wildlands and is in tune with all living beings. We are willing to believe that the Old Snowpriestess is a kind and sensitive soul. Should you meet her face-to-face in the future, please convey to her our most sincere greetings and respect.

title.cn: 有关雪松林运作模式的调查报告
title.en: IR: Operational Model of the Snowy Forest

content.cn: 管理员！我们收到了资料！
content.en: Endministrator! We received the data!

content.cn: 下次我要想办法换一个能闻到味道的终端，唉，但是感觉只闻到味道也不够，有没有能够直接传送商业街食物的小型终端……好吧，我要停止会被组长骂的寒暄，开始给您认真分析资料了。有关您所好奇的，武陵商业街的发展，我们确认到了以下情报。
content.en: I'll try to find a replacement terminal capable of communing smells as well. Perhaps the smells won't be enough. I wonder if there's a handyterm capable of physically delivering snacks from the shopping avenue... Okay. I must conclude the usual greetings and start data analysis if I wish to avoid the wrath of my team leader. We have verified the following intel regarding the development of the Wuling shopping avenue that you are interested in.

content.cn: 首先，我们可以肯定的是，武陵的方兴衢是一个奇迹，不可复制的奇迹。
content.en: First, we are certain that Fangxing Avenue of Wuling is a wonder that cannot be replicated elsewhere.

content.cn: 我想您应该已经产生了对甚大裂隙的基础认知——近百公里的大型裂隙群就在武陵地下，也就是说，这座城几乎就是建在一座“活火山”上——准确地说是“火山口”里。那么为什么这座城里，能够发展出一条繁华的商业街，为什么会如此安居乐业呢？……我们查阅了历年有关武陵的报告，确认了一件事——庄方宜，这位管代天师拥有着极高的管理水平。从建城开始，她的思路中就存在着发展民生、教育、招商等等事项，这种完善的思维真是让人叹为观止。当然，我并没有否定武陵民众奉献的意思……在我们已确认到的资料中，庄天师每一次都能在最准确的方向上，列出最翔实的发展规划，无论是新增几个竹筏站点，又或者是为方兴衢新增一个龙泡泡款式……我猜武陵的每一个人——这么说有点夸张，但——一定都信任她，不然武陵必然不可能发展到今天的样子。您看到了游商的备忘，看到了普通居民的评价，也看到了经营者的笔记……无论内与外，所有人都相信这条街能蒸蒸日上。在险地之中亦有奇景，我想这就是方兴衢给许多人的第一印象。
content.en: I believe you already have the basic understanding of the Very Large Rift (VLR). The huge formation of multiple rifts measures nearly one hundred kilometers in length and exists right below Wuling. In other words, the city is literally built on an "active volcano" — To be more accurate, the entire place is built right over a "volcanic crater". So, why would such a precarious city develop such a bustling shopping avenue? Why is everyone settling in with a peace of mind...? We checked past records about Wuling and arrive at these verified findings — The Viceroy Tianshi Zhuang Fangyi has exceptional administrative skills. Ever since the founding of Wuling, she wholly focused on providing living amenities, education, and business opportunities. Her comprehensive ideas and approach are most admirable. Of course, I am not downplaying the contributions of the Wulingers... According to verifiable data we have, Tianshi Zhuang always came up with the most applicable development plans for special focuses that require them most. These efforts include the adding new bamboo raft stops, or introducing new Chubby Lung designs for Fangxing Avenue... I believe every Wulinger (though this claim appears exaggerated, it is not) has placed their trust in her for the city to reach its present day level of development. You yourself read the memos of the traveling merchant or the proprietor... Everyone inside and outside the city believes that the shopping avenue is heading up. A commercial wonder in a precipitous place. I believe this is the impression that people get when they first visit Fangxing Avenue.

content.cn: 您自可静静体会，这座城也有您留下的痕迹，我想大家也会以您为荣的。
content.en: Experience this place at your own leisure. You have left quite a mark on Wuling, and I am sure everyone is honored to be in your presence.

title.cn: 有关武陵商业街的调查报告

content.cn: 管理员，我们已经收到了您上传的资料。
content.en: Endministrator, we received the data you have uploaded.

content.cn: 武陵的竹子可是赫赫有名的！
content.en: The bamboo of Wuling is incredibly famous!

content.cn: 嗯？好像没在说竹子……抱歉……这就为您解答武陵交通规划的问题。
content.en: Ah! The topic is about something else... Apologies... I'll now answer your inquiries about transportation in Wuling.

content.cn: 单从您发回的资料来看，毫无疑问，无论是迷踪林资料中出现的“迷路”字样，还是留信者展示出的，明显被竹林伤害到了的精神状态……这些说法是有点夸张的。
content.en: From the data you sent us, writings that mention becoming "lost" or other overt signs of psychological trauma exhibited by travelers in the Stragglers Grove are ... undoubtedly exaggerated.

content.cn: 按照资料库中的记载，我们可以从武陵的交通设计方针中提炼出两个特点——自然与有序。“自然”，顾名思义，道路也好，竹筏站点也罢，甚至您资料中，那位巡林员提到的蟠兽巢穴也算在内……我想您能够发现，景玉谷内部极少出现生硬地人造建筑，但它依旧通行无阻。
content.en: According to existing data in the database, we can identify two key features in the design of transportation in Wuling — nature and order. "Nature" literally refers to lack of abrupt, artificial structures in Jingyu Valley, and that includes roads, bamboo raft stops, and even the pantailbeast lair mentioned by the forest ranger indicated by the data you found. However, Jingyu Valley remains a rather accessible place.

content.cn: 至于“有序”，这恐怕用言语很难表述，实际上，我建议您亲身体会，例如乘坐竹筏环游一番景玉谷，又或者试试咱们终末地的滑索？届时您会发现，武陵人在最小程度破坏自然环境的情况下，将景玉谷整个串联了起来，这需要极高深的规划水平。
content.en: "Order", on the other hand, might be a little hard to describe. I encourage you to explore and experience the area in person. Taking a raft ride through Jingyu Valley might be a start. How about using our Endfield ziplines? You will discover that the Wulingers have established a decent transport network throughout Jingyu Valley with minimal disruption to the natural landscape. Such an achievement requires incredible skills in area planning.

content.cn: 或许是炎国源远流长的风水知识，在塔卫二这颗异星上开放出了崭新花朵？如果有机会，您可以试着寻找一下有没有更多的资料。
content.en: Perhaps the well-established Yanese tradition of fengshui produced new blossoms in the distant world of Talos-II? Try looking for additional information, if the opportunity presents itself.

title.cn: 有关武陵交通规划的调查报告

content.cn: 管理员，您上传的资料我们已经收到。
content.en: Endmin, we received the data you uploaded.

content.cn: 我十分理解您想了解清波寨建设过程的心情，这确实是一件值得研究的事情。实际上，在您抵达清波寨的消息传回帝江号时，我们就做好了分析清波寨资料的准备，并第一时间在数据库中进行了搜索，可惜的是，所获寥寥。即便是在我们——S.O.W.——的数据库中，亦不存在什么有关清波寨建设过程的有价值信息（当然，这并不代表着我们缺乏对清波寨现状的理解，有关武陵地区的信息，我们有妥善地与宏山科学院进行及时同步）。
content.en: I understand your desire to learn more about the building of Qingbo Stockade. It is indeed a topic that we should look deeper into. In fact, we were prepared to analyze Qingbo Stockade when news of your arrival at that location reached Dijiang. A database search was initiated at once. Unfortunately, we received very few hits. Even our SOW database contains very little information about the construction of Qingbo Stockade (however, this does not mean we lack understanding on the current status of Qingbo Stockade; regarding information on the region of Wuling, we have already conferred with the Hongshan Academy of Sciences for a timely update in an appropriate manner).

content.cn: 万幸的是，您有了新的收获。目前，我们分析后已经可以确认，清波寨的建设工作至少经历了两个重要阶段。第一阶段应该是对周边威胁的清理，主要清理目标极有可能是兽群……当然这并不代表诸如侵蚀、天使等威胁并不严重，而是彼时清波寨周遭的兽群能对人造成的威胁，或许是超出想象的。这一点从您面对过的彪兽、咆兽、水灯虫等动物集群的危险性上也可以看出。与此同时，我们也在数据库中找到了佐证，某位众生长地师者曾在八十余年前游历经过现武陵地区，在他所留下的歌谣中，有“兽之海，水之源”的词句。在您上传资料之前，我们本无法确认这段歌谣的所指，但现在，它成为了彼时清波寨周边野兽肆虐的力证。我们推测，也正是在这种威胁下，寨民们才发展出了驯兽的技能。
content.en: Fortunately, you have also acquired new findings. Through our analysis, we can say with certainty that the building of Qingbo Stockade went through at least two important phases. The first phase involved the elimination of nearby threats, which were likely to be packs of beasts that roamed the area... However, this does not mean that the Blight or Aggeloi posed less of a risk. The local fauna of Qingbo Stockade may have once endangered the livelihood of the local residents to a degree that goes beyond our imagination. The rakerbeasts, howlerbeasts, and waterlamps you have encountered strongly suggest this possibility. Meanwhile, evidence has been found in the database about an Aldertone of the Hannabit Circuit who visited Wuling over 80 years ago. The hanna folksong he left behind includes this line: "An ocean of beasts, a source of the creeks." We were uncertain what the hanna meant until you uploaded your findings. The song is now solid proof how Qingbo Stockade was once threatened by beasts. We postulate that beast taming techniques were developed by Stockaders who tried to fight against these bestial hazards.

content.cn: 清波寨建设的第二阶段应该与环境改造有关，在您传回的写生者分析内容的基础上，我们也查阅了您在投放次级核心时同步的环境数据。经分析后，我们发现清波寨整体建筑的设计思路与某一时期的据点开拓思路相符合。在第一次天使战争结束之初，研究者们提出了许多针对小型据点的建设方案，其中就包括最大程度利用地貌特征，尽可能适应环境特性，以拦截、引导、分流等方式对抗侵蚀的低成本建设模式……清波寨正与这种建设模式相符。无论是语焉不详的“水从天上来”，还是清波寨这种将主体架高的建筑风格，无不印证了这一点。我们可以合理推测，那一时期的寨民中，应该有着对这种建设思路有所了解的人物。
content.en: Phase two of the building of Qingbo Stockade is probably related to environmental engineering. After reading through the writings and records of the sketcher you uploaded, we also checked ambient readings synced with us when you deployed the Sub-PAC. Our analysis revealed that the overall architectural design of Qingbo Stockade was rather similar to outpost expansion during a certain period in our history. Shortly after the First Aggeloi War ended, researchers proposed many plans for building small outposts. These designs focused on maximizing the use of local topography, adapting to the local environment, and low-cost construction methods to intercept, channel, and divert Blight masses... Qingbo Stockade happens to match this approach. "Water cascades from the heavens above" may seem like an esoteric line, but Qingbo Stockade actually lives up to this name with its high-rise buildings. We can assume, with good reason, that an individual knowledgeable in such architectural approaches lived amongst the Stockaders during that time.

content.cn: 总而言之，清波寨的建设过程，某种意义上是人类在塔卫二挣扎求生的历史缩影，它值得所有人铭记。我们感谢您的发现，管理员。
content.en: In essence, the building of Qingbo Stockade can be treated as a historical montage about humanity's struggles to survive on Talos-II. It is something that everyone should remember. We thank you for your discoveries, Endministrator.

title.cn: 有关清波寨建设历史的调查报告
title.en: IR: History for the Building of Qingbo Stockade

content.cn: 管理员，我们收到了您上传的资料，接下来向您同步有关首墩的资料。
content.en: Endministrator, we received the data you have uploaded. We shall sync you with our findings about the Marker Stone.

content.cn: 首墩是最早落成的，也是最大的天师桩。有关它的设计、落成和对侵蚀的削弱作用，相信您在S.O.W.提供的数据资料，以及与庄方宜天师的交流中已有初步了解。因此，本次同步仅仅从首墩及其配套设施运作逻辑的角度展开。
content.en: The Marker Stone is the first, and the largest, Tianshi Pillar ever built. Thanks to SOW data and discourse with Tianshi Zhuang Fangyi, you likely have acquired a basic understanding of its designs, construction, and ability to weaken the Blight. This investigation report (IR) will therefore expand upon the operational mechanics and processes of the Marker Stone and its affiliated facilities.

content.cn: 首先我们可以肯定的是，写下笔记的外来者的确聪明，这位先生或女士敏锐地注意到了首墩建设工程中最值得探讨的内容：与水环境的深度结合。整座首墩及其周边设施实际上呈现出了一种阶梯结构，我们可以从遏制甚大裂隙这一目的的角度将这种阶梯分成三部分，即对抗部分、缓冲部分，以及集中处理部分。所谓“对抗部分”指的自然是首墩本身——一个巨大的天师桩，息壤在其中流动，能够第一时间形成控制侵蚀的边界。所谓的“缓冲部分”则如同检修者在备忘中的表述，是蓄水站所积蓄的水。本质上，缓冲部分是为了给武陵一个启动应急措施的时间，如果对抗部分真的出了什么问题，受到影响的水就会流到第三部分——集中处理部分，该部分（您在首墩区域应该无法直观地看到）散布的活性息壤粒子能立刻处理受侵蚀影响的水。在如此三部分的设计基础上，首墩还修建了隐于水下的防御工事。武陵的天使自水下来，为了避免首墩被破坏，首墩的水下防线也十分完备（可惜的是您也无法直观看到）。想要完成这样的阶梯设计要付出极大的努力，我们从宏山科学院同步的资料中可以了解到，143年武陵的人们为修建首墩进行了怎样的准备工作，从开掘针对侵蚀的隔离带，再到封闭地下水道，设置防御天使袭击的水下工事，他们用极快的速度完成了首墩的建设。
content.en: First, we are certain that the outsider who made these notes was remarkably intelligent. This observant individual keenly identified the feature of the Marker Stone construction project that most warrants investigation: its deep integration with the aquatic environment. The entire Marker Stone and its nearby facilities are actually arranged in a way that resembles a multi-tiered terrace. We can divide this "terrace" into three portions based on the installation's purpose of suppressing the Very Large Rift (VLR): (1) the resistance portion; (2) the buffer portion; and (3) the central processing portion. The "resistance portion" naturally refers to the Marker Stone itself, a gigantic Tianshi Pillar with Xiranite coursing through it. This portion is capable of creating a boundary that contains the Blight. The "buffer portion", as the repair personnel's memo suggests, would be the water stored within the Reservoir Station. The buffer essentially helps to buy Wuling time for activating its emergency measures. If something were to happen to the resistance portion, the affected body of water would be directed to the third portion, namely the central processing portion. This portion has active Xiranite particles scattered within it (which you probably could not observe directly in the Marker Stone area), allowing it to immediately treat Blight-affected water. In addition to the designs of these three portions, the Marker Stone is also furnished with underwater defenses. The Aggeloi of Wuling tend to lurk within water bodies. To prevent the Marker Stone from being damaged, the installation also boasts a comprehensive suite of aquatic defenses (unfortunately, this is also not directly observable from your perspective). A great deal of effort must have been invested to construct this terraced installation. From the data that Hongshan Academy of Sciences (HAS) synced with us, we have learned how the Wulingers prepared for the construction of the Marker Stone in the Year 143. They started by excavating a Blight-breaking belt before moving on to sealing the local aquifers and furnishing the area with underwater defenses to defeat Aggelos attacks. Marker Stone construction was completed with incredible speed.

content.cn: 首墩的建设可谓奇迹，它是希望的象征。
content.en: The construction of the Marker Stone can thus be considered a miracle. The installation itself is a symbol of hope.

title.cn: 有关首墩建设的调查报告
title.en: IR: Construction of the Marker Stone

content.cn: 您好，管理员，我们收到了您上传的资料，看到了您有关藏剑谷炎国遗迹的疑问，针对这一问题，我们即将为您展开分析。
content.en: Greetings, Endministrator. We received the data you uploaded and saw your questions regarding the Yanese ruins in Sword Vault Dale. The content herein presents the results of our analysis.

content.cn: 首先我们需要坦率承认的是，由于第一次天使战争及其后续事件造成的影响，与这座炎国遗迹相关的资料几乎完全不存在于我们的数据库内，这就代表着我们仅能以推测的方式，从各角度对其进行分析，请您务必结合现场状况后再对我们的报告结果进行采纳。
content.en: First, we must be honest and admit our limitations. Given the impact of the First Aggeloi War and subsequent events, our database contains hardly any information on these Yanese ruins. This means our analysis will be speculative, albeit based on various perspectives. The content of this investigation report should only be accepted if it is congruent with the actual findings in the field.

content.cn: 从您发现的资料来看，我们推测这座遗迹的建成时间较早（具体时间尚需您采集建筑残骸样本传回帝江号后分析得出），约在第一次天使战争爆发初期。您可以想象，一支权限极高的队伍，在天使战争爆发初期，在协定的督促下，九死一生地向南前进，在彼时最远离战场的地方，付出了惨烈的代价，修成了这处设施……或许是天使，又或许是侵蚀的大潮，让设施终究成了遗迹。我们推测，或许清波寨的人们对此处遗迹也有一定了解，但可惜的是，依照我们对清波寨知识传承状况的了解，有关它的资料应该早已遗失。
content.en: From the information you recovered, we postulate that these ruins were constructed many years ago, circa the early phases after the outbreak of the First Aggeloi War. For an exact date, we will need you to gather physical samples from the ruins for a chronological analysis aboard Dijiang. Imagine this. In the early days of the First Aggeloi War, a team with an extremely high level of Protocol authority and supervision was ordered to go southwards. They endured all manner of danger, paid a dear price, and reached a place far away from the battlefield just to construct this facility... Perhaps the Aggeloi or major Blight Tides came and turned it into ruins. We postulate that the residents of Qingbo Stockade may know something about these ruins. Unfortunately, if what we know about education and knowledge preservation in Qingbo Stockade is true, written records about this site may have been lost for a while.

content.cn: 我们结合了关于清波寨的资料，以及天使战争遗落资料回收库中能与本遗迹建筑风格、保存状况等特征产生关联的情报，尝试对遗迹内部的保存物进行了推测，一切事件的起点显然与曾经的塔卫二探索息息相关——来自泰拉的人们，为了保证某些东西不会遗失，而将其储存在了这一遗迹中。目前我们还无法对储存内容究竟是什么做出有效推测，但塔卫二各地截至今日所发现、回收的，因天使战争或侵蚀危机而遗落的若干具备保存库性质的设施中，储存的绝大部分是工程、武器或源石技艺相关的数据。或许此处遗迹中存放的也是这类物品（这有待您的验证）。
content.en: Our attempt to analyze the content preserved within the ruins involves integrating pieces of relevant intel about Qingbo Stockade, data salvaged from recovered records of the Aggeloi War, as well as the architecture and state of preservation of said ruins. The origin of the entire effort is obviously related to past surveillance missions that explored Talos-II. To ensure that certain things would not be lost, the Terrans stored them in these ruins. Currently, we have yet to arrive at an effective conclusion regarding the stored content. After all, vaults or storage facilities lost during the Aggeloi War or Blight disasters discovered to date have yielded content or salvages mostly tied to engineering, weaponry, or the Originium Arts. These ruins might contain similar things, though field validation will be required.

content.cn: 这座遗迹被尘封的时间已超过百年，我们对它的分析也仅能吹去时间覆盖在其上的薄薄一层尘土，但您正在现场，管理员，相信您能让等待许久的它再度焕发生机。
content.en: These ruins have been sealed away for over a century. Our analysis would only dispel the dust that had settled with time. But you are at the very threshold of the facility, Endmin. We believe you have what it takes to restore it to its former glory.

title.cn: 有关藏剑谷炎国遗迹的调查报告
title.en: IR: Yanese Ruins in Sword Vault Dale

content.cn: 管理员，我们整合了目前所有的信息。可以确定，岸所带领的那几支应龙小队早在两年前便发现了阿莱克琉斯投出的那把剑。但由于剑引发的侵蚀瘴扩散，两支小队受困于禁区深处，他们没能更早确认坐标源究竟是什么，只能想办法联络另外三支小队把坐标送回。
content.en: Endministrator, all current data has been compiled. We can safely assume that the Yinglung Special Task Force (YSTF) Team led by Shore actually found the sword thrown by Alleikhreos two years ago. However, the said sword triggered the spread of Blight Miasma and trapped two YSTF teams deep within the exclusion zone (EZ). They failed to confirm the actual nature of the entity at the marked coordinates. Their only recourse was to contact the three other YSTF teams to return with the data.

content.cn: 蚀影的出现和侵蚀瘴的突然扩散阻断了他们的退路，岸决定前往深处，和肃小队把携带的应龙桩全部放下，她发现了剑，却也经历了塌方，眼看着剑将没入谷底后，她独自观察并记录、推算着剑大致的位置。
content.en: The appearance of Blightshades and Blight Miasma suddenly severed their exit route. Shore then decided to turn around and head further into the EZ with Team Stern and plant all the Yinglung Pillars they carried with them. A landslide occurred shortly after Shore discovered the sword. Having witnessed it fall deeper into the gorge, Shore decided to track it on her own, record the relevant data, and approximate the location of the sword.

content.cn: 负责送出坐标的小队中，只有一支抵达了城建区附近，但由于蚀影的袭击也未能平安归来……后续执行任务的应龙特勤队回收了那份坐标，但这次大规模的人员伤亡让应龙暂缓了勘察计划，塌方也使得对该坐标的勘察毫无收获。
content.en: Of the teams charged with escorting the coordinates, only one managed to reach the site near the Designated Urban Area. However, this team also failed to exit the EZ following a Blightshade ambush. The coordinates were later recovered by another YSTF team assigned to a separate operation. Nevertheless, YSTF suspended additional surveillance operations due to the significant casualties suffered. The landslide also rendered follow-up surveillance of the recovered coordinates meaningless.

content.cn: 如果他们能够幸存，或许我们能够提早两年，去重新审视禁区事故的真相……但也是因为他们英勇的行为，才让我们得以穿越侵蚀瘴。
content.en: If they had made it out alive, our investigations into the truth of the EZ incident could have restarted two years ago... Nevertheless, the brave and selfless actions of the Yinglungs have helped us breach the Blight Miasma.

content.cn: 向他们送上最崇高的敬意。
content.en: They deserve our deepest and most sincere respect.

title.cn: 应龙战匣相关线索汇总
title.en: Summary of Findings: Yinglung War Cases

content.cn: 管理员您好，我们收到了您上传的资料。接下来我们将会为您同步应龙关的有关情况。
content.en: Greetings, Endministrator. Your data uploads have been received. We shall sync you with our findings regarding Yinglung Pass.

content.cn: 关于应龙关的设计、落成，以及它的作用，相信您已经通过S.O.W.提供的数据资料，有了初步的了解。因此，本次同步将会从应龙关的驻扎人员这一角度展开。
content.en: We believe you have, via the information provided by SOW, gained a preliminary understanding of the designs, construction, and purposes of Yinglung Pass. Hence, this data sync shall primarily focus on the garrison of this installation.

content.cn: 结合您上传的资料，我们可以推测出——应龙特勤队负责处理应龙关的一切防守事务，但对于防守之外的事务，还是需要其他人员的协助。根据这一结论，我们翻阅了大量文件，发现宏科院会在必要时，授权已经通过了背景调查的职工或是天师，短期入驻应龙关。或许您也有所察觉，天师们为了抵御甚大裂隙这一威胁而在此进行研究。尽管相较于应龙关，北部禁区才是最合适的科研场地，但由于进入北部禁区对绝大多数人来说无异于是自杀，周期性深入北部禁区的应龙队员也因为安全上的考量不能携带太多的科研设备，所以天师们便只能进入相对安全的应龙关完成科研任务，且进驻时间、研究区域都要经过宏科院本部的层层审核，整个科研任务也都要在应龙队员的陪同下进行。
content.en: Thanks to the data you have uploaded, we can now make the following deductions: The Yinglung Special Task Force (YSTF) is wholly responsible for the defenses of Yinglung Pass. However, the YSTF will require support from other personnel on matters that lie outside their defensive duties. Starting from this conclusion, we perused vast amounts of data and found out that the Hongshan Academy of Sciences (HAS) has, where necessary, authorized short-term residency for laborers or Tianshi who passed their background checks. You may have seen several Tianshi conducting research in this area to handle the threat posed by the Very Large Rift (VLR). Although the North Wuling Exclusion Zone (NWEZ) is more fitting for field research compared to Yinglung Pass, entering the NWEZ would be considered a suicidal act for most people. Yinglungs who periodically venture deep into the NWEZ could not carry many scientific instruments for safety considerations. Hence, the Tianshi were forced to conduct their scientific research in the relative safety of Yinglung Pass. Furthermore, the duration of their residency and the area of their field studies must undergo multiple rounds of review by HAS Headquarters. Any scientific process or task can only be conducted while accompanied by the members of the YSTF.

content.cn: 关于应龙关周遭民众是如何看待应龙特勤队这点，感谢您搜集到了这些信息。在此之前，我们对应龙特勤队在民众眼中的形象所知甚少，情报大多来源于外部观察或者居民间的闲聊。通过您提交的这些资料，以及我们找到的各种文件可以看出：武陵城的居民们——特别是经历过十年前那场灾难的幸存者，总是会主动参与到应龙关的运输任务中，并会为应龙特勤队带去自己准备的物资，这足以表明特勤队受到了相当广泛的支持，尽管他们会出于纪律要求拒绝接受民众捐赠的物资。
content.en: We are thankful for the information you have gathered regarding the locals near Yinglung Pass and their views of the YSTF. Prior to your findings, we knew little regarding the public image of the YSTF. Most of our intel on this subject matter comes from external observations or idle chatter from members of the public. In addition to the documents we have found and the information you have kindly shared, we can see that the residents of Wuling, particularly the survivors from the disaster that took place ten years ago, actively volunteered for Yinglung Pass transport missions and often prepared their own supplies for the YSTF. This shows that the Yinglungs have grassroots support, even though they have been strictly prohibited from accepting any donations from the public.

content.cn: 管理员，我接下来要说的话已经脱离了情报分析的范畴，但我相信这会成为我们共同的结论：应龙特勤队并不是孤军奋战、默默牺牲的守护者，在他们的身后，以及在您的身后，还有无数人愿意提供无私的支持。
content.en: Endministrator, the following statement of mine may go beyond the scope of our intel analysis. Nevertheless, I believe both of us can arrive at this same assumption: The Yinglungs are not lone guardians who sacrifice themselves in silence. A great multitude of volunteers willing to offer their unconditional support stands behind them, and behind you as well.

content.en: After multiple rounds of field investigations and years of research, the author has reached a degree of understanding of <@qu.key>special glyphs and markings</> made by the Bonekrushers (a Landbreaker clan).

content.cn: 近几年，在已发现的<@qu.key>印记</>中，下列几种最为常见：

content.cn: 现通过大量实景照片的对比，笔者最终在象形学研究者拉特斯先生的启发下，初步得出了以下结论，供广大相关研究者参考：

content.cn: ①号图案，有明显形似箱子的轮廓，四周延伸的线有“引人注目”“闪亮”的象征感，或许意为“宝藏”。
content.en: FIGURE 1. A glyph with an outline that resembles a crate surrounded by radial lines that convey a sense of "attractiveness" or "brightness". This glyph may symbolize "treasure".

content.en: FIGURE 2. If the main feature of this glyph represents a "person", then the meaning conveyed by the posture may have something to do with the act of "worship".

content.cn: <image>Reading/collection_ldz_leader</image>
content.en: <image>Reading/collection_ldz_leader</image>

content.cn: ③号图案，疑似为一张人脸的涂鸦，常常与②号图一起出现，可能接近传统语境中“领袖”“首领”的含义。
content.en: FIGURE 3. A glyph that resembles a human face. This glyph is often seen with the glyph shown in Figure 2 and may symbolize a "chief" or "leader".

content.en: FIGURE 4. A glyph that resembles the one shown in Figure 2 and often appears with the glyph of Figure 1. The meaning conveyed by this glyph may be related to the act of "burying" or "hiding".

title.cn: 试论碾骨氏族印记的源流及特色
title.en: Origins and Distinctive Features of Bonekrusher Glyphs

content.cn: <image>Reading/reading_read_file</image>
content.en: <image>Reading/reading_read_file</image>

content.cn: 在那遥远的开拓地带，有一群名叫“裂地者”的暴徒，他们无恶不作，他们残暴凶狠。
content.en: Merciless, cruel, and vicious raiders known as the Landbreakers roam in the frontierlands miles away from civilization.

content.cn: 生活在此地的每个孩童都曾听过这样一句话——“再不听话就把你送给裂地者！”
content.en: Every nomad and frontiersmate grew up with these words: "You best listen or we'll give you to the LBs!"

content.cn: 约翰家的小恰克也不例外。
content.en: Little Chuck from the Jones family was no exception.

content.cn: 这天，小恰克像平时一样赶着驮兽去集市，费尽口舌才用这个月采到的野菜换来了一袋小麦。回程时已近黄昏，为了早点到家，他选了一条平时不怎么走的小路。就在他走到半路时，忽然听见不远处传来奇怪的叫喊声，他连忙牵着驮兽躲在了一块<@qu.key>大石头后面</>。
content.en: As usual, Little Chuck went to the bazaar with his burdenbeast and spent a good part of the day haggling just to trade a month's worth of foraged herbs for a small bag of wheat. The sun was sinking down the horizon when he prepared to head home. Little Chuck chose an unfamiliar shortcut to make it back in time but heard strange howling and shouts halfway down the road. He quickly led his burdenbeast <@qu.key>behind a large rock</> and hid there.

content.cn: 果然是一群裂地者！
content.en: They turned out to be Landbreakers!

content.cn: 小恰克不禁一阵后怕，继续缩在石头后默默观察着这些打扮怪异的暴徒，看着他们用一种几乎看不出颜色的“颜料”在一块石头上涂来涂去，涂来涂去……
content.en: Little Chuck was terrified. Silently he studied these gaudily dressed Landbreakers from behind his rock. The raiders gathered around another piece of rock and started painting it with a colorless and transparent substance.

content.cn: 就在小恰克以为他们要涂到夜幕降临的时候，这些裂地者突然停了下来，拿出铲子在石头前挖了个大洞！
content.en: Little Chuck thought they would keep doing this till night time when the Landbreakers suddenly stopped. They took out their shovels and dug a huge pit before the rock.

content.cn: 然后他们就把一大堆小恰克从没见过的好东西全都埋了进去。
content.en: They buried all sorts of treasures and loot that Little Chuck had never seen before.

content.cn: 小恰克心想，这难道就是他们藏宝贝的方式吗？
content.en: "Is this how they hide their loot?" Little Chuck thought to himself.

content.cn: （未完待续）
content.en: To be continued...

content.cn: （摔出的行车记录仪上残存着数条语音记录）
content.en: (Though it fell out of the vehicle, this dashcam still has a few audio logs saved)

content.cn: “喂？怎么样了，他今天吃东西了吗？你现在还在医院吗？”
content.en: "Allo? Da? What is it? Did he eat something today? Are you still in the hospital?"

content.cn: “这样下去也不是办法啊。医生上次说的那个营养液呢？”
content.en: "We can't let this continue. I remember the surgeon saying something about a nutrient mix."

content.cn: “贵不是问题，先打上。跟医院那边说，之后我会回去销账的。”
content.en: "I don't care about the price. Hook him up with one of those and tell the hospital I'll pay them when I get back."

content.cn: “我啊，我回不去啊，我在外面跑业务呢。”
content.en: "Me? No, I can't head back right now. I got clients to meet."

content.cn: “你不能多理解理解我吗？我这边实在走不开啊！我得工作！”
content.en: "Blin! I can't leave! I have to work! Don't you understand? I have to earn the creds and pay for everything!"

content.cn: “没裁员！都说了不要听那些风言风语。你照顾好老爸，我最快下周就回去了。”
content.en: "No! No one got fired! Ignore the gossip and rumors! You take good care of Papa. I'll be back next week if everything works out."

content.cn: “嗯，不辛苦，你更辛苦一点。”
content.en: "Hrnngh. No. I'm okay. You're working harder than me."

content.cn: （摔出的行车记录仪上残存着数条语音记录）
content.en: (Though it fell out of the vehicle, this dashcam still has a few audio logs saved)

content.cn: “一个月吧，下个月我肯定还上，行吗？杰森，咱们这么多年的哥们儿，我什么时候骗过你？”
content.en: Jason, my friend! Come on. Just give me one more month. You'll definitely get your money! We're like the best buddies, right? When did I ever lie to you?

content.cn: “上次……上次是特殊情况嘛！后面我不是都还上了？”
content.en: "Last time...? Hey, hey, partner! Last time was a special case. And I paid you back in the end, right?"

content.cn: “没有拆东墙补西墙啊！唉，我这会儿在开车，不好说话，但你相信我，我肯定——”
content.en: "No, I wasn't borrowing from someone else to pay you back! Look, I'm driving and can't really talk to you right now. Trust me, partner—"

content.cn: “总之先借我一笔填账，医院那边等不得。利息你说了算，真的，哥们儿真不骗你。”
content.en: "Just get me a bit of dough. The hospital can't wait. Just name your interest. Your boy Alex never lied to you, right?"

content.cn: （摔出的行车记录仪上残存着数条语音记录）
content.en: (Though it fell out of the vehicle, this dashcam still has a few audio logs saved)
"Allo?"

content.cn: “对，我接，我去给你接着谈这个单子。你直接说怎么办。……埃里克松商贸？……我什么时候沦落到跟这种人坐一桌吃饭了？”
content.en: "Da. Okay. Got it. I'll negotiate this order for you. Just give me the details ... Erikssohn Trading House...? What? ...These small-timers are actually my competition?"

content.cn: “不是不是，哎，哥，我真没有挑三拣四。他们跟一家啥公司搭上了？终末地？原来你们……咱们公司第一轮就被淘汰了啊。”
content.en: "Oh, no. Don't misunderstand, partner. I'm not being picky. Wait. What you mean? They're partnering with someone else? Endfield? So you ... I mean, they dropped us in round one?"

content.cn: “得看终末地跟埃里克松谈到什么程度了。他们要签合同了？……行，我准备准备就过去那边。”
content.en: "Depends on how far the Endfield-Erikssohn negotiations went... They're signing a contract already...? Sure. I'll get my things together and head right over."

content.cn: “门德斯那些人呢？他们派过来的是汉斯？他才不是什么业务员——他就是个打手！”
content.en: "What about Mendez? They're sending Hans? No, Hans is no negotiator — the guy is a merc!"

content.cn: “我、我当然不会暴露他们啊，别怀疑我的专业程度。不就是吓吓那小子吗？”
content.en: "Me? Expose them? Partner, I'm a true professional. We just need to scare the youngling a little."

content.cn: “这里前不久前还一片混乱，没人会怀疑到他们头上的。”
content.en: "The frontier is filled with breakers and scum. No one would suspect anything else."

content.cn: “嗯，谈下来了，你就帮我去跟上头说点好话……就是，这么多年老员工的情面……是吧？嗯。”
content.en: "Alright. It's settled. Just push a few kind words to the boss for me... I've worked for many years, right...? Hmm?"

content.cn: “……佣金不是说好的二八分？怎么变成你八我二了？！”
content.en: "...I thought we're splitting the commission 20-80. I was the one getting the 80, not you!"

content.cn: “什么写在纸上了，你给我那张契约根本不是这么写的！副本就在我副驾驶箱里呢，你别挂电话，你等着，我找给你看——”
content.en: "Printed and signed? That's not what your contract said! I got a copy of it right in my glove box. Suck-a-blight! Stay on the line! I'll show you —"

content.cn:
伪装成埃里克松商贸的员工与终末地接触,意图抢走订单,来者不善。据说被揭穿后变成明抢了……
实际上其人早已被公司开除。做出这一系列举动的原因是家中变故,急需中转资金。
经过调查,发现是与汉斯合伙抢劫和陷害哈特曼,有诸多不法行为。
事情败露后,有悔改之意。
content.en:
Aleksandr masqueraded as an Erikssohn Trading House employee to hijack their contract negotiations with Endfield. When we saw through his disguise, he revealed his actual company (Clavis) and negotiated on behalf of the latter. 
However, Aleksandr has already been laid off by Clavis. His desperate need for funds to provide for his family was the reason behind his willingness to take part in various illegal actions. 
Further investigations revealed that Aleksandr collaborated with Hans in a scheme to rob Hartmann and set the Erikssohn employee up. 
When the scheme failed, Aleksandr exhibited signs of remorse and guilt.

title.cn: 拉奎尔·琼斯的工作履历

content.cn: 近日，本刊记者在位于文明环带边缘的四号谷地进行了实地调查，通过走访这里的工团工作人员与普通民众，了解了他们在四号谷地的饮食、居住和就医情况。……不少公司在这里都有外派人员，在本地的侵蚀灾害爆发后，大部分人员都参与到了救援工作中。其中，一家名为“终末地工业”的公司在处理相关危机时显得尤为专业。据消息人士透露，该公司的外派干员大多都是具备丰富实战经验的行业精英，非常擅长在极端危险的环境下处理各类难题。截至目前（本篇报道的撰稿时间），这些来自终末地工业的“问题处理专家”已经帮助四号谷地的人们解决了侵蚀灾害带来的大大小小十余次纠纷与危机。……可以说，该地区在灾后能够如此稳定且高效地展开重建工作，终末地工业功不可没。——以上就是本刊特派记者关于四号谷地的全部报道。
content.en: Recently, our correspondent conducted a tour of Valley IV that lies at the fringes of the Civilization Band. Numerous UWST crew mates and frontiersfolk were interviewed to better understand the food, accommodations, and medical amenities available in Valley IV. ...Many companies have resident liaisons and agents operating in the frontier. When a Blight disaster struck this region, most of them joined various forms of search and rescue operations. A company named Endfield Industries demonstrated their effectiveness in handling various disaster-related crises. A reliable source revealed that many field operators of Endfield are veteran combatants and elites of their field, making them incredibly skilled in handling the challenges posed by the extremely hazardous environments. To date (the time when this article is being written), this Endfield "troubleshooting" team has handled and mediated more than a dozen Blight-induced conflicts and emergencies for the residents of Valley IV. ...We can even say that Endfield played an instrumental role in ensuring regional stability as well as the efficiency of post-disaster rebuilding. — And this concludes our Valley IV report from our special correspondent.

content.cn: 我们已经获取了您所递交文件的阅读权限。管理员，经过武陵材料研究所的准许，我们调取了“打潮鞭”项目相关的实验报告并留档。这是一项关于利用高密度息壤攻克侵蚀问题的研究。内容如下：
content.en: Endministrator, we have acquired read access for the files you submitted. With the authorization granted by the Wuling Institute of Materials Science, we acquired and archived test reports and records associated with the Tide Flayer project. This project was an attempt to utilize high-density Xiranite to address the Blight. The details are as follows:

content.cn: 档案编号：147
content.en: FILE NUMBER: 147

content.cn: 项目名称：打潮鞭
content.en: PROJECT TITLE: Tide Flayer

content.cn: 项目负责人：莫痕
content.en: PRIMARY INVESTIGATOR: Mo Hen

content.cn: 原理构想：由于侵蚀及其相关物质的不稳定性，侵蚀核心在当前实验条件下无法准确定位，计算误差过大，不利于息壤的填充与覆盖。遂本实验选择将超高密度息壤压缩为鞭状，当与侵蚀核心接触时，鞭状结构会迅速瓦解，息壤会以接触点为方向迅速释放，以求最高效率探索、定位、破坏侵蚀核心，解除侵蚀威胁。
content.en: PRINCIPLES AND CONCEPTS: Given the instability of Blight and Blight-related materials, the location of the Blight Core cannot be discerned with the means and conditions available to this project. Algorithmic offsets and deviations are also too large to achieve effective Xiranite filling and coverage. Hence, this test opted to compress super-dense Xiranite into a whip-like structure. Upon contact with the Blight Core, this structure rapidly disintegrates, releasing Xiranite at the point of contact. This achieves efficient broad-area probing, positioning, and destruction of the Blight Core, thereby eliminating the threat posed by the Blight.

content.cn: 实验条件：打潮鞭相关实验需要深入侵蚀环境，针对鞭身的探测范围与息壤的释放效率进行详细测试。需要材料研究所划拨所需防护装备及所需息壤。实验必须确保在最高监护等级下进行。
content.en: TESTING CONDITIONS: The Tide Flayer project requires investigators to be in close proximity to Blighted environments to perform detailed testing of whip probing ranges and Xiranite-release efficiency. Protective gear and Xiranite are to be supplied by the Institute of Materials Science. All testing must be conducted under the highest level of supervision.

content.cn: 项目审查结果：建议全面停止实验
content.en: PROJECT REVIEW RESULTS: Recommend complete suspension of this project
