content.cn: 第十三次打潮鞭测试：
content.en: Tide Flayer Test Run 13:

content.cn: 实验结果依旧不理想，有可能是息壤的压缩密度不太对，需要更进一步调整。这次实验耗费的时间比预想中还要久，之前申请到的息壤也快耗尽了，这是个麻烦事……不知道春荷那边的申请情况怎么样。
content.en: The test run results were less than ideal. Perhaps the compressive density of the Xiranite was off and needed adjustment. This run also took far longer than expected, and I'm running out of Xiranite from the last shipment. Things don't look good... I wonder if Chun He just got lucky with her applications.

content.cn: 第十七次打潮鞭测试：
content.en: Tide Flayer Test Run 17:

content.cn: 又出意外了……明明只差一点……鞭体结构在接触到侵蚀核心前就提前瓦解了，根本没法形成定位……究竟是哪里出现了问题？要不是研究所派来的人中断了实验，我肯定能查出原因……
content.en: Another accident... We were so close. The structural integrity of the whip gave way before it could strike the Blight Core. Proper targeting could not be achieved... Where did we go wrong? I would have found out if I hadn't been interrupted by the people from the Research Labs...

content.cn: 也罢……实验本就不是一朝一夕的事，好在春荷还在，那孩子聪明、有灵性，还踏实肯学。即使我完不成这打潮鞭，她也一定能替我……
content.en: Oh well... Projects aren't completed in a single day. Fortunately, I have Chun He on the team. The lass is smart, gifted, and a hardworking learner. Even if I fail to complete the Tide Flayer project, she could succeed where I left off...

content.cn: 可笑，连我自己也迷糊了，这种想法都冒出来了，这打潮鞭只差一步，我一定会亲手完成它！
content.en: Oh dear, did I just lose faith in myself? This is ridiculous. We're so close to completing the Tide Flayer. I will see it completed!

content.cn: 第二十次打潮鞭测试：
content.en: Tide Flayer Test Run 20:

content.cn: 打潮鞭能够在高读数下的侵蚀中保持结构稳定了！这是突破性的一步！可惜，息壤已经完全用尽了，下一次实验不知道什么时候才能进行了。春荷……说来，已经几天没有见过那孩子了……最近天气转凉了……
content.en: The Tide Flayer can now maintain its structural integrity in the Blight, even at high depth readings! A true breakthrough! Unfortunately, we're out of Xiranite. I don't know when the next test run can begin. Say... I wonder where Chun He has gone... I haven't seen the lass for a while... The weather's getting colder too...

content.cn: 第二十二次打潮鞭测试：
content.en: Tide Flayer Test Run 22:

content.cn: 功亏一篑，功亏一篑！可笑，可笑！！这就是这么多年的成果，这就是答案？我苦苦追寻了这么多年，得到的竟然是一场空？打潮鞭根本定位不了侵蚀核心，更何谈破坏？可悲，可怜！！
content.en: This is it! I've fallen short! Preposterous! Why did I spend so many years on this pursuit only to find this answer? Was it all for nothing? If the Tide Flayer couldn't locate the Blight Core, how could we ever hope to take out the Blight? This is utterly pathetic!

content.cn: 这实验已经没有做下去的必要了……都结束了，都结束了。对了……春荷，亏那孩子还一直相信我……不过是在误人子弟罢了。那孩子值得更好的前程。那孩子……上次来是什么时候？
content.en: I see no point in continuing this project... It's over. This is where it ends. Chun He ... that poor girl still has faith in me ... but all I did was delay her entire career. She deserves far better. Speaking of which, when was the last time she returned to the lab...?

content.cn:
坨坨的背上长着小房子。我每天给坨坨喂一颗瓜子。
有一天，小房子上闪着金光，瓜子发芽，开花，结出了更多的瓜子，人们吃一颗就会饱一天。
坨坨慢慢地说：“你喂一颗瓜子，就会在我的小房子里存进一点时光。”
原来，是大家把时光吃进了肚子里，所以才会那么饱。
content.en:
Pebbles carries a little house on its back. Every day, I feed Pebbles a melon seed. 
One day, the little house started giving off a golden glow. The melon seed sprouted and produced special seeds. A single special seed will make someone full for an entire day. 
"Every time you feed me a seed," Pebbles slowly explained, "it stores a bit of time in my little house."
It turned out that the special seeds were packets of time, and that was why eating the seed made us feel so full.

title.en: Pebbles and the Seeds of Time

content.cn: 息壤粒子的捕集与封存技术在当代巨兽学应用体系中的作用
content.en: Xiranite Particle Capture and Storage Technology and its Uses in Modern Applied Feranmut Studies

content.cn: 作者：奚墨
content.en: AUTHOR: Xi Mo

content.cn: 通讯作者：庄方宜
content.en: CORRESPONDING AUTHOR: Zhuang Fangyi

title.cn: 与巨兽相关的研究资料

content.cn: 实验室编号：武陵-CRL05
content.en: LAB NUMBER: Wuling-CRL05

content.cn: 概述：本报告旨在分析首墩遇袭后的息壤粒子生产波动程度，评估校准首墩内巨兽心脏能量的外溢数据，用以改进后续的修复方案。数据来源为首墩内B23号探测器阵列。
content.en: ABSTRACT: This report aims to analyze the extent of fluctuations of Xiranite particle production after the attack on the Marker Stone, and to assess and calibrate the energy dissipation data of the Feranmut Heart in the Marker Stone. The results will then be used to improve the subsequent cardiac remediation project. Raw data was provided by the B23 sensor array inside the Marker Stone.

content.cn: 关键数据结果：检测到三次显著爆发情况，数据较基线值上升48%，与首墩内四处较为严重的损坏相关。
content.en: KEY RESULTS: Three significant bursts were detected and data readings were 48% higher than baseline values, correlating with severe damages at four sites inside the Marker Stone.

content.cn: 初步结论：巨兽心脏能量外溢强度超出原本模型，建议结合粒子网捕集数据进行跨周期验证，原始数据及处理代码已归档实验室服务器。
content.en: PRELIMINARY CONCLUSION: The levels of Feranmut Heart energy dissipation have exceeded the original model. We recommend using a particle mesh to acquire more readings for the cross-cycle data verification. All associated raw data and processing algorithms have been archived in the lab server.

content.cn: 分析员：奚墨
content.en: ANALYST: Xi Mo

title.cn: 《息壤堰内巨兽心脏能量数据分析报告》

content.cn: 《赤酋征伐录》 萨尔贡
content.en: Conquest by the Crimson Ameer (Sargon)

content.cn: 阿卡胡拉地区流传的史诗，记述了某位以“赤酋”为名的萨尔贡王酋扩张领土的征战史，他的军队以红色旌旗和残酷战术闻名。学者对其中神话与史实的比例争论不休。
content.en: A popular Acahuallan epic about the conquests and territorial expansions of a Sargonian warlord named the "Crimson Ameer". His armies were known for their crimson-colored banners and brutal tactics. To this day, scholars still debate if this work is largely mythological or how much of it was actually based on historical facts.

content.cn: 《霄阙年鉴·卷七》 炎国
content.en: Annals of the Empyrean Court, Scroll 7 (Yan)

content.cn: 大炎内廷秘史的一部分，专门记载了真龙执政某几年间炎国朝廷、地方发生的大事纪要，是研究炎国政治制度变迁的重要文献。
content.en: A part of the secret histories recorded by the interior courts of Great Yan. The records specifically focus on major events of the Yanese imperial court and of various regions across a specified period during the reign of the True Lung. It is an important historical source for studying the shifts and changes of Yanese administration and government.

content.cn: 《赤衫军之陨》 维多利亚
content.en: Fall of the Crimson Coats (Victoria)

content.cn: 一部关于历史上的“赤衫近卫军”如何在一次著名的王位继承战争中全军覆没并被遗忘的军事史著作，充满了悲情与背叛的叙事。
content.en: A work of military history about the Crimson Guards, their annihilation during a succession war, and how they were eventually forgotten. It is a narrative of sorrow and betrayal.

content.cn: 《赤雪：旧贵族衰亡史》 乌萨斯
content.en: Crimson Snow: Fall of the Old Houses (Ursus)

content.cn: 一位流亡的乌萨斯学者所著，分析乌萨斯帝国旧贵族如何在动乱中逐渐失去权力与影响力，书名中的“赤雪”既指鲜血，也隐喻旧贵族势力的消融。
content.en: Written by a fugitive scholar from Ursus. The work analyzes how the old nobility of Ursus gradually lost their authority and influence during the unrest. The "Crimson Snow" in the title refers to fresh blood and hints at the melting away of old noble powers and privileges.

content.cn: 《赤心论》 东国
content.en: Sekishin-ron (Higashi)

content.cn: 探讨感染者与非感染者能否“赤心相待”，摒弃偏见共存的一部哲学对话录，作者匿名，在各国地下思想界流传甚广。
content.en: Literal translation: Theory of Crimson Hearts (meaning: Theory of Sincerity). A philosophical dialogue by an anonymous author investigating whether sekishin aitaisu (transl. treating each other with sincerity) and abandonment of all prejudices can be achieved between the Infected (Oripathy positives) and the non-Infected (Oripathy negatives). This work was quite popular in the underground salons of various nations.

content.cn: 《霄壤之辩》 炎国
content.en: Xiao-Rang, Disquisition of Sky and Earth (Yan)

content.cn: 古典哲学名篇，探讨“天”（霄）与“地”（壤）的本质、关系以及人在其中的位置。
content.en: A famous work of classical philosophy that investigates the nature and relationship between Xiao (the sky or the firmament) and Rang (the earth), and the role occupied by humanity within the two concepts.

content.cn: 《赤雨呼号》 卡兹戴尔
content.en: Callsign: Crimson Rain (Kazdel)

content.cn: 一份号召被压迫者（尤其是感染者）团结起来争取权利的激进文稿，推测由萨卡兹雇佣兵或其他感染者组织撰写，被认为是整合运动之前感染者的重要思想文献。内容曾遭多国查禁。
content.en: A radical piece of writing calling for the oppressed, especially the Infected (Oripathy positives), to unite together and fight for their rights. The author was probably from a Sarkaz mercenary formation or other Infected organization. The work is a piece of key ideological literature for the Infected prior to the Reunion Movement, and was once banned in multiple nations.

content.en: Sekika Juuhachi Emaki (Higashi)

content.cn: 浮世画派大师的代表作画集，以其描绘黄昏时漫天赤霞的极致用色而闻名，影响了多个国家的绘画风格。
content.en: Literal translation: Eighteen Paintings of Crimson Sunset. A collection of masterwork paintings of the Ukiyo-e (transl. pictures of the floating world) genre. These pieces of fine art are famous for their unique color palette for depicting crimson sunsets, and have inspired the artistic works of many other nations.

content.cn: 《云霄乐章》 莱塔尼亚

content.en: An extremely valuable manuscript of ancient pieces of music discovered and compiled by William Fichte Czerny. It is said that the work included ceremonial pieces created by grandmasters of the Originium Arts. The originals, however, have been lost to time.

content.cn: 热门动作电影，获蓝卡坞学院奖提名。讲述一位来自炎国的侠客（代号“赤霄”）在哥伦比亚大都市中对抗阴谋的故事，充满了华丽的源石技艺打斗场面和文化碰撞笑料。
content.en: A popular action movie and a Wrankwood Academy Awards nominee. The movie is about a pugilist from Yan (codename "Chi Xiao") fighting a conspiracy deep in a Columbian metropolis, and features generous loads of spectacular Originium Arts fight scenes and culture shock humor.

content.cn: 《赤崖上的决斗》 叙拉古

content.cn: 仪式完成，我已经精疲力竭，所幸还有一根手杖，助我在风雪中前进。
content.en: The ritual is done. I'm completely exhausted. Thank goodness I still have a staff to help me trudge through the wind and snow.

content.cn: 前路难行，在雪地独坐片刻后，本想撑着手杖起身，竟发现身体不似从前沉重，日夜折磨我的关节痛也暂缓几分。
content.en: The road ahead is difficult, so I rested awhile by sitting on the snow. When I used my staff to get back on my feet, my body suddenly felt so much lighter. The joint pains that plagued me for years were gone.

content.cn: 走了几步，发现就算不带手杖，也能健步如飞。
content.en: I took a few steps and realized that I could make wide strides across the snow without my staff.

content.cn: 索性将它丢在雪中，凭这双腿向前去。
content.en: So I tossed my staff aside and kept going.

content.cn: 西格妮亲启：

content.cn: 你最近还好吗？有没有如愿成为雪祀？

content.cn: 我要先一步告知你一个好消息——我已经通过考核，正式成为铁誓军的一员了。
content.en: I have some good news for you — I passed the trials and became an actual Oathkeeper.

content.cn: 随信附上了我通过考核时留下的照片。我自觉比较帅气，所以寄给你看看。
content.en: I have attached a photograph of me passing the trials to this letter. It made me look good, so I decided to send it to you.

content.cn: 以及，我所属的旗队，或许近日就会在靠近萨米维格的地方短期驻扎。
content.en: Also, the banner that I've been assigned might be getting a short-term deployment soon. The site will be close to Samivegr.

content.cn: 那时，我想见你一面。
content.en: I hope we'll get to see each other when that time comes.

content.cn: 我已从北方归来。
content.en: I have returned from the north.

content.cn: 此前您教我的避寒方法帮了大忙。彼时不便携带物资，若非此法简便有效，我恐怕要吃不少苦头。
content.en: The warming Arts you taught me proved extremely helpful. There were times when I could not carry much supplies. Calamity would have befallen me if not for the Arts.

content.cn: 为表感谢，随信留下一些武陵特产的小零食，希望合您的口味。

content.cn: 不日我将再次归队。事毕后，再与您通信。
content.en: I must report back to my unit soon, and shall write you again once the mission ends.
