content.cn: 在终末地工业的人事档案中存在着一批特殊的干员：他们普遍留存着一份保密级别极高的额外卷宗；他们都持有与终末地工业高级管理人员直接通讯的权限；他们都是依据《终末地工业与罗德岛制药公司关于特种技术岗位合作的框架协议》，从罗德岛来的派遣人员——但实际上他们并不常在终末地的设施内工作，也并不总是执行终末地的任务，而是遍布在塔卫二各地，从事各种岗位。
content.en: The Endfield HR database has a list of special operators whose profiles are managed separately and locked behind an incredibly high Authority Level. These special operators have the right to directly communicate with senior corporate officers of Endfield Industries, and all of them are special Rhodes Island liaisons working at Endfield pursuant to the Framework Agreement on Special Technical Roles and Co-Operation Between Endfield Industries and Rhodes Island Pharmaceuticals. Most of these operators usually do not work at Endfield facilities and do not carry out Endfield assignments on a regular basis. Instead, they are often involved in various roles throughout Talos-II.

content.cn: 这些干员都拥有一个罕为人知的身份：再旅者。
content.en: These special operators are also known by an esoteric title: Reconveners.

content.cn: 由于穿越星门来到塔卫二的那一枚“最初的源石”在第一次天使战争的最后决战中受到污染，源石概念性的损伤导致其性质发生了退化。然而出乎预料的是，即使遭到了污染，混乱不堪的内化宇宙内部仍旧存在一些完整的信息碎片。这些信息碎片如同一道无穷尽的光，反而成为了腐化的信息流中唯一能看清的脉络。
content.en: The First Originium crystal that traversed the Cosmic Gate to arrive at Talos-II was contaminated in the final battle of the First Aggeloi War. The very fundamental nature of the info-crystal was damaged, causing degradation in its properties. Despite the contamination, several intact data shards remained within the chaos of its Assimilated Universe. Should anyone wish to navigate the corrupted data streams within, these shards can be perceived as a never-extinguishing beacon of blinding light.

content.cn: 出于各种目标，在管理员本人和M3的默许下，罗德岛的时任领袖华法琳对被污染的“最初的源石”开始进行抢救性研究。由于未知的原因，超域的反演性在此信息脉络周围表现得极为和缓。在华法琳对此脉络的解析中，一枚信息碎片的深度读数发生了意外的自发式上升，导致这枚碎片从内化宇宙“析出”到了现实空间。
content.en: To achieve various objectives, both the Endministrator and M3 tacitly allowed Warfarin (the leader of Rhodes Island at that time), to conduct emergency repairs and decontamination of the First Originium. For reasons unknown, the reversing nature of Æther was greatly slowed near the data vein. When Warfarin deciphered this data vein, Depth readings of a data shard underwent a spontaneous spike as it decrypted from the Assimilated Universe into realspace.

content.cn: 第一位再旅者抵达塔卫二其实是一个意外。管理员对此现象并不知情，华法琳显然也没有做好准备。仅就结论而言，再旅者们在走出源石森林后普遍对罗德岛和管理员表现出友好、合作的态度。此外，再旅者们似乎能明确地认识到自己是一个独立的人——尽管他们对自己在泰拉的“记忆原型”的一部分人生经历和人际关系有所认识，并也因此具有了“曾经”的技能和本领。
content.en: The first Reconvener also arrived at Talos-II by accident and without the Endministrator's knowledge. Warfarin was also unprepared for the arrival. Every Reconvener who left the Originium Woods has been friendly and willing to work with Rhodes Island and the Endministrator. All of them also seem capable of realizing that they are a unique individual, despite sharing partial knowledge of the life experiences and interpersonal relationships stemming from "distant" memories of Terra. Such knowledge also allows Reconveners to use skills and abilities wielded by their original counterparts.

content.cn: 华法琳随后发现了和信息碎片交流的方法。她压下了其他知情人的担忧，开始主动地探索源石森林，接回那些同意来到塔卫二的信息碎片，并为他们设计了一整套进入塔卫二世界的流程。许多再旅者已经在管理员沉睡期间来到了塔卫二，他们以帮助管理员为出发点，展开了各自的探索，寻找着各自的使命。
content.en: Warfarin later found a way to commune with the data shards. Despite the concerns of others aware of their existence, she began to actively explore the Originium Woods. Warfarin encountered data shards willing to set foot on Talos-II, and thus she designed a process to better lead them out of the Woods and enter the new world. Many Reconveners arrived at Talos-II while the Endministrator hibernated. The Reconveners began exploring the world and seeking their own destinies, and they did so with the goal of assisting the Endministrator in mind.

content.cn: 接回再旅者的行为近乎等同于创造生命，华法琳独自承担起了这个责任，她偶尔会对终末地方的知情人发泄由此而来的压力，但每一次她都会在最后反复提起，她是如何靠多年（100年前修正为500年，50年前修正为300年，目前称20年）的人生阅历“迅速”地说服自己的。
content.en: Leading Reconveners out of the Woods is essentially an act of creation. Warfarin bore the responsibilities for her actions though she would occasionally vent out her frustrations to Endfielders who knew of this project. After every stress-fueled episode, she would remind everyone how years* of extensive experience taught her that everything was worth its while. *NOTE: The years of extensive experience Warfarin claims to have are subject to change, with the figure being 500 years a century ago, 300 years half a century ago, and dropping to 20 years in her most recent claims.

content.cn: 罗德岛和终末地无论如何都愿意相信在森林里看见的那道光，以及循着那道光、在混沌之中诞生的意志们。
content.en: Any Rhodes Islander and Endfielder is willing to trust in the beacon of the Woods as well as the wills that followed the light and emerged from the roiling chaos.

content.cn: <@nar.quote>我也如此相信。</>
content.en: <@nar.quote>I believe so too.</>

content.cn: <image>Reading/document_cosmicGate_intro</image>
content.en: <image>Reading/document_cosmicGate_intro</image>

content.cn: 星门是人类对一种运作原理尚未被完全理解的前文明交通设施的称呼。在泰拉，主要大陆的南北两端各有一座星门。而塔卫二已知的唯一一座星门位于星球的北极。
content.en: Cosmic Gates represent a classification of precursor transportation infrastructure whose operational principles remain only partially understood by contemporary science. On Terra, these structures were positioned at both the northern and southern extremities of the planet's major continents. Talos-II, by contrast, possesses only one confirmed Cosmic Gate, located at its northern polar region.

content.cn: 泰拉的两座星门在人类发现时已经被毁坏，但人类设法复原了其中损毁程度较轻的北方星门（又称“萨米星门”），并随之发现其内部通向某种“亚空间”（现已确定其并非超域）。经过了无数尝试与牺牲，在泰拉本恒星系的前文明计量天体“天堂支点”重新启动后，人类终于找到了与北方星门配对的另一座星门，踏上了塔卫二的土地。
content.en: When discovered by humanity, both Cosmic Gates on Terra were found in states of severe damage. Through immense effort, researchers managed to restore the less-damaged northern structure, commonly called the "Sami Cosmic Gate". Exploration revealed it led to what was initially termed "subspace," though this has since been determined not to be a true Ætherside. After countless attempts and sacrifices, following the reactivation of the precursor celestial calculation and measurement device known as the "Celestial Fulcrum" within Terra's home star system, humanity finally identified the Cosmic Gate's paired counterpart. This breakthrough allowed the first steps onto the soil of Talos-II.

content.cn: 在塔卫二的开拓过程中，出于谨慎，人类并没有贸然对塔卫二的星门做出任何调整，也就未能进一步发现其他的星门，但文明环带的科学家们广泛认同一个观念——塔卫二所在的恒星系中必然存在其他星门。
content.en: During the colonization of Talos-II, humanity exercised deliberate caution by refraining from any modifications to the planet's Cosmic Gate. This prudent approach meant no additional Cosmic Gates were discovered in the process. However, scientists across the Civilization Band widely maintain that other Cosmic Gates must exist within Talos-II's star system.

content.cn: 泰拉往返塔卫二的这一生命通道维持了五年时间，直到第一次天使战争爆发，人类失去塔卫二的星门为止。今日，塔卫二的星门被笼罩在塔卫二的极光之下，人类活动不能到达。它的现况，以及彼侧泰拉的状况，都无法再为人所知。
content.en: This vital passage between Terra and Talos-II remained operational for five years until the outbreak of the First Aggeloi War, when humanity lost access to the Talos-II Cosmic Gate. Today, the Talos-II Cosmic Gate lies shrouded beneath the Aurora of Talos-II, beyond the reach of human activity. Its current condition, along with the status of Terra on the other side, has become inaccessible to human knowledge.

content.cn: <image>Reading/document_firstAngelWar_intro</image>
content.en: <image>Reading/document_firstAngelWar_intro</image>

content.cn: 第一次天使战争，指塔罗斯历5年至15年发生在人类与以天使为主的敌对势力之间的战争。塔罗斯历142年之前的文献中记述的“天使战争”与它指的是同一场战争。以塔罗斯历11年为界，它可以分为前后两部分。
content.en: The First Aggeloi War refers to the decade-long conflict spanning from Talosian Calendar, Year 5 to 15, fought between humanity and hostile forces primarily composed of Aggeloi. Historical records predating Talosian Calendar, Year 142 document this conflict simply as "the Aggeloi War", referencing the same engagement. The war divides into two distinct phases, separated by the pivotal events of Talosian Calendar, Year 11.

content.cn: 战争前期以天使造成的大规模灾害和人类方的混乱为标志。在战争爆发的24小时内，突然出现的大量锚点使得天使的巨型集群淹没并摧毁了人类在北方星门周围建立的、塔卫二最初的城市，它们完全占据了北极地区，并可能以目前仍未知的手段引发了“塔卫二的极光”。随后的六年则以残存人类在天使施加的压力下不断向南迁移，不断丧失技术产物为主轴。
content.en: The war's initial phase was marked by catastrophic disasters caused by the Aggeloi and widespread chaos among human forces. Within the first twenty-four hours of the conflict, suddenly emerging Ankhor points allowed massive Aggeloi swarms to overwhelm and obliterate humanity's earliest cities around the northern Cosmic Gate, Talos-II's inaugural city. They seized complete control of the polar region, potentially triggering the phenomenon now known as the "Aurora of Talos-II" through means that remain unknown. The subsequent six years saw surviving human populations driven southward under relentless Aggeloi pressure, progressively losing technological capabilities throughout their forced migration.

content.cn: 直到塔罗斯历11年，当时的管理员协助剩余的人类势力完成了重整，人类一方开始能够对天使的进犯进行较为有效的抵御——战争进入后期。在塔罗斯历15年的一次重大军事行动之后，天使在南方的活动终于得到了有效的遏制。这一时期的重大事件还包括巨兽萨米的参战、萨米子民掀起的“狂猎之日”、铁誓军的建军等。
content.en: By Talosian Calendar, Year 11, the current Endministrator had assisted the remaining human factions in reorganizing their forces, enabling effective resistance against the Aggeloi incursions. This marked the transition to the war's latter phase. Following a major military campaign in Talos Year 15, Aggeloi activities in southern regions were finally contained. Significant events during this period include Sami the Feranmut joining the Aggeloi War, the "Wild Hunt Uprising" initiated by Sami's followers, and founding of the Order of Steel Oath.

content.cn: 对人类来说，主要的天使灾害和战争行为在塔罗斯历15年末结束，因此这一年被一些人视为第一次天使战争的结束年，而另一些人则认为，塔罗斯历17年文明环带的建立才意味着这场战争的彻底终结。
content.en: For humanity, major Aggeloi disasters and combat operations concluded by the end of Talosian Calendar, Year 15. Consequently, some regard this year as the war's official end. Others maintain that the conflict truly reached its conclusion only with the establishment of the Civilization Band in Talosian Calendar, Year 17.

content.cn: <image>Reading/document_civilizationBand_intro</image>
content.en: <image>Reading/document_civilizationBand_intro</image>

content.cn: 文明环带是对在《环带公约》（以下简称《公约》）体系下，遵守相关规约的人类集合体的称呼。
content.en: The Civilization Band designates the collective human societies operating under the framework of the Band Accord (hereinafter referred to as the Accord), adhering to its established statutes and regulations.

content.cn: 文明环带由大大小小的阵营、团体、组织构成，由于《公约》的限制，并不接受自我宣称为“国家”的实体加入。它以《公约》为基础和准绳，推行成员间的技术分工和自治，维持人类在塔卫二的基本生存，争取人类在塔卫二的自我实现。具有文明环带认可的身份，居住在文明环带各阵营、团体、组织管治的处所中的人类被称为“环带居民”。在塔卫二的总人口中，环带居民占90%以上。
content.en: The Civilization Band comprises various sized factions, coalitions, and organizations. Bound by Accord restrictions, it does not accept self-declared "nation-states" as members. Using the Accord as its foundational framework, it promotes technical specialization and autonomy among members, sustains humanity's basic survival on Talos-II, and strives for human self-actualization on this world. Individuals possessing Civilization Band recognized status who reside within territories administered by its constituent factions and organizations are designated "Band Residents". This group constitutes over 90% of Talos-II's total population.

content.cn: 文明环带中最大的三个阵营分别是塔卫二全联盟工团（联盟工团）、环塔卫二企业联合商会（环塔商会）和大炎天师府附属宏山科学院（宏山科学院）。根据其《公约》地位，此三者合并称为“《环带公约》中享有不可动摇的立场的成员”（简称“U3”），也被广泛称为“三大阵营”“三巨头”等。
content.en: The three largest factions within the Civilization Band are the United Workers' Syndicates of Talos II (known as the UWST), the Talos-II General Chamber of Commerce (known as the TGCC), and the Affiliated Hongshan Academy of Sciences of Tianshi Bureau of Great Yan (known as the HAS). Under the Accord's framework, these three entities collectively hold the designation of "Unshakable Members of the Band Accord" (abbreviated as U3). They are widely recognized as the "Major Three" or the "Big Three".

content.cn: 终末地工业也是文明环带的重要成员之一。出于便利性和中立性的考虑，帝江号上设有专门供环带成员就《公约》修订和其他事务进行一般性讨论的会场。
content.en: Endfield Industries also stands as a significant member of the Civilization Band. For convenience and to maintain neutrality, Dijiang houses dedicated conference facilities where Band members conduct general discussions regarding Accord amendments and other collective matters.

content.cn: <image>Reading/document_Ether_intro</image>
content.en: <image>Reading/document_Ether_intro</image>

content.cn: 超域是对塔卫二星球内部、表面、大气及外层空间中存在的所有深度读数为1的时空的统称。在塔卫二的时间尺度下，现实空间与超域存在重叠，物质与能量在二者之间的流动已经被证实为可能。
content.en: The Ætherside is an overarching term for describing areas where Depth reading is at 1 in subterranean, surface, atmospheric, and orbital regions of Talos-II. Given the time scale of Talos-II, the Ætherside is currently overlapping with realspace. Flow of matter and energy between the two dimensions has been verified as a feasible possibility.

content.cn: 在塔卫二，重叠的现实空间与超域之间的阻隔有时会发生破溃，产生的空间通道（在罕见的情况下，时间尺度也会被打乱）被称为“裂隙”，裂隙的周围通常深度读数接近0.5，这也就代表着它附近会成为动态侵蚀高发地点。
content.en: In Talos-II, the barrier between the realspace and Ætherside may sometimes rupture to create an inter-spatial conduit (and in rare occasions, disrupt the very time scale itself) colloquially referred to as the "rift". Depth readings near rifts typically approach 0.5, which also means that Active Blight has a higher probability of occurring at these places.

content.cn: 种植源石或铺设活性源石可以有效降低周围空间的深度读数，从而在一定意义上遏制超域的破溃，但这种效果缺乏固定的规律。有时，源石的活性反而会受到裂隙的抑制。在超域活动活跃的区域，依赖源石技术的设备、器材都会受到较大影响。
content.en: Cultivating Originium or deploying activated Originium can effectively reduce depth readings in surrounding areas, thereby helping contain breaches in Æthersides to some extent. However, this effect lacks consistent patterns. At times, Originium activity may instead be suppressed by rifts. In regions with active Ætherside phenomena, facility and machinery reliant on Originium Arts often experience significant operational interference.

content.cn: 物质从现实空间进入超域的后果随机而不可预测，但可以确定的是生物维持生命相关的活动和反应在超域中受到极大的阻滞和妨害。而物质从超域进入现实空间时则会在现实空间中产生动态侵蚀。因此，现实空间与超域之间的物质交换实验受到《环带公约》的严格限制，绝大部分相关活体实验更是被禁止。
content.en: The consequences of matter transitioning from reality into Æthersides are random and unpredictable. What remains certain is that all biological processes essential to sustaining life experience severe disruption and obstruction within these domains. Conversely, when matter emerges from Æthersides back into realspace, it generates Active Blight in realspace. Consequently, matter exchange experiments between realspace and Æthersides face strict restrictions under the Band Accord, with the vast majority of related live-subject testing explicitly prohibited.

content.cn: 与物质不同，能量会以势能转化的形式单方面从超域流向现实空间，这种现象在没有产生裂隙的情况下仍会发生，与之相关的研究是“超域利用”这一主题的主要发展方向。但这种能量流动的速率超过某个阈值后，极易发生随机而不可控的爆炸。
content.en: Unlike physical matter, energy flows unidirectionally from Æthersides into realspace through potential energy conversion. This phenomenon occurs even in the absence of rifts, making related studies a primary focus in the field of Ætherside utilization. However, when this energy flow exceeds certain thresholds, it frequently triggers random and uncontrollable explosions.

content.cn: 人类对超域的理解还十分有限。尤其是将其与已知的亚空间区分开后更是如此。主流假说认为，超域本质上是另一片宇宙，一片正在安静地迈入热寂，并且遍布死亡之毒的宇宙，而亚空间则是隔开超域与现实空间的隔膜。但此类假说目前缺乏有效的数学模型或实验观测结果支撑。
content.en: Humanity's comprehension of Æthersides remains profoundly limited, particularly since distinguishing them from known subspace. The prevailing hypothesis suggests Æthersides constitute a separate universe, one quietly undergoing heat death while saturated with lethal toxins. Subspace, in this framework, would serve as the membrane separating Æthersides from realspace. Yet such theories currently lack substantiation through mathematical models or experimental observation.

content.cn: <image>Reading/document_Qingbo_intro</image>
content.en: <image>Reading/document_Qingbo_intro</image>

content.cn: 清波寨是位于武陵城外的一处小型聚落，居民傍水而生，早在宏山科学院的科研考察团到来前便在武陵地区生活。
content.en: Qingbo Stockade is a small riverside community located in the outskirts of Wuling City. The Stockaders were already living in this part of Wuling before the scientific survey team from Hongshan Academy of Sciences arrived in this region.

content.cn: 清波寨层叠的悬空构造与简单的水利设施支撑着寨民们的日常生活，尽管寨民窃取抢夺武陵城物资的事件时有发生，但清波寨在总体上仍然能够自给自足。
content.en: The stacked multistory design, hanging architecture, and simple waterworks are capable of supporting those living in Qingbo Stockade. Although Stockaders often steal and raid supplies from Wuling, the community is largely self-sufficient.

content.cn: 结合实地考察与清波寨寨民口述，地方史研究者认为，清波寨的建立可以追溯到耻辱战争时期。这场不光彩的武装冲突使许多人对文明环带的未来感到悲观，这种情绪同样影响到了清波寨的建立者。他们来到武陵地区，试图在这颗陌生的星球上重新寻找自己的归宿，不久之后便有了清波寨。
content.en: After analyzing field investigations and testimonies from actual Stockaders, folk historians believe that the founding of Qingbo Stockade occurred during the Humiliation War. That shameful conflict made many lose hope in the future of the Civilization Band. Such sentiments must have affected the Stockade founders as well. They ventured to the region of Wuling, found a new home on this alien planet, and expanded it into the Qingbo Stockade we see today.

content.cn: 根据多位老年寨民的口述，先人利用自己的才干，在侵蚀泛滥的武陵为众人寻得一片净土，先人的后代围绕祖泉起居生活，以简朴直接的方式应对塔卫二抛给寨子的难题。对清波寨的寨民们来说，侵蚀潮无疑是一种灾害，但同时也隔绝了外界的干扰，直到宏科院的天师们来到这里。
content.en: Oral testimonies from multiple elderly Stockaders describe how their ancestors used their skills and techniques to discover a pristine sanctuary amidst the Blight-flooded landscape of Wuling. The earliest Stockaders lived around the Ancestral Spring and devised simple, direct solutions to survive the unforgiving environment of Talos-II. To the Qingbo Stockaders, the Blight Tide was a disaster but also kept them free from outsiders until the arrival of Tianshi from Hongshan.

content.cn: <image>Reading/document_YinglungSpecialTaskForce_intro</image>
content.en: <image>Reading/document_YinglungSpecialTaskForce_intro</image>

content.cn: 应龙特勤队是宏山科学院下属的一支精锐作战部队，负责为宏科院执行最高级别的特种作战任务。
content.en: Yinglung Special Task Force (YSTF) is an elite combat unit serving under Hongshan Academy of Sciences (HAS). The unit is responsible for carrying out the highest levels of special combat operations.

content.cn: 应龙特勤队的成立基于《环带公约》赋予缔约各方建立并维持用于保卫文明环带整体的军事力量的权利这一共同原则。塔罗斯历23年，一位资深的炎国司岁台秉烛人从第一次天使战争的炎国老兵中，遴选并训练了第一批应龙特勤队队员。宏科院在应龙身上，毫无保留地投入了那些于战火中留存下来的炎国先进技术。应龙特勤队的队员装备了经过天师改造的巨兽造物，他们能在一定程度上利用巨兽的力量，是文明环带中极少数能在重度侵蚀影响环境下执行长时间作战任务的特种部队。
content.en: The founding of YSTF is compliant with the general principle provided in the Band Accord, where all Accord signatories are given the right to establish and maintain a military force for defending the entirety of the Civilization Band. In Talosian Calendar Year 23, a senior Candleholder under the Sui Regulator of Yan selected and trained the first cohort of YSTF members (colloquially referred to as Yinglungs) from among Yanese veterans of the First Aggeloi War. HAS generously provided the Yinglungs with advanced Yanese technologies that survived the war. Yinglungs are equipped with Feranmut artifacts and gear modified by the Tianshi, allowing them to wield varying degrees of Feranmut power. They are also one of the very few special forces capable of carrying out extended operations in environments severely affected by the Blight.

content.cn: 目前，武陵科学发展区部署有执行长期作战任务的应龙特勤小队。小队在整个武陵区设有多个哨站，首要任务为周期性深入北部禁区展开前沿监测，设置遏制侵蚀活动的息壤装置，同时负责清除所有针对武陵城的重大安全威胁。
content.en: An Yinglung squad is currently garrisoned at the Wuling Scientific Developmental District for long-term combat operations. These Yinglungs have established multiple sentry bases throughout Wuling. Their primary objectives include: conducting regular deep forays into the North Wuling Exclusion Zone for forward monitoring; deploying Xiranite devices to contain Blight activities; and neutralizing major threats to the security of Wuling City.

content.cn: <image>Reading/document_HongshanBureauofSwordmancers_intro</image>
content.en: <image>Reading/document_HongshanBureauofSwordmancers_intro</image>

content.cn: 宏山选剑局是由宏山科学院直接管理的重要研发生产机构，负责满足宏科院乃至整个文明环带的优质轻、重型武器装备的研发和生产需求。宏山选剑局在负责管理宏科院下属的各地选剑局的装备生产的同时，也负责审核和分发生产蓝图，以及对生产的装备进行质量的最终验证。
content.en: The Bureau of Swordmancers (also known as Hongshan Swordmancers or HS.Swords) is an important research and production institution directly managed by the Hongshan Academy of Sciences (HAS). The Bureau is responsible for the research, development, and production of high-quality light and heavy equipment and weaponry for HAS and the entirety of the Civilization Band. While managing production at various regional branches under HAS, the Bureau is also in charge of auditing and distributing production blueprints, as well as conducting final quality verification and validation of the equipment it produces.

content.cn: 在人们失去塔卫二的星门后，为了应对第一次天使战争中对人类一方极端不利的处境，宏山选剑局正式挂牌成立，集中力量研发能够有效应对天使的武器装备。在此基础上，选剑局生产了大量规格不同，适应泰拉各国军事人员使用需求的装备。如今，许多自第一次天使战争时期留下来的旧式装备，还能看到“选剑局造”的铭文。
content.en: The Bureau of Swordmancers was founded to address humanity's severe disadvantage during the First Aggeloi War after losing the Cosmic Gate of Talos-II. The Bureau then focused its research efforts on developing weapons and equipment that can effectively counter the Aggeloid threat. This laid the foundation upon which the Bureau produced equipment with a wide range of specifications capable of fulfilling the needs of military personnel from various Terran nations. To this day, many pieces of old equipment manufactured during the War still bear these inscriptions: Manufactured by the Bureau of Swordmancers.

content.cn: 时至今日，宏山选剑局的武器装备依旧是宏科院军事人员的首选。在文明环带的市场上，来自宏山选剑局的产品始终受到广泛好评。
content.en: Even now, weapons and equipment manufactured by the Bureau of Swordmancers remain the first choice of HAS personnel. Products of the Bureau are still very well received by the market of the Civilization Band.

content.cn: 岁兽，亦称“岁”，是炎国“大狩猎”中最后一位被击败，并被封印的巨兽。
content.en: The Feranmut Sui (or simply as "Sui") is the last Feranmut to be defeated and sealed during the "Great Hunt" of Yan.

content.cn: 在炎国的神话传说中，一位真龙曾举全国之力，亲率贤臣将士发起“大狩猎”，将活动在炎国境内的，被视若神明的巨兽猎杀殆尽。其中，最强大的巨兽“岁”背弃同族，转而协助炎国征讨。炎国付出了惨痛的代价，战胜了包括“岁”在内的全部巨兽，最终实现了“敕封神明”的壮举。“敕封神明”象征着炎国的命运自此重新掌握在人的手中。
content.en: In the legends of Yan, a True Lung once mobilized the powers of an entire nation and personally led talented scholars and powerful warriors in the "Great Hunt" that decimated the once godlike Feranmuts. During this war, a powerful Feranmut named Sui betrayed its own kin and assisted the Yanese nation in this war of subjugation. After paying a steep price, the Yanese people finally defeated all Feranmuts, including Sui itself, and achieved the great feat known as the "Ennoblement of the Gods". This event also marked the turning point at which the fate of the Yanese nation was returned to the hands of the mortals.

content.cn: 与此同时，我们清楚地了解到，在历史上实际发生的“大狩猎”，与神话传说的描述不尽相符。只是，由于“岁”相关的事务始终被列为炎国最高机密，许多研究者穷尽一生也未能触及真相。但根据宏山科学院提供的信息，以及来自罗德岛的档案，我们得知“岁”的十二位代理人曾行走于泰拉的大地之上。
content.en: Meanwhile, we also know clearly that the "Great Hunt" that actually took place in history may differ from the details embellished by the myths. However, all matters associated with Sui are treated as top secrets of the Yanese state. Many researchers have spent entire lifetimes in pursuit of the truth but never came close. Nevertheless, information provided by the Hongshan Academy of Sciences (HAS) and the archives of Rhodes Island indicates that the twelve proxies of Sui once walked upon the Land of Terra.

content.cn: 时至今日，宏山科学院一方面对巨兽相关问题仍持极为审慎的态度，另一方面与“岁”的第十三位代理人之间的合作已相当密切，双方共同改进了名为“巨兽心脏”的重要装置。该装置被视为宏科院在巨兽学应用技术领域的最高技术成果之一，其技术渊源最早可追溯至泰拉时期，此后通过深度融合协议源石技术，逐步演变为现有形态。首墩内部设有多颗巨兽心脏协同工作，它们共同构成了首墩如今的根基。
content.en: As of today, HAS remains extremely prudent on issues related to Feranmuts, though it has also achieved a close partnership with the thirteenth proxy of Sui. Both have worked together to improve crucial devices known as the Feranmut Hearts. Such devices are considered among the pinnacle of technological applications stemming from the HAS discipline of Feranmut studies, the technical origins of which can be traced back to the Age of Terra. Deep integration with Protocol-Originium technology eventually led to the current iteration. The interiors of the Marker Stone are furnished with multiple Feranmut Hearts working together, forming the foundation of the installation seen today.

content.cn: <image>Reading/document_XiraniteNexus_intro</image>
content.en: <image>Reading/document_XiraniteNexus_intro</image>

content.cn: 枢壤仪，是宏山科学院为应对武陵甚大裂隙而研制的诸多实验型源石设备之一。它借由瞬间释放的息壤能量，与超域能量相互作用，达到闭合裂隙的效果，是宏山科学院在武陵科学发展区的重要科研成果。
content.en: The Xiranite Nexus is one of the many experimental Originium devices developed and constructed by the Hongshan Academy of Sciences (HAS) to contain the Wuling Very Large Rift (Wuling VLR). This device is a key achievement of scientific research conducted by the HAS in the Wuling Scientific Developmental District, and it uses sudden emissions of Xiranite energy that react with Æther energy to seal the Rift.

content.cn: 塔罗斯历142年的大规模侵蚀灾害发生后，武陵科学发展区的息壤储备短缺。由息壤新材项目负责天师庄方宜牵头，却在数次迭代后仍远未达到预期的枢壤仪项目，被暂时中止，研究重点被转向息壤生产的迭代与天师桩阵列的建设。
content.en: After the large-scale Blight disaster in Talosian Calendar Year 142, the Wuling Scientific Developmental District reported shortages in its Xiranite reserves. Tianshi Zhuang Fangyi led the Novel Xiranite-Based Materials Project, which included Xiranite Nexus development. However, after multiple rounds of iterations that failed to deliver the desired results, the development of Xiranite Nexus was temporarily suspended. The project then shifted its focus to upgrading Xiranite production and constructing the Tianshi Pillar Array instead.

content.cn: 枢壤仪项目虽然被暂时搁置，但天师们一直对其抱有希望。塔罗斯历152年，在终末地工业的协助下，息壤产能窘迫的困境有所缓解，为了解决武陵甚大裂隙这一威胁，枢壤仪项目得以重启。
content.en: Although Xiranite Nexus development was put on hold, the Tianshi remained hopeful. In Talosian Calendar Year 152, support from Endfield Industries helped alleviate the crisis caused by limited Xiranite production yields. Xiranite Nexus development was then restarted to seek a permanent solution for the threat posed by the Wuling VLR.

content.cn: <image>Reading/document_HannabtCircuit_intro</image>
content.en: <image>Reading/document_HannabtCircuit_intro</image>

content.cn: 众生长地是对具备特定文化认同的塔卫二荒地流浪者群体的总称。
content.en: The Hannabit Circuit is a general term for certain groups of traveling wanderers who roam the wilderness of Talos-II while sharing a distinct cultural identity.

content.cn: 众生长地的成员自称“游人”，以游历者、游学者与流浪者的身份自居。他们在文明环带诸城之外的荒地上巡行漫游，掌握着独特的荒地生存本领与手工制造技术，并组建了自力更生的游牧聚落。尽管各聚落间有着迥异的传承，但众生长地的游人大多遵循着同一个基本理念——通过游历的方式历练自我，探寻与塔卫二的共存之道。
content.en: Members of the Hannabit Circuit refer to themselves as "Songseekers" and see themselves as travelers, wandering scholars, and nomads. Songseekers roam the wildlands beyond the cities of the Civilization Band. They have mastered unique wilderness survival skills and crafting techniques, and have founded many self-sufficient pastoral tribes. Although different Hannabit tribes uphold radically different traditions, every Songseeker in the Circuit follows the same basic tenet — take up the wanderer's path to hone oneself, and seek a way to coexist with Talos-II.

content.cn: 在众生长地的内部，“师者”是向导与教师，每位师者自成一派，向徒从传授知识，并在游历中不断验证、完善自己的理念；“徒从”则是学徒与追随者，他们从师者那里学习智慧，追随师者游历。在游历过程中，成熟的徒从往往会积累经验，走向独自游历的旅途，甚至接纳自己的追随者，成为另一位师者——正因如此，众生长地也被人们称为“荒野上的大学”。
content.en: The "Aldertones" of the Hannabit Circuit serve as guides and teachers. Each Aldertone has their own following, offering knowledge to their "Echolings" while wandering the world to validate and perfect their beliefs. The "Echolings" are apprentices and followers who acquire wisdom from their Aldertones and join them on their wandering journeys. A well-learned Echoling often gains enough experience to journey alone. When such Echolings gather their own following, they become Aldertones themselves — which is why the Hannabit Circuit is colloquially known as the "academy of the wilderness."

content.cn: 塞什卡，萨卡兹语中意为“歇脚地”。塞什卡是萨卡兹在塔卫二的代表机构，也是他们在塔卫二建立的家园。
content.en: Seš'qa means "The Stop" in the language of the Sarkaz. The Sarkaz built Seš'qa as their home on Talos-II, and it also serves as the organization representing their interests in this world.

content.cn: 第一次天使战争爆发后，来自卡兹戴尔的萨卡兹参与了几乎每一场重要战役。为了表达谢意，又或是密文板揭示了全新的预言，萨米的雪祀将陨落巨兽的一枚牙齿作为礼物赠予了萨卡兹。萨卡兹以巫术将巨兽的利齿转化为腾空之锚，一如过去的“生命脊椎”。他们以此为基础在空中建立了名为塞什卡的悬空城——远小于环塔商会的自由市和联盟工团的钢铁巨城，但作为“歇脚地”已然名副其实。
content.en: Ever since the outbreak of the First Aggeloi War, the Sarkaz of Kazdel have fought in nearly every major conflict in Talos-II. The Snowpriest of Sami thus gifted the Sarkaz a fang from the fallen Feranmut, perhaps as a token of gratitude, or to uphold a new prophecy revealed by the Foldartals. With their witchcraft, the Sarkaz converted the Feranmut fang into a floating anchor, much like the "Lifebone" of the past. Around this anchor, they built a floating city named Seš'qa — far smaller than the free cities of TGCC and the steel citadels of UWST. "The Stop" proved a fitting name for this Sarkazian community.

content.cn: 战争结束后，许多萨卡兹拒绝了过去的孤立传统，选择融入文明环带。塞什卡顺应潮流，以品牌经营者、意见代表和调解人的姿态为整个文明环带提供帮助。悬空城仍然保留了战时空中堡垒的功能，同时它也是一扇窗户：向整个文明环带开放的游乐园、剧场、露天集市，还有“巫术时刻”的品牌总部。技艺精湛的巫术工匠与佣兵仍然是塞什卡最引人注目的招牌，但曾经外界对萨卡兹的固有印象已不再是全部。
content.en: After the war ended, many of the Sarkaz walked away from their traditional isolationism and chose to become part of the Civilization Band. Seš'qa did not oppose the trend. Instead, they became brand managers, opinion leaders, and mediators and eagerly offered their services for the Civilization Band. Though the floating city has retained its functions as a massive military airship, it is also a window. The city contains a theme park, a theater, and a bazaar open to the entire Civilization Band. It is also the headquarters of the famous brand — Witching Hour. Skilled witch-crafters and mercenaries remain the most famous trades of Seš'qa, but these no longer define the stereotypes of the Sarkazian people.

content.cn: 即使不与战争为伴，萨卡兹也培下了新生活的土壤。
content.en: War is no longer the constant companion of the Sarkaz. They have finally tilled the soil for a new life.

content.cn: 寂语修会是继承了拉特兰信仰传统的技术研修组织，以一座移动的大修道院作为总部。
content.en: The Cabal of Tranquility is a technocratic organization that inherited aspects of the Lateran faith. Its current headquarters is the Monasterium, a nomadic city.

content.cn: 一个多世纪以来，寂语修会的修士们致力于修复在第一次天使战争中失落的泰拉技术，对塔卫二可能存在的前文明遗迹展开调查与发掘工作，并为人们提供精神引导。寂语修会积累了数目庞大的，受《环带公约》认可的技术专利，但他们仅将其中的一小部分用以维持修会本身的运作——绝大部分成果都在文明环带范围内进行了无偿的共享。
content.en: For more than a century, Cabal clerics have devoted themselves to restoring Terran technologies lost during the First Aggeloi War, excavating various locations of Talos-II in search of Precursor ruins, and providing spiritual guidance to the people. The Cabal of Tranquility has accumulated a vast number of technological patents approved by the Band Accord. However, the Cabal has made most of its technological endeavors free for public use within the Civilization Band, and only collects royalties on a small fraction of its patents to cover operational expenses.

content.cn: 寂语修会内部，修士们在共同的拉特兰信仰指引下形成了三大教派：
content.en: Internally, Cabal clerics have organized themselves into three branches following the teachings of their Lateran faith:

content.cn: 第一派为“会话派”。会话派修士从第一次天使战争的废墟中重拾了泰拉的源石微电子技术，帮助《环带公约》各方重新建立了现代水准的通信网络。便携终端、无人机，乃至帝江号的总控系统，都离不开会话派修士的技术支持。
content.en: The first is the Sessionites, whose clerics restored the Terran technology of Originium-based micro-electronics from the ruins of the First Aggeloi War. Their efforts helped the signatories of the Band Accord re-establish the modern communication network. Technical support from Sessionite clerics is indispensable for portable terminals (handyterms), drones, and even the master control system of Dijiang.

content.cn: 第二派为“重现派”。重现派常被外界认为是寂语修会的军事部门，这一教派充斥着手持重型铳械，身着重型甲胄的武装修士。他们是守护修会圣殿的战士，也是先史文明遗迹发掘的积极参与者。虽然他们所做的一切都是为了“重现圣城”，但这一切不仅是一个信仰符号，也是一种喜乐的生活方式。
content.en: The second is the Resurgonites. Outsiders may regard this branch as the military arm of the Cabal of Tranquility as it is full of clerics clad in heavy armor and wielding heavy guns and cannons. The Resurgonites are charged with the defense of Cabal temples. They also actively take part in the excavation of Precursor ruins. Although they claim their goal is to "restore the Holy City", not every action is an act of faith. Some simply enjoy this way of life.

content.cn: 第三派为“阐释派”。阐释派修士将信仰放在首位，当他们启程前往塔卫二时，圣城的巨变早已改写了拉特兰信仰本身。阐释派致力于治愈星门崩溃对文明环带造成的长久性精神创伤，通过提供精神引导，支持公共慈善事业的方式，重建人与人的联系，在塔卫二续写拉特兰信仰哲学的新章。
content.en: The third faction is the Veritarites, whose clerics place faith above all else. By the time these clerics first journeyed to Talos-II, the great upheaval of the Holy City had already transformed the Lateran faith itself. The Veritarites are committed to healing the long-term psychological trauma suffered by the Civilization Band following the collapse of the Cosmic Gate. Through spiritual guidance and public charity campaigns, they seek to restore human connections and compose a new chapter in theological philosophy on Talos-II.

content.cn: 铁誓军是驻守在塔卫二北方高纬度地区的文明环带防卫力量。
content.en: The Order of the Steel Oath is a defensive force currently garrisoned in the high latitudes of Talos-II, far north of the Civilization Band.

content.cn: 作为文明环带的盾牌，铁誓军拥有一个多世纪以来持续构筑的环北极圈工事群，以及承载了大量非军事人口（由来自文明环带的志愿者及军人家属构成）的要塞都市。这支骄傲的军团得到了来自整个文明环带提供的人力、技术及装备支持。他们的使命，或者说“铁誓”，正是围绕塔卫二的北极圈构建抵御锚点与天使的封锁线，不惜一切代价阻止第一次天使战争的惨剧重演。
content.en: As the shield of the Civilization Band, the Order of Steel Oath oversees territories that include the Polar Circle defense works, which it has been building for more than a century without pause, as well as fortress cities that house numerous non-combatants (including volunteers as well as family members of the Oathkeepers). The Order is a proud military organization, sustained by personnel, technology, and hardware supplied by the entirety of the Civilization Band. Its duty (also known as the "Steel Oath") is to hold the defense line along the Polar Circle of Talos-II against the Ankhors and the Aggeloi, and to do whatever is necessary to prevent a disaster like the First Aggeloi War from happening again.

content.cn: 第一次天使战争期间，铁誓军的前身，一支由泰拉各国军人组成的残军在塔卫二北极圈的边缘立起了军旗。他们与萨米维格的人们一道，在极光下挖掘战壕，建立了坚不可摧的友谊。在铁誓军封锁北极圈的连绵堡垒后方，熔炉要塞兵工厂吞吐着钢铁与重炮，遗产库保存着可追溯至泰拉结晶时代前的战争遗产，来自文明环带，以及在要塞中出生的军人们结为“旗队”，以浴血的战旗传承着铁誓军不屈的战斗意志。
content.en: During the First Aggeloi War, a motley force of soldiers from the various nations of Terra rallied and raised their battle colors on the polar fringes of Talos-II and became the predecessors of the Order. Together with the people of Samivegr, they dug a network of trenches beneath the Aurora and forged an indestructible alliance. Within the string of fortresses behind the Order's Polar Circle defenses, the Arsenals of Fort Forgefane churn out steel and artillery, while war relics that can be traced back to the Crystal Age of Terra are kept within the Order's vaults. Oathkeepers, whether they are fortress-born or hailing from the Civilization Band, are organized into banners. The blood-soaked pennants carried by banner ensigns are symbols of the Oathkeepers' indomitable will in battle.

content.cn: <image>Reading/document_Yan_intro</image>
content.en: <image>Reading/document_Yan_intro</image>

content.cn: 炎国，位于泰拉东方的古老帝国，疆域辽阔，人口众多，历史悠久。
content.en: Yan is an ancient empire located in the eastern parts of Terra. It is a vast and populous country well known for its long history.

content.cn: 炎国的医疗和教育体系完备，社会安定有序。长期以来，炎国在外交上保持着独善其身的态度，展现出不轻易干涉外部事务的和平姿态。只有在发生无可避免且刻不容缓的紧急事态时，来自炎国的信使与天师才会奉旨出访，参与外交事务。
content.en: Yan boasts robust public healthcare and education systems as well as a stable and safe society. For many years, Yan maintained a largely isolationist and peaceful stance, actively refraining from interfering in the affairs of other nations. Yanese messengers and Tianshi, authorized by imperial edicts, would only leave the borders and engage in diplomacy when an emergency made this approach the only resort.

content.cn: 炎国的最高统治者是皇帝，也被称为“真龙”。真龙通过“朝廷”——由皇帝和内阁，以及吏、户、礼、兵、刑、工六部组成的中央行政机构——和延伸至各地的官僚系统，实现对整个帝国的统治。六部之下，设有包括钦天监、司岁台在内的特殊机构。其中，司岁台专司岁兽分身的一应事务，掌握大量与巨兽相关的学识，其成员被称为“秉烛人”。在塔卫二宏山科学院的科研领域中，司岁台有着举足轻重的地位。
content.en: Yan's head of state is the Emperor, who also bears the title of "True Lung". The vast empire is governed by the imperial court — a centralized administrative collective comprising the Emperor, the Cabinet, and the Six Ministries (Personnel, Revenue, Rites, War, Justice, and Works) — as well as a bureaucracy that extends into every administrative division of Yan. Operating under the Six Ministries are specialized state organs, including the Imperial Astronomers and the Sui Regulator, the latter of which is charged with monitoring the fragments of the Feranmut Sui and thus possesses vast knowledge related to the Feranmuts. Those who serve within this organization are known as Candleholders. The Sui Regulator continues to play a crucial role in scientific research and development at the Hongshan Academy of Sciences on Talos-II.

content.cn: 强大的军事力量是炎国受周边国家敬畏的重要原因。禁军是整个炎国最高规格的武装力量，是真龙与帝国核心秩序的守护者，是炎国意志的最高执行者。禁军的选拔极为严苛，成员均具备强大的个人战力。在炎国的政治体系中，禁军便是那“不可动摇的秩序”，他们的存在本身即是一种威慑。但在目前的塔卫二上，禁军的规模远不及泰拉时期，他们的使命与人员构成也有了些许的变化。
content.en: Yan's powerful military is the main reason the country is respected by its neighbors. Among its armed forces, the Imperial Guards are the most powerful and elite formation. They serve as guardians of the True Lung, protectors of the core interests and order of the empire, and supreme executors of the will of the Yanese nation. The selection process for the Imperial Guards is extremely strict, and every Imperial Guard is a formidable combatant. Under the Yanese political system, the Imperial Guards represent an "unshakable order" and their mere presence imposes a powerful deterrent. The Imperial Guards of Talos-II, however, pale in scale when compared to their Terran counterpart. Their mission and composition have also undergone various changes.

content.cn: <image>Reading/document_WulingTianshiBureauAcademy_intro</image>
content.en: <image>Reading/document_WulingTianshiBureauAcademy_intro</image>

content.cn: 天师府学院，是大炎天师府附属宏山科学院设立在拥有一定规模的科学发展区内的教研一体机构，也正是在各区天师府学院的努力下，宏山科学院才能够在各个科研领域中，维持着高速发展。
content.en: The Tianshi Bureau Academies (TBA) are academic and research institutions established by the Affiliated Hongshan Academy of Sciences of Tianshi Bureau of Great Yan (also known as Hongshan Academy of Sciences, or HAS). They are usually located in scientific developmental districts that have reached a sufficient size or level of development. Thanks to the joint efforts of TBAs across various districts, the HAS is able to sustain rapid research and development in every field of science.

content.cn: 天师府学院的职责，除了进行各式各样的科研课题研究，还有为宏科院乃至文明环带培养出更多的“天师”。对于天师这一称呼，或许在炎国古话里被赋予了许多特殊的含义，但在如今的塔卫二，这一身份仅代表着他们是宏山科学院的正式科研技术人员。
content.en: The responsibilities of the TBAs include pursuing various scientific research projects and training more Tianshi for the HAS and the Civilization Band. The title of Tianshi carries a very special meaning in Ancient Yanese, but in Talos-II, a Tianshi is simply an official scientific or technical personnel of the HAS.

content.cn: 天师职称承炎制，按专业门类划分。相较于泰拉的天师，塔卫二天师们的研究领域，则更倾向于文明环带所面临的生存危机。也因为存在这种差异，天师府学院不再只对留在塔卫二的炎国后裔敞开大门，即便并非炎国人的后代，只要能向宏科院证明自己的能力，也能够在天师府学院中修习、研究。
content.en: The role of a Tianshi carries on the legacy of Yanese traditions and is divided into various disciplines. Unlike the Tianshi of Terra, the Tianshi of Talos-II focus on survival and crises faced by the Civilization Band. These differences are the reason why the TBAs of Talos-II no longer restrict their admissions to disciples of Yanese descent. Anyone who can prove their worth to the HAS will be able to study and conduct scientific research at the TBA.

content.cn: <image>Reading/document_AncestralSpring_intro</image>
content.en: <image>Reading/document_AncestralSpring_intro</image>

content.cn: 祖泉是清波寨寨民对寨中一处天然水源的称呼，传闻它具有净化侵蚀，驱散外来威胁的能力。
content.en: The residents of Qingbo Stockade named a natural source of water within the Stockade their Ancestral Spring. Rumors claim that the Ancestral Spring is capable of purifying the Blight and dispelling external threats.

content.cn: 据清波寨寨民间流传的说法，祖泉最早由避世至此的清波寨先祖所发现，因其特殊的净化侵蚀能力，成为了清波寨立寨的根基。多年来，无论是祭祀仪式还是节庆典礼，寨民总会聚集在祖泉旁进行。泉边既设有供日常汲水的水车，也放置着寄托对逝者思念的水竹铃。关于祖泉的种种传说在寨民间代代相传，渐渐凝聚成一种深厚的信仰。
content.en: Folklore of the Stockaders claims that the Ancestral Spring was first discovered by the founders of Qingbo Stockade when they sought refuge at this location. The ability of the Ancestral Spring to purify the Blight became the key feature upon which the Stockaders built their community. For years, the Stockaders held ceremonies and festivals at the Ancestral Spring. They also furnished it with water-collecting waterwheels and bamboo water chimes as tokens of remembrance for the deceased. All sorts of myths and legends revolve around the Ancestral Spring, gradually transforming the source of water into the foundation of the Stockaders' faith.

content.cn: 然而，少有人知的是，祖泉的净化之力并非来自神迹，而是源于泉底一座炎国的水利装置。该装置由炎国天师于百余年前建造，通过将侵蚀与泉流分离，使水源保持洁净。但由于年代久远，无人维护，装置储污池中积聚的侵蚀已濒临满溢，随时可能威胁到地上的清波寨。最终，在一位知情寨民的恳请下，管理员以源石技艺将其彻底封停，结束了它漫长而疲惫的使命。
content.en: Unknown to most, the purifying powers of the Ancestral Spring were not a miracle. They were actually achieved by the presence of a Yanese irrigation machine located at the bottom of the Ancestral Spring. This machine was installed over a century ago by Yanese Tianshi, and it kept the water clean by separating the Blight from the flowing aquifer. Given its age and lack of maintenance, the Blight buildup within the machine was close to reaching critical levels and posed a risk to Qingbo Stockade located at the ground level above. In the end, a knowledgeable Stockade resident sincerely asked the Endministrator to seal the machine with Originium Arts, thus ending the extended and exhausting operational run of the machine.

content.cn: 如今，祖泉已失去往日的“特殊能力”，但寨中仍有人坚信泉中自有神明庇佑。而那座静沉泉底，终将被时光湮没的水利装置，或许将成为那段往事最后的见证。
content.en: Though the Ancestral Spring has lost its "special powers" from the past, many Stockade residents believe that the spring is still protected by the gods. The irrigation machine that rests quietly at the spring will eventually be swallowed by time, though it may be the last witness to a particular period in history.

content.cn: <image>Reading/document_MarkerStone_intro</image>
content.en: <image>Reading/document_MarkerStone_intro</image>

content.cn: 首墩，宏山科学院正式投入运行的第一根天师桩。
content.en: The Marker Stone is the first operational Tianshi Pillar to be formally deployed by the Hongshan Academy of Sciences (HAS).

content.cn: 天师们为首墩赋予了远不止天师桩的职责。首墩及其附属的生产设施还承载了为武陵供应息壤的功能，一旦首墩出现问题，整座城市都将危如累卵。首墩区域还是武陵城巨兽心脏的所在之处。将两块壤心玉——巨兽心脏的核心能源——精确地结合在一起，便可以启动巨兽心脏。
content.en: The Tianshi built the Marker Stone to perform more than just Tianshi Pillar functions. The Marker Stone and its affiliated production facilities also supply Wuling with Xiranite. In other words, if anything were to happen to the Marker Stone, the entire city would be in grave danger. The Marker Stone area is also where the Wuling City Feranmut Heart is located. Joining two pieces of Xirancore Jade (the key source of power for the Feranmut Heart) in a precise fashion will start up the Feranmut Heart.

content.cn: 首墩与武陵城一同经历了从无到有的历程。为了纪念这段对武陵科学发展区至关重要的历史，人们在首墩区域建立起了城建馆，并在其外墙上记录下了武陵自开始建城以来的不同时间节点。
content.en: The Marker Stone and Wuling City share similar origins in that both were established in this stretch of previously unclaimed wilderness. To commemorate this crucial period in the history of the Wuling Scientific Developmental District, an Urban Development Hall was built in the Marker Stone area. The exterior walls of the hall also display important milestones dating from after the city's founding.

content.cn: <image>Reading/document_QingboHeroes_intro</image>
content.en: <image>Reading/document_QingboHeroes_intro</image>

content.cn: “清波豪杰”一词为清波寨寨民的口头用语，常用于指代清波寨寨史上崇武尚义、传承武术传统的习武之人。
content.en: Qingbo Hero (or "Qingbo Haojie" in Yanese) is a common vernacular phrase used by the residents of Qingbo Stockade. The term often refers to pugilists who pursue fighting prowess, uphold a code of honor, and continue the practice of martial traditions.

content.cn: 据寨民口述，清波寨的先祖曾历经战乱，受此影响，寨内上下始终信守居安思危、防患未然的理念。在建寨之初，研习炎国传统武艺便蔚然成风。寨内上到年逾古稀的老者，下到垂髫之年的孩童，无论天资高低，都会修习一些炎国传统的格斗技能，以此强身健体，护佑家园。其中天资较高者，有时也会离寨游历四方，以求在武艺境界上得到突破。
content.en: According to oral accounts given by Stockade residents, their ancestors had lived through the chaos of war. These experiences taught everyone in the Stockade to exercise constant vigilance and preparedness against any potential threat or disaster. When the Stockade was first built, the practice of traditional Yanese martial arts was already part of Stockade culture. Almost all Stockaders, regardless of age or skill, trained in Yanese combat techniques to strengthen their physique and to defend their homes. Those with exceptional talent might also leave the Stockade to roam the lands with the aim of further elevating their fighting abilities.

content.cn: 十年前，清波寨内大量习武寨民都被卷入了一场与武陵城的剧烈冲突中，冲突双方在此期间均蒙受了人员伤亡。事后，许多精于武艺的寨民，或是背井离乡，或是陷入消沉，清波寨的习武传统也就此沉寂，与寨内为比武切磋而设立的擂台一同蒙尘至今。
content.en: Ten years ago, numerous Qingbo Stockaders with combat training were involved in a violent confrontation with Wuling City that resulted in casualties for both sides. Since the incident, many Stockaders skilled in fighting either left their homes or retreated into an ennui of defeat. The martial traditions of Qingbo Stockade gradually died out, and the battle arena that the Stockaders once used to identify their best heroes has remained silent until this day.

content.cn: <image>Reading/document_SwordVaultDale_intro</image>
content.en: <image>Reading/document_SwordVaultDale_intro</image>

content.cn: 藏剑谷是位于武陵清波寨东南面的一处山谷。相传，其中有一座秘库，埋藏着第一次天使战争前遗留的技术遗产。
content.en: The Sword Vault Dale is a valley located southeast of Qingbo Stockade in the region of Wuling. Rumors say that the place is home to a secret vault containing technological relics from the First Aggeloi War.

content.cn: 有关此地的传说多见于武陵地区的话本创作中，如流传颇广的“大炎双侠”系列故事，便将藏剑谷设定为主角最终埋剑归隐之地，一些短篇话本还常将其描绘为藏有大量武器图谱与失落技艺的传奇秘境。然而，藏剑谷与秘库的具体情形仅有少数人员知晓，后来此地更是因第一次天使战争爆发遭侵蚀掩埋，相关记录也在动荡中散佚殆尽。宏山科学院的部分历史研究人员基于“昔日礼部与工部曾在此联合修筑一座秘库”的史料推测，谷内宝藏或为某些机巧重器的蓝图备份，旨在为后人开拓塔卫二提供助力。
content.en: This area is often the subject of short fiction and novelettes in Wuling. The popular series titled "Twin Heroes of Yan" chose Sword Vault Dale as the site where the hero buried the sword and retreated into seclusion. Other short stories often depict the vault as a mystic sanctuary filled with numerous weapon blueprints and long-lost technologies. However, the actual conditions of both the Sword Vault Dale and the secret vault were known to only a few. The site also became buried under the Blight following the outbreak of the First Aggeloi War, and almost all writings that mentioned the place were lost in the chaos that followed. Historical records mention how "the Ministry of Rites and Ministry of Works jointly constructed a secret vault at this site", and this was used as a reference by historians from the Hongshan Academy of Sciences to speculate that the dale-bottom vault may contain copies of intricate technologies or heavy machinery that could help explore and develop Talos-II.

content.cn: 如今，随着侵蚀潮退去，藏剑谷再度展现在世人眼前。相关研究人员深入探查后才发现，秘库中保存的实际上是来自泰拉诸国的珍贵人文典藏。根据其中的遗存记载，这个由炎国作为发起方与秘库修筑方的，珍藏了文明火种的计划，旨在于塔卫二留存所有应当被铭记的文明印记，使后人不致遗忘这段“来时之路”。
content.en: The retreat of the Blight Tide has revealed the Sword Vault Dale to our sights once more. Extensive site investigations conducted by a team of explorers revealed that the vault contents were largely precious collections of literature and fine arts produced by the various nations of Terra. Actual data found in the vault named the nation of Yan as the founder of the project and builder of the vault that houses the embers of humanity. Their aim was to create a cultural ark on Talos-II for the imprints of civilization that deserved to be remembered, and to ensure that posterity would not forget the "Road of the Past" taken by their ancestors.

content.cn: <image>Reading/document_NorthWulingExclusionZone_intro</image>
content.en: <image>Reading/document_NorthWulingExclusionZone_intro</image>

content.cn: 北部禁区，位于武陵科考站的旧址。十年前，以科考站为中心，周边地区逐渐形成了一个小型社区，有着包括学校、医院在内的各种设施。其中，培育了诸多应龙队员的“谈剑堂”，更是为了随父母一同居住在科考站的适龄儿童，专门开设了基础教育课程。
content.en: The North Wuling Exclusion Zone (North Wuling EZ) is located at what was once the Wuling Science Station. Ten years ago, a small town was built around the Science Station. The town had amenities that included a school, a hospital, and Tanjian Hall. The latter trained many members of the Yinglung Special Task Force (YSTF), and even provided basic education for children of schooling age who lived together with parents working at the Science Station.

content.cn: 塔罗斯历142年，宏山科学院驻武陵科考站的天师们尝试利用息壤遏制甚大裂隙的扩张趋势。这次尝试引发了灾难性的后果，武陵科考站及原型息壤设施在两小时内被裂隙爆发带来的侵蚀潮完全吞没。尽管宏科院在之后的救援行动中付出了巨大代价，幸存者仍然寥寥。宏科院投入全部应急力量，将受灾难影响的区域封锁在应龙关之后。这片被严密封锁的区域——武陵科考站的遗址，便是如今的北部禁区。
content.en: During Talosian Calendar Year 142, the Tianshi stationed at Wuling Science Station of the Hongshan Academy of Sciences (HAS) attempted to reverse the growth of the Very Large Rift (VLR) with Xiranite. This experiment triggered a rift rupture of disastrous effects, with Wuling Science Station and its prototype Xiranite facilities being completely engulfed by the Blight Tide within two hours. Although the HAS directed vast amounts of resources and personnel to support subsequent search-and-rescue operations, only a handful of survivors were saved. The HAS then committed all of its emergency response forces to contain the disaster within Yinglung Pass and enforced strict access control to the stricken area that covered the entirety of Wuling Science Station. This area became known as the North Wuling EZ.

content.cn: 十年以来，宏山科学院基于对文明环带整体安全的考量，将整个北部禁区彻底封锁，并派遣应龙特勤队于应龙关进行长期驻守。武陵城兴建后，宏山科学院也利用天师桩阵列等息壤技术产物，重新建立了对北部禁区内异常侵蚀现象的完整遏制体系。
content.en: For ten years, the HAS imposed a complete lockdown of the North Wuling EZ out of safety considerations for the Civilization Band, and even assigned Yinglung Special Task Force (YSTF) teams to long-term garrison duties at Yinglung Pass. After the completion of Wuling City, the HAS constructed a new comprehensive system for containing anomalous Blight phenomena in the North Wuling EZ. The system featured facilities based on Xiranite technology, such as the Tianshi Pillar Array.

content.cn: 在北部禁区的封锁措施实行之初，文明环带内部存在许多对宏科院是否彻底放弃武陵地区的猜测，即使在宏科院内也存在不同的声音。但武陵城的人们仍然怀揣着终有一日能彻底战胜甚大裂隙的希望与信念，并为之不断努力至今。
content.en: During the early phases of North Wuling EZ lockdown, many within the Civilization Band questioned whether the HAS might abandon the region of Wuling entirely. Certain voices in the HAS seemed partial to this course of action, but the people of Wuling still hoped for a day when they would triumph over the VLR. The Wulingers remain strongly and wholly committed to this belief.

content.cn: <image>Reading/document_YinglungPass_intro</image>
content.en: <image>Reading/document_YinglungPass_intro</image>

content.cn: 应龙关是宏山科学院为应对武陵甚大裂隙爆发而建设的大规模封锁设施群，其位于武陵地区的天堑之上，曾是武陵科考站外围侵蚀监测设施的一部分。建设之初名为“武陵关”，后因翻新扩建外加由应龙特勤队长期驻守管理，被宏科院重新命名为“应龙关”。
content.en: Yinglung Pass is a massive collection of lockdown facilities constructed by the Hongshan Academy of Sciences (HAS) to deal with the Wuling Very Large Rift (VLR) rupture event. The Pass, once part of the peripheral Blight monitoring facilities of Wuling Science Station, is located atop a natural chasm in the region of Wuling. When first completed, it was named "Wuling Pass". After subsequent overhauls and expansions, and deployment of an Yinglung Special Task Force garrison, the HAS renamed the defense works as "Yinglung Pass".

content.cn: 应龙关的主体关隘结构由宏山科学院的土木天师设计，天师们结合息壤材料技术，为限制甚大裂隙扩张而专门加强了针对侵蚀的防御构造。其采用的所有设计建造标准都基于一个假想场景——甚大裂隙的再度爆发。在必要时，宏科院会调用最高规格的应急力量介入，借助巨兽权能进一步强化应龙关的防御机能。
content.en: The main architecture of Yinglung Pass was designed by Tumu Tianshi of the HAS. The Tianshi incorporated Xiranite material technology. To contain VLR growth, the defensive structure was further reinforced with Blight-countering features. All design and construction standards were based on a hypothetical scenario of another VLR rupture event. If necessary, the HAS will further augment the defensive capacities of Yinglung Pass by committing its best emergency response forces and employing Feranmut Power.

content.cn: 驻守在此的应龙特勤队十年间持续肩负着北部禁区内部的监视、探查与清理任务，并负责在第一时间应对应龙关的各类突发状况。
content.en: For ten years, the YSTF garrison at Yinglung Pass has upheld the duties of monitoring, surveying, and eliminating Blight phenomena within the North Wuling Exclusion Zone (North Wuling EZ). The YSTF is also responsible for enacting rapid response measures against any contingency in the Yinglung Pass area.

content.cn: 如今，应龙关已屹立禁区边界十年之久。
content.en: As of today, Yinglung Pass has stood vigil at the boundary of the North Wuling EZ for ten years.

content.cn: <image>Reading/document_Blightshade_intro</image>
content.en: <image>Reading/document_Blightshade_intro</image>

content.cn: 在文明环带的超域研究领域，“蚀影”被视为一种极为罕见的超域活动现象。
content.en: According to the field of Æther sciences in the Civilization Band, "Blightshades" are considered extremely rare phenomena of Æther activity.

content.cn: 蚀影是一种通常表现为具备自主活动能力，存在强烈侵略性的“超域能量复现实体”。在既有的目击记录中，蚀影个体仅会在超域能量活动最活跃、侵蚀灾害最严重的极少数区域出现。
content.en: Blightshades represent a form of "Æther-replicated entity" capable of autonomous actions and high levels of aggression. According to existing witness reports, Blightshade entities are extremely rare, appearing only where Æther activities are most active or in the worst Blight-stricken areas.

content.cn: 蚀影个体会复现生物受到超域能量活动直接影响，被侵蚀物质完全吞没时的形态。在未受外部影响的情况下，多数蚀影个体展现出模仿生物生前行为的基本行为逻辑。一旦受到惊扰，蚀影个体将表现出高级的运动功能和认知功能，其行为将转变为以暴力手段驱逐或摧毁干扰因素。学界也曾收到过关于蚀影个体试图采取沟通行为的个案报告，但是始终未能得到确凿的证据。
content.en: Blightshade entities would replicate the form of a biological organism under the direct influence of Æther activities and when completely consumed by Blight matter. In the absence of external stimuli, most Blightshade entities would mimic basic behavioral patterns of their source organisms while alive. When disturbed, Blightshade entities would exhibit advanced motor functions and cognition, and assume a behavioral pattern that seeks to violently remove or destroy the source of disturbance. Researchers have received isolated reports of Blightshade entities attempting to communicate, though no solid evidence has been secured so far.

content.cn: 试图解释蚀影的存在及其活动原理的主流假说认为：蚀影的本质是被固定在现实宇宙的微弱超域活动现象场，是未能被彻底抹去的，已死生命的残留信息。在文明环带各方的侵蚀处置人员积累了不少蚀影应对经验的当下，蚀影存在的原因及其活动原理，仍然是一个未解之谜。
content.en: The mainstream hypothesis for the existence of Blightshades and their behavioral principles proposes that: Blightshades, in essence, are sites of weak Æther activities fixed in the material universe, and are manifestations of residual data of dead lifeforms that cannot be completely removed. However, even though Blight-handling personnel of various Band factions have accumulated substantial experience in dealing with Blightshades, the existence and behavioral principles of such entities remain an inexplicable mystery.

content.cn: 根据终末地工业S.O.W.关键敏感情报安全协议，在查阅关于“基石”的任何情报信息之前，请确认如下事实：
content.en: Pursuant to the Endfield SOW Security Protocol for Key and Sensitive Intelligence, please confirm the following facts before perusing any intel related to "The Foundation":

content.cn: 1. 基石是掌握了先史文明遗产的特殊个体，其存在本身就是遗产的一部分。
content.en: 1. The Foundation is a collection of unique individual entities that have mastered the legacy of the Precursor Civilization. Their existence itself is a part of the said legacy.

content.cn: 2. 基石对泰拉联合科考团的全面袭击引发了第一次天使战争，其摧毁、奴役泰拉文明的敌对意图无比明确。
content.en: 2. The Foundation launched a full-scale attack on the Terran Joint Science Expedition and triggered the First Aggeloi War. The Foundation has made its hostile intent to destroy and subjugate Terran Civilization irrevocably clear.

content.cn: 3. 基石是锚点与天使的创造者，但此二者只是基石最基本的“工具”。基石真正的造物要远比这些更加危险。
content.en: 3. The Foundation is the creator of Ankhors and Aggeloi, but these two entities are but the most basic "tools" of the Foundation. The true creations of the Foundation are far more dangerous than these crude constructs.

content.cn: 4. 塔罗斯历15年，管理员与四十英杰在北极取得了决定性胜利。基石的威胁被解除，这场胜利是终结第一次天使战争的关键。
content.en: 4. During Talosian Calendar Year 15, the Endministrator and Forty Heroes achieved a decisive victory in the North Pole. The victory eliminated the threat posed by the Foundation and proved crucial in ending the First Aggeloi War.

content.cn: <image>Reading/document_SamitheFeranmut_intro</image>
content.en: <image>Reading/document_SamitheFeranmut_intro</image>

content.cn: 萨米维格，萨米语中意为“萨米之路”，是萨米诸部落在塔卫二的主要居住地，也作为他们的团体名登记在《环带公约》中。这片偏远寒冷的土地是这颗卫星上最北端的大规模人类定居地，与铁誓军的要塞比邻。
content.en: Samivegr, a Sami term that literally translates to "The Way to Sami", is the primary habitat of various Sami tribes in Talos-II. The Samifjod (Sami people) also registered their community in the Band Accord under this name. Located near the Order of Steel Oath forts, the cold and frigid Samivegr is also the northernmost settlement of sizable scale on Talos-II.

content.cn: 萨米人自泰拉来到塔卫二的方法较为特殊——他们并非跟随科考团，而是在一头巨兽的背上穿越了时空的藩篱。这头巨兽是人类已知最大的巨兽个体之一，祂的名字同样是“萨米”，也被称为“祖灵之父”。文明环带对祂过去在泰拉的经历了解不多，在萨米人口耳相传的故事中，人们在接受“捕猎”“歇息”与“选择”的启示与十六次大会占卜后，决定跟随巨兽，去往“新的大地”，投入“祖灵之父赐予的新使命”。
content.en: The Samifjod's journey from Terra to Talos-II was rather unique. They did not follow any of the Science Expedition convoys. Instead, they rode on a Feranmut's back to cross the space-time boundary. This particular Feranmut, also named "Sami" (and sometimes referred to as the "All-Father"), is one of the largest Feranmut specimens known to humanity. The Civilization Band knows little about its past experiences in Terra. From the oral traditions of the Samifjod, after accepting revelations of "hunt", "rest", and "choose" and divinations from sixteen major assemblies, the Samifjod decided to follow the Feranmut to "new lands" and devote themselves to the "new mission granted by the All-Father".

content.cn: 巨兽萨米后来在战斗中陨落，其身躯重构了当地环境，形成了如今被称为“萨米维格”的地区。
content.en: The Feranmut Sami later fell in war. Its carcass then changed the local environment and transformed it into the "Samivegr" region we know today.

content.cn: 在萨米维格，大多数萨米人仍遵照他们古老的传统生活，他们以被称为“雪祀”的术师首领为中心形成一个个部落，交错分布在土地上，又由雪祀大会代表诸部落整体的意志，参与文明环带的事务。萨米维格的部族有许多优秀的战士，这和他们延续至今的战争传统密切相关。因此，志愿加入铁誓军的萨米维格部族战士是铁誓军最重要、稳定的兵源。
content.en: Most of the Samifjod in Samivegr adhere to their ancient way of life and traditions. They are divided into many tribes scattered across the land, each led by a leading caster known as the "Snowpriests". The Assembly of Snowpriests serves as the representative of the various tribes and partakes in various affairs of the Civilization Band. Given their long martial traditions that survive till this day, the tribes are famous for raising many excellent fighters. To date, Samivegr tribal volunteers remain the most important and stable source of recruits for the Order of Steel Oath.

content.cn: 一个萨米人会说，在塔卫二，除了战争的对象和方法，其他一切都没有，也不需要改变。“萨米维格”这个名字正是他们集体对这个精神的诠释和表现：祖灵之父已经死去，为我们而死，但祂的路尚在，祂的意志永存。
content.en: A typical Samifjod would say that they have nothing in Talos-II except enemies and methods for making war against them, and they do not need anything to change this fact. The name "Samivegr" is their collective interpretation and manifestation of their spirit: The All-Father has died for us, but His way has remained, and His will is eternal.

content.cn: <image>Reading/document_Feranmuts_intro</image>
content.en: <image>Reading/document_Feranmuts_intro</image>

content.cn: 巨兽是原生于行星泰拉的超巨型生物。
content.en: Feranmuts are gargantuan creatures indigenous to the planet Terra.

content.cn: 已知巨兽个体的躯体规模从最小数百米到最大数十万米不等，他们仅仅存在便足以改写自然规律，重塑星球环境，甚至孕育崭新的生命形态。另一方面，所有已知的巨兽个体都具备远超出现代源石技艺理论范畴的独特权能，其中最为人类所熟知的，是巨兽塑造自身“代理人”的能力。与泰拉人类保持着相近形态的“代理人”是巨兽与泰拉文明展开沟通的渠道，也是巨兽权能的具现，许多“代理人”个体行走大地数百年而从未被人类察觉。
content.en: Known Feranmuts measure anywhere from several hundred to several hundred thousand meters in size. Their presence alone could alter natural laws, transform planetary environments, and even give birth to new forms of life. Additionally, every known Feranmut wields unique powers that far surpass modern bases of Originium Arts Theory. One of the most commonly known Feranmut powers is the ability to create "proxies". These "proxies", while serving as a manifestation of Feranmut power, resemble Terran humans and serve as a channel by which Feranmuts communicate with Terran Civilization. In fact, many "proxies" have traveled across the Land for centuries without any humans detecting their true nature.

content.cn: 宏山科学院所属的炎国是泰拉诸国中对“巨兽”研究最深的国家，在历史上曾经与巨兽爆发战争。而如今，宏科院则是文明环带的“巨兽学专家”。他们掌握巨兽学识，与巨兽代理人维持着谨慎而平稳的关系，并将巨兽权能投入技术研发领域——新型源石材料“息壤”就是这一领域最重要的成果。
content.en: The Terran nation of Yan, from which Hongshan Academy of Sciences (HAS) hails, has performed the most extensive "Feranmut" studies and even fought a war against Feranmuts in its history. To this day, HAS remains the "expert regarding Feranmuts" in the Civilization Band. Armed with its strength in Feranmut studies, HAS maintains a cautious yet stable relationship with the Feranmut Proxy while it channels Feranmut powers into technological research and development. The novel Originium material known as "Xiranite" is a key result of this effort.

content.cn: <image>Reading/document_BeastLords_intro</image>
content.en: <image>Reading/document_BeastLords_intro</image>

content.cn: 兽主，一种十分特殊的存在。时至今日，无论是诉诸神秘学解释的不可知论者，还是试图通过源石理论作出实证分析的学者，都无法对兽主的存在进行准确的定义。我们了解到，尽管兽主通常以生物或近似生物的形象在人类的面前显现，但他们的存在更接近于承载着生物“形相”信息的载体。
content.en: Beast Lords are unique entities. Neither esotericists studying mystical and occult knowledge nor scientists with empirical data based on Originium Theory have succeeded in providing an accurate definition of the Beast Lords. We understand that even though Beast Lords assume the form of (or bear a close resemblance to) various beasts before humans, they are in fact closer to vessels bearing data on animal "likenesses".

content.cn: 在关于兽主起源与本质的谜团之中，唯有一个问题可以得到肯定的回答：兽主诞生于源石的直接影响。随着源石的影响遍及整个泰拉，兽主的足迹也开始在历史中显现。泰拉文明日渐兴盛，许多兽主都选择以自己的方式与人类为伴。他们时而全然不可见，时而又被尊为统治者的密友、家园的守护神、超凡的音乐家，或是富可敌国的大亨。
content.en: Of the many questions on the origins and nature of Beast Lords, only one has a definite answer: The Beast Lords are directly created by the effects of Originium. As the influence of Originium spread across Terra, the Beast Lords began to appear in various chapters of Terran history. And as Terran Civilization prospered and grew, many Beast Lords chose to coexist with humans in their own ways. Some remained invisible or only occasionally manifested themselves as close companions of various rulers, guardian spirits watching over ancestral homelands, exceptionally talented musicians, or ultra-rich magnates whose wealth rivals entire nations.

content.cn: 我们有理由相信，兽主如今仍然活跃在我们身边。
content.en: We have reasons to believe that Beast Lords are still very much alive and close to us.
